Bi nìn máń isaraafan gbanti ki tīī Siidɔn yab timbiiliwaal Asitaartee nì Moowaab yab timbiiliwaal Keemooki nì Amɔn yab timbiiliwaal Mooleeki ní. 14Joosiyaasi nìn yāntì bi gbáń ki wīī awaa taŋkpeeŋi ŋin bi nìn dūu cóoǹee, ki yāntì bi gāatì iwindɔ in bi nìn cóoǹee ní ki yāntì bi dū anikpab ki bíl̀ laakin ataŋkpeeyee nì iwaadɔee nìn cɔ́ee.
Joosiyaasi mɔ̄tìi bɔ́ntì dinimbɔtinool Isirayeel tiŋkin
(Kpèè 2 Kroo 34.6-7)
15Joosiyaasi nìn gbáń ki wīī Beeteel saraafaŋŋu nì mpaan ŋun pu bi nìn jáaḿ awaayee. Neebaati jipɔɔn Jeerooboowaam un nìn yāntì Isirayeel ŋá ikpitee di nìn máń-ŋu. U nìn tūū mpaanee pu ŋŋmi, ki gbáń ki wīī nsaraafan ní ki dū ŋwindɔ ŋun nìn bí niinee ki tūū ŋŋmi ŋu wùn̄ dúsi dusi ki kpántì ŋfantam.
16Míǹ boonee, Joosiyaasi fātèe ki ká akaakul di bí niin dijool puee. Niinee ní u tú binib bi cūtìi yōoǹ akaakulee poon akpab ní u dū-ŋi ki páaǹ nsaraafan pu ki wùn̄ ŋŋmi ki bíil̀-ŋu ki nóó nì ti-Dindaan bɔnaatiliu nín nìn sòon̄ pu ki síiǹee. 17Ní Joosiyaasi gíti bālifì yii: «Dikumpool dilal ní m wāĺ nee ní?» Ní kitiŋ gbantin nib kíí-u yii: «An sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu un nyánní Juudayee kaakul, úǹ di nìn sòon̄ tin a dá láá ŋá nsaraafan nee puee ki síiǹ.» 18Niinee Joosiyaasi tīī mara ki lī yii: «Ní yàntī dikaakul gbanti! Ubɔ ń taa gbēē ubɔnaatil gbanti kpabiŋ!» An nín dī pu bi yāntì u-kpabiŋee dee, ki kpáaǹ ubɔnaatil un nìn nyánní Samaarii tiŋkin ki dɔ́mińee.
19Isirayeel bɔtiibi nìn máń ŋwaadibiyaamu Samaarii timmu kɔkɔn ki yāntì ti-Dindaan nìn gíí diŋuul. Joosiyaasi nìn gbáń ki wīī ŋwaadibiyaamu gbanti kɔkɔ kii u nín nìn ŋá pu Beeteel tiŋkinee. 20U nìn dū ŋgbantamu pu waaŋi tandambi ki páaǹ isaraafan pu ki kūū ní ki dū anikpab ki páaǹ ŋi-pu ki tūū ŋŋmi. U ŋá míǹ ki dóòyee ní ki nín gítiń Jeerusaleem.
Juuda yab jíń Dilákatil jiŋaaliu
(Kpèè 2 Kroo 35.1,18-19)
21Ubɔti Joosiyaasi nìn tīī samaa kɔkɔ mara nee yii: «Jīmaan Dilákatil jiŋaaliu kí tīī ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu tinyool kii an nín ŋmàn̄ pu ki kā dipoondi gbɔŋku nee poon puee.» 22Kí yòon̄ ŋyunti ŋun bibɔsoonliibi nìn dáá kpòotī Isirayeel tiŋkee nì Isirayeel yab nì Juuda yab bɔtiibi yuntiŋuee, baa ti jíń Dilákatil jiŋaaliu kii un bi jíń nee. 23Joosiyaasi nín jíń dibeel abin saalku nì ata poonee ní bi jíń Dilákatil jiŋaaliu gbanti Jeerusaleem ki tīī ti-Dindaan tinyool.
Joosiyaasi maŋfal wiiŋyi nín kúntì puee
(Kpèè 2 Kroo 35.20-27, 36.1)
24Joosiyaasi nìn ŋá kii an nín ŋmàn̄ pu ki kā kugbɔŋu kun ní usaraaŋakpil Ilikiyawuu nìn ká ti-Dindaan Diikunee. U nìn kúntì bin kàal̀ abɔɔjal puee, ki kúntì awaakpitikaa nì amakaa nì ntimbiil tuuŋŋi ŋin kɔkɔ bi nìn pée ŋáańee Juuda nì Jeerusaleem timmun.
25Bibɔtiibi bin kɔkɔ nìn jíń dibeel ki wāatì ní Joosiyaasi nín bāańee, ubɔ kaa bàn̄-u. U nìn dū u-ba kɔkɔ ki tīī ti-Dindaan ki nóó-u nì u-pɔbil kɔkɔ nì u-naŋki kɔkɔ nì u-pɔŋŋu kɔkɔ kii Mooyiisi marau nín bí yii bí ŋá puee. Úǹ boonee, ubɔti ubɔ kaa ti nyáń ki bàn̄-u.
26Nì míǹ kɔkɔee, ti-Dindaan ŋuukpaandi din u nìn gíí Juuda puee kaa nìn sɔ̄ŋkì, di sá yii Manasee nìn yīntiǹ-u ki gbítì u-ŋuul ŋkpitim pu. 27An pu ní ti-Dindaan nìn lī yii: «M làá jà Juuda yab kí taa ti wāl̀-bi kii m nín ŋá Isirayeel yab puee. M làá dū Jeerusaleem tiŋki kin ní m lēēyee nì Kudii kun ní m nìn pōoǹ yii m làá nīn bí ku-ni kí nīn lèekī m-ba ki dàkèe kí fá.»
28Joosiyaasi tuuŋŋi ŋin kíǹee nì tin kɔkɔ u ŋée ŋmàn̄ ki kā Juuda bɔtiibi tuuŋŋi gbɔŋkun. 29Joosiyaasi nín nìn dáá bée ní Eejipiti bɔtiu Neekoo nín cá Eefiraati mɔɔl caŋin kí já nì Asuur bɔtiu. Ubɔti Joosiyaasi nìn kíntì-u nsanni kí já nì u, ama ní Faaroo kūū-u Meegiidoo tiŋkin. 30U kpíì mimmee ní u-janjaliibi dū-u ki ŋá tɔrɔku ubɔn ki yōoǹní-u Meegiidoo ki cáań Jeerusaleem. Bi nìn dū-u ki síb́ u-kaakulin. Míǹ boonee ní Juuda yab yōoǹ u-jipɔɔn Joowakaasi ki kāaǹ tibɔtiil ú fōō u-baa yil.
Joowakaasi, Juuda bɔtiu
(2 Kroo 36.2-4)
31Joowakaasi nìn cáá abin mmuŋku nì ata ní ki kpántì ubɔti. U nìn kóò Jeerusaleem ní ki jíń dibeel iŋmal ita. U-na nìn sá Liibina tiŋkin, Irimeeya bisal ní bi yíì-u yii Amutaal. 32U nìn ŋá tin kaa kítì ti-Dindaan nimbiinee kii u-naanjabee. 33Faaroo Neekoo nìn cúú-u ki bóob́-u ikusaka ní ki cáá-u ki cūnnì Riibila tiŋki kin bí Amati tiŋkpaaŋkinee ú taa ti nín̄ sá ubɔti Jeerusaleem. Neekoo nìn síiǹ Juuda yab yii bí pà lampoo animbil kúti kiiloobi kutukub bita nì sindaariya kiiloobi mmuŋku nì saalaa.
34Míǹ boonee ní u lēē Joosiyaasi jipɔɔn Eeliyaakiim ki kāaǹ ubɔti ú fōō u-baa yil ní ki kpántì u-yindi bi kíǹ ki yíì-u yii Yooyakiim. U nìn yōoǹ Joowakaasi úǹ ki cūnnì Eejipiti tiŋkin ki tɔ́ sarka, niin ní u gbíntì ki dāa kpáàa kpíì. 35Yooyakiim nìn tīī Faaroo Neekoo animbil nì sindaariya un u nìn bālifèe. Kí ŋmā kí pà an nimbiliŋee, u nìn kpèé báà ŋma ŋmam ní kí gíí udaan kunimbiŋmiiu kun an sá ú pèe.
Yooyakiim, Juuda bɔtiu
(2 Kroo 36.5-8)
36Yooyakiim nìn cáá abin mmuŋku nì aŋmoo ní ki kpántì ubɔti. U nìn kóò Jeerusaleem ní ki jíń dibeel abin saalaa nì diba. U-na nìn sá Ruuma tiŋkin ní ki sá Peedaya bisal ní bi yíì-u yii Seebuda. 37Yooyakiim nìn ŋá tin kaa kítì ti-Dindaan nimbiinee kii u-naanjabee ní.

english_text:
1 During Jehoiakim's rule, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia invaded and took control of Judah. Jehoiakim obeyed Nebuchadnezzar for three years, but then he rebelled.
2At that time, the Lord started sending troops to rob and destroy towns in Judah. Some of these troops were from Babylonia, and others were from Syria, Moab, and Ammon. The Lord had sent his servants the prophets to warn Judah about this, 3and now he was making it happen. The country of Judah was going to be wiped out, because Manasseh had sinned 4and caused many innocent people to die. The Lord would not forgive this.
5Everything else Jehoiakim did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah. 6Jehoiakim died, and his son Jehoiachin became king.
7King Nebuchadnezzar defeated King Neco of Egypt and took control of his land from the Egyptian Gorge all the way north to the Euphrates River. So Neco never invaded Judah again.
King Jehoiachin of Judah Is Taken to Babylon
(2 Chronicles 36.9,10)
8Jehoiachin was 18 years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled only 3 months from Jerusalem. His mother Nehushta was the daughter of Elnathan from Jerusalem. 9Jehoiachin disobeyed the Lord, just as his father Jehoiakim had done.
10King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia sent troops to attack Jerusalem soon after Jehoiachin became king. 11During the attack, Nebuchadnezzar himself arrived at the city. 12 Jehoiachin immediately surrendered, together with his mother and his servants, as well as his army officers and officials. Then Nebuchadnezzar had Jehoiachin arrested. These things took place in the eighth year of Nebuchadnezzar's rule in Babylonia.
13The Lord had warned that someday the treasures would be taken from the royal palace and from the temple, including the gold objects that Solomon had made for the temple. And that's exactly what Nebuchadnezzar ordered his soldiers to do. 14He also led away as prisoners the Jerusalem officials, the military leaders, and the skilled workers—10,000 in all. Only the very poorest people were left in Judah.
15 Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin to Babylon, along with his mother, his wives, his officials, and the most important leaders of Judah. 16He also led away 7,000 soldiers and 1,000 skilled workers, all of them trained for battle.
17 Then Nebuchadnezzar appointed Jehoiachin's uncle Mattaniah king of Judah and changed his name to Zedekiah.
King Zedekiah of Judah
(2 Chronicles 36.11-16; Jeremiah 52.1-3)
18 Zedekiah was 21 years old when he was appointed king of Judah, and he ruled from Jerusalem for 11 years. His mother Hamutal was the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah. 19Zedekiah disobeyed the Lord, just as Jehoiakim had done. 20 It was Zedekiah who finally rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar.
The people of Judah and Jerusalem had made the Lord so angry that he turned his back on them. That's why these horrible things were happening.
translation_text:
1Ŋyunti ŋun Yooyakiim sá ubɔtee, ní Babiloon bɔtiu Neebukadineesaar dɔ́miń kí já nì Juuda yab. Yooyakiim nìn kíǹ ki bí Neebukadineesaar taapu ki cáa sāā abin ata, ama ní boonee, ki dāa yíkì kaa kíí u-ba pu. 2Niinee ní ti-Dindaan dū Babiloon nì Siirii nì Moowaab nì Amɔn fukuliliibi ki tɔ́ u-pu. Bi nìn nāaǹ Juuda tiŋki ki nóó nì ti-Dindaan nín nìn dī u-tɔntɔnliibi bibɔnaatiliibi pu ki sòon̄ pu ki síiǹee. 3Ti-Dindaan u-ba di nìn cáań nnaabu gbanti ki tɔ́ Juuda yab pu, kun puee u nìn là kí jà-bi kí wàatī u-ba. Tiŋman ubɔti Manasee nìn baasii ŋá ikpiti ní. 4U nìn kūū maanyiibab tikpil ki yāntì fatiku gbí Jeerusaleem tiŋki, an puee ti-Dindaan kaa nìn kíí kí dūú pɔ̄.
5Yooyakiim tuuŋŋi ŋin kíǹee nì tin kɔkɔ u ŋée ŋmàn̄ ki kā Juuda bɔtiibi tuuŋŋi gbɔŋkun. 6Yooyakiim nìn kpíì ki cūtìi ŋàl̄ u-baabi ní u-jipɔɔn Yooyakiin fōō u-yil ki kpántì ubɔti.
7Eejipiti bɔtiu kaa nìn gíti nyēē u-tiŋkin kí cù kujaau, di sá yii Babiloon bɔtiu nìn jáń ki fōō ntimu mun kɔkɔ nìn bí u-taapuee, kí yòon̄ Eejipiti bùmbiki kí cáá sāā Eefiraati mɔɔl.
Yooyakiin, Juuda bɔtiu. Bin bi péé péé ki cúú kuyuŋuee
(2 Kroo 36.9-10)
8Yooyakiin nìn cáá abin saalku nì ata ní ki kpántì ubɔti. U nìn kóò Jeerusaleem ní ki jíń dibeel iŋmal ita. Bi nìn yíì u-na yii Neeyuseeta. U-na gbanti nìn sá Eelnatan bisal ní ki nyánní Jeerusaleem. 9U nìn ŋá tin kaa kítì ti-Dindaan nimbiinee kii u-baa nín nìn pée ŋá puee ní deedeedee.
10Ŋyunti gbantee, Babiloon bɔtiu Neebukadineesaar janjaliibi nìn dɔ́miń kí já nì Jeerusaleem yab ní ki māntìi tú-kì. 11Babiloon bɔtiu Neebukadineesaar u-ba nìn dɔ́miń kí já nì kitiŋ kin ní u-janjaliibi nìn māntìi túee. 12Niinee Juuda bɔtiu Yooyakiin nì u-na nì u-kpambaliŋ nì u-janjakpilib nì u-kàliŋkpilib nyáń ki túŋkì Babiloon bɔtiu. Neebukadineesaar nín jíń dibeel abin anii poonee ní u cúú-bi ki tɔ́ sarka.
13Kii ti-Dindaan nín nìn pée sòon̄ pu ki síiǹee, Neebukadineesaar nìn kóoǹ tigaajawan tin kɔkɔ nìn bí ti-Dindaan Diikunee nì tin kɔkɔ bí dibeecindinee. U nìn gbáń ki wīī sindaariya wanti tin kɔkɔ ní Isirayeel bɔtiu Saloomɔn nìn mɔ́ɔ́ ki síiǹ ti-Dindaan Diikunee. 14U nìn cúú Jeerusaleem yab kɔkɔ ki cáa cūnnì kuyuŋu. U nìn cúú bikpootiliibi kɔkɔ nì bijanjakpilib kɔkɔ, an dàkà yii binib kutukub saalaa. U nìn cúú ki kpáaǹ iŋal pu tɔntɔnliibi nì bicaabi kɔkɔ. Bin nìn pée kíǹ kitiŋinee di nìn sá biwɔfib. 15U nìn cúú Yooyakiin nì u-na nì u-nimpoobi nì u-janjakpilib nì abɔtibil ki yōoǹ-bi Jeerusaleem ki cūnnì Babiloon kuyuŋu. 16Babiloon bɔtiu nìn gíti cúú bigaajab kɔkɔ binib kutukub biluli nì iŋal pu tɔntɔnliibi nì bicaabi binib kutuku ki cūnnì Babiloon tiŋkin kuyuŋu. Binib gbanti kɔkɔ nìn sá bibaatandambi ní.
17U nìn dū Yooyakiin baawaai Mataniya ki kāaǹ ubɔti u fōō u-yil, ní ki kpántì u-yindi. Bi nìn kíǹ ki yíì-u yii Seedeesiyasi ní.
Seedeesiyasi, Juuda bɔtiu
(Kpèè Yeer 39.1-3, 2 Kroo 36.11-12)
18Seedeesiyasi nìn cáá abin mmuŋku nì diba ní ki kpántì ubɔti ní ki kāl̀ Jeerusaleem ki jíń dibeel abin saalaa nì diba. Bi yíì u-na yii Amutaal, uliibinaja Irimeeya bisal. 19U nìn ŋá tin kaa kítì ti-Dindaan nimbiinee, kii Yooyakiin nín nìn ŋá puee ní deedeedee.
20Ti-Dindaan nín nìn gíí diŋuul diŋyee puee di nìn yì-tì ní nnaabu gbanti jéetì Jeerusaleem nì Juuda yab pu, áli gba u dāa fātì u-boon ki tīī-bi.
Neebukadineesaar janjaliibi māntìi tú Jeerusaleem kí já nì kì
(Kpèè Yeer 39.1-7, 52.3-11)
Seedeesiyasi nìn yíkì kaa kíí u-ba pu Babiloon bɔtiu cee.

english_text:
Jerusalem Is Captured and Destroyed
(2 Chronicles 36.17-21; Jeremiah 52.3-30)
1 In Zedekiah's ninth year as king, on the tenth day of the tenth month, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia led his entire army to attack Jerusalem. The troops set up camp outside the city and built ramps up to the city walls.
2-3After a year and a half, all the food in Jerusalem was gone. Then on the ninth day of the fourth month, 4 the Babylonian troops broke through the city wall. That same night, Zedekiah and his soldiers tried to escape through the gate near the royal garden, even though they knew the enemy had the city surrounded. They headed toward the desert, 5but the Babylonian troops caught up with them near Jericho. They arrested Zedekiah, but his soldiers scattered in every direction.
6Zedekiah was taken to Riblah, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial and found him guilty. 7 Zedekiah's sons were killed right in front of him. His eyes were then poked out, and he was put in chains and dragged off to Babylon.
8About a month later, in Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king, Nebuzaradan, who was his official in charge of the guards, arrived in Jerusalem. 9 Nebuzaradan burned down the Lord's temple, the king's palace, and every important building in the city, as well as all the houses. 10Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem. 11He led away as prisoners the people left in the city, including those who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar. 12Only some of the poorest people were left behind to work the vineyards and the fields.
13 The Babylonian soldiers took the two bronze columns that stood in front of the temple, the ten movable bronze stands, and the large bronze bowl called the Sea. They broke them into pieces so they could take the bronze to Babylonia. 14 They carried off the bronze things used for worship at the temple, including the pans for hot ashes, and the shovels, snuffers, and also the dishes for incense, 15as well as the fire pans and the sprinkling bowls. Nebuzaradan ordered his soldiers to take everything made of gold or silver.
16The pile of bronze from the columns, the stands, and the large bowl that Solomon had made for the temple was too large to be weighed. 17Each column had been eight meters tall with a bronze cap over one meter high. These caps were decorated with bronze designs—some of them like chains and others like pomegranates.
18Next, Nebuzaradan arrested Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah his assistant, and three temple officials. 19Then he arrested one of the army commanders, the king's five personal advisors, and the officer in charge of gathering the troops for battle. He also found 60 more soldiers who were still in Jerusalem. 20Nebuzaradan led them all to Riblah 21near Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar had them killed.
Most of the people of Judah had been carried away as captives from their own country.
Gedaliah Is Made Ruler of the People Left in Judah
(Jeremiah 40.7-9; 41.1-3)
22 King Nebuchadnezzar appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam to rule the few people still living in Judah. 23When the army officers and troops heard that Gedaliah was their ruler, the officers met with him at Mizpah. These men were Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth from Netophah, and Jaazaniah from Maacah.
24Gedaliah said to them, “Everything will be fine, I promise. We don't need to be afraid of the Babylonian rulers, if we live here peacefully and do what Nebuchadnezzar says.”
25 Ishmael was from the royal family. And about two months after Gedaliah began his rule, Ishmael and ten other men went to Mizpah. They killed Gedaliah and his officials, including those from Judah and those from Babylonia. 26 After that, the army officers and all the people in Mizpah, whether important or not, were afraid of what the Babylonians might do. So they left Judah and went to Egypt.
Jehoiachin Is Set Free
(Jeremiah 52.31-34)
27Jehoiachin was a prisoner in Babylon for 37 years. Then Evil-Merodach became king of Babylonia, and in the first year of his rule, on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month, he let Jehoiachin out of prison. 28Evil-Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there. 29Jehoiachin was even allowed to wear regular clothes, and he ate at the king's table every day. 30As long as Jehoiachin lived, he was paid a daily allowance to buy whatever he needed.
translation_text:
1Seedeesiyasi nín jíń dibeel abin awa ŋmasaalaatiu poon iwiin saalaa dalee, ní Babiloon bɔtiu Neebukadineesaar nì u-janjaliibi kɔkɔ dɔ́miń kí já nì Jeerusaleem tiŋki. Bi nìn ŋātì bi-janjanaapaal kitiŋ boon ní ki gbìn̄ ataŋkpuku ki bíl̀ ki māntìi tú-kì. 2Bi nìn māntìi tú kitiŋee ki dāa sāā Seedeesiyasi nín jíń dibeelee, abin saalaa nì diba poon.
3Ŋkùm nìn nyāŋkì kitiŋin ní binib kaa nìn gíti cáá tiba kí jī. Uŋmananaati iwiin iwa dalee, 4Babiloon yab lùkū dibundi digundi din nìn māntìi tú Jeerusaleem tiŋkee. Kunyeeuee, min kamaa Babiloon janjaliibi māntìi tú-kèe, Juuda janjaliibi dūu dī kipunyɔkɔ kin bi dìŋfī ki cá ubɔti kuŋfaati kpaabun, kì bí agunlɔkɔ ali kansikinee ki sáǹ. Ubɔti Seedeesiyasi nìn kíĺ nsan ŋun cá Jɔɔdan tantakalinee ki nín cá. 5Ama Babiloon janjaliibi nìn kùl̄ ki bīiǹ ubɔti boon ní ki jìn̄ ki tin cúú-u Jeeriikoo tantakalin. Niinee ní u-janjaliibi kɔkɔ sáǹ ki yàl̄ ki dū-u ki fá. 6Babiloon yab nìn cúú ubɔti ní ki cáá-u ki cūnnì Babiloon bɔtiu cee, Riibila tiŋkin. Niin ní bi sòon̄ u-bɔti. 7Bi nìn lāntì Seedeesiyasi jipɔmbi u-nimbilin. Míǹ boonee ní Neebukadineesaar yāntì bi sāā ki cɔ́tì Seedeesiyasi nimbiliŋ aliitil, ní ki yāntì bi dū tasa kusakai ki bóob́-u tiŋan ki cáá-u ki cūnnì Babiloon tiŋkin.
Bi jáń ki fōō Jeerusaleem. Bi cúú binib nliliitiim ki cūnnì kuyuŋu
(Kpèè Yeer 39.8-10, 52.12-30, 2 Kroo 36.17-21)
8Babiloon bɔtiu Neebukadineesaar nín jíń dibeel dibindi diba kpá mmuŋku, uŋmaŋmooŋmooti winluluútiŋu poonee, ní Neebusaradan kɔ́ Jeerusaleem tiŋkin. U nìn sá Babiloon bɔtiu janjakpiliu ubɔ ní ki nìn sá bijanjaliibi bin cí ubɔtee kpiliu. 9U nìn gāā ŋŋmi ki tūū ti-Dindaan Diiku nì ubɔti diiku nì Jeerusaleem tiŋki diiŋŋi, cilinjee bikàliŋkpaambi diiŋŋi kɔkɔ. 10Babiloon yab janjaliibi bin nìn céeǹní ujanjakpilee nìn gbáń ki wīī digundi din bi nìn máń ki tú Jeerusaleem tiŋkee.
11Neebusaradan nìn cúú bin kɔkɔ nìn kíǹ ki gbíntìi bí Jeerusaleem tiŋkinee, an dàkà yii bin nìn sáǹ ki kɔ́ Babiloon yabee nì bin kɔkɔ nìn pée kíǹ ki bí niinee. 12Ama u nìn yāntì biwɔfib kansikin biba bíǹ ń nīn bí ki kù fiinyib nì tikpaajin tisatin.
13Babiloon yab nìn gbáń ki wīī ti-Dindaan Diiku jaantalkub bin bi nìn dū tasa kúti ki mɔ́ɔ́yee. Bi nìn gbáń ki wīī tɔrɔkub nì kusɔŋkpaaŋŋu kun bi nìn dū tasa kúti ki mɔ́ɔ́ an bí ti-Dindaan Diiku cindinee. Bi nìn yōoǹ kusɔŋu gbanti ki cáa cūnnì Babiloon tiŋkin. 14Bi nìn gíti yōoǹ ŋfantam kumbɔbiyaamu nì peelab nì njimu nì kɔŋkɔnnyɔkaabi nì tiwan tin kɔkɔ bi nìn pée dū tasa kúti ki mɔ́ɔ́ bi cáa tūǹ ditundi ti-Dindaan Diikunee. 15Bijanjaliibi bin cīití ubɔtee kpiliu nìn gíti yōoǹ kisambiki kin poon ní bi nìn tùutī talaalubee nì kisambiki kin poon bi ŋáań fatiku ki cáa yàantée. Tiwan gbanti kɔkɔee, sindaariya àá animbil kúti ní bi nìn dūu mɔ́ɔ́-tì.
16Tasa kúti tin ní Saloomɔn nìn yāntì bi dūu mɔ́ɔ́ jaantalkub liitil nì kusɔŋkpaaŋŋu nì tɔrɔkub ki síiǹ ti-Dindaan Diikunee nyiŋfiŋu kaa nìn cáá bí dūú ŋmàntī. 17Jaantalkub kamaa fɔkɔŋŋu yilpu nìn sá meetab biwa ní. Bi nìn dū tasa kúti ki mɔ́ɔ́ dikɔl yam, di-fɔkɔŋŋu sá meeta ubɔ nì dijandi ki tɔ́kɔǹ jaantalku kamaa yilpu. Bi nìn dū tasa ki lēē tilaandi yam nì greenaadi biliŋ ki nyɔ̄kɔntì ki māntìi tú-bi. Jaantalkub liitilee nì bi-laanti nìn sá tiwambaantiil ní.
18Ujanjakpilee nìn cúú usaraaŋakpil Seeraya nì u-taapu yɔu Seefaniya nì bisaraaŋaliibi bin nìn cīití ti-Dindaan Diiku punyɔkɔkee taatil kuyuŋu. 19U nìn gíti cúú ukàlinjakpaan un nìn kpèé bijanjaliibi bɔtee nì ubɔti saŋkiliibi biŋmoo bin nìn bí kitiŋinee. U nìn gíti cúú ujanjakpil un nìn fòol̄ bijanjaliibi ki gíti sá ugbaŋŋmalee nì Juuda yab binib imuŋku ita kitiŋin niin. 20Bijanjaliibi bin cí ubɔtee kpiliu Neebusaradan nìn yōoǹ bisarkadambi gbanti kɔkɔ ki cáa cūnnì Babiloon bɔtiu cee, Riibila tiŋkin. 21Ní Babiloon bɔtiu kūū bi-kɔkɔ Riibila tiŋkin, Amaati tiŋkpaaŋkin.
An nín dī pu ní bi cúú Juuda yab kuyuŋu ki jìn̄-bi bi-tiŋki puee dee.
Geedaliyasi, Juuda tiŋki gɔminau
(Kpèè Yeer 40.7–41.18)
22Babiloon bɔtiu Neebukadineesaar nìn yāntì binib biba gbíntì Juuda tiŋkin. U nìn lēē Ayiikaam jipɔɔn, Cafan naantiiu Geedaliyasi ki kāaǹ gɔmina ú nīn kpòotī-bi. 23Ŋyunti ŋun ní Juuda yab janjakpilib nì bi-janjaliibi bin kaa nìn dū bi-ba ki tīī Babiloon yab kí kpántí bi-yumbuuyee nín gbìl̄ yii Babiloon bɔtiu dū Geedaliyasi ki kāaǹ gɔminee ní bi cūtìi ká-u Miisipa. Bijanjakpilib bin nìn cūtèe di sá Neetaniya jipɔɔn Isimaayeel nì Kareeya jipɔɔn Yoowanan nì Taneewumeeti jipɔɔn Seeraya nì Neetoofa nì Yasaniyawuu nì Maaka. 24Geedaliyasi nìn tùkū bi-kɔkɔ yii: «Ní taa fàŋkì Babiloon yab. Nimbi dee, ní kàl̄maan kitiŋ nee poon kí sìntī ni-ba kí tīī Babiloon bɔtiu ní an kɔkɔ ń còom̀ tiŋan kí tīī-ni.»
25Ama dibindi poon ŋmaluluútiu poonee, Neetaniya jipɔɔn, Eeliisama naantiiu Isimaayeel un gíti sá Juuda bɔtiu dicaŋkun ubɔee nì binib saalaa táá ki cūtì Miisipa. Bi bàn̄ee ní ki kūū Geedaliyasi nì Juuda yab nì Babiloon yab bin nìn bí u-ceeyee. 26Niinee kí yòon̄ kibiki kí cáá sāā ukpaan nì bijanjakpilibee kɔkɔ kíĺ nsan ki nín cá Eejipiti, di sá yii bi nìn fāŋkì Babiloon yab.
Babiloon bɔtiu nyántì ubɔti Yooyakiin kusaarkadiin
(Kpèè Yeer 52.31-34)
27Bi nín cúú Juuda bɔtiu Yooyakiin ki cūnnì kuyuŋu abin ata kpá imuŋku ilee ní Eefiil Meerodaki kpántì Babiloon bɔtiu. Dibindi din u kpántì ubɔtee iŋmal saalaa nì ili poon iwiin mmuŋku nì iŋmoo dalee ní u nyántì Juuda bɔtiu Yooyakiin sarkan ki tīī-u dibatɔl. 28U nìn sòoǹ nì u kubɔɔtiiu poon ní ki nìn kāaǹ-u mpaan ŋun jítiǹ bibɔtiibi bin kɔkɔ nìn bí u-cee Babiloon tiŋkinee yai. 29U nìn yāntì Yooyakiin kaa ti pèentí disarkabɔkutil. Yooyakiin nì Babiloon bɔtiu di nìn kíǹ ki jīǹ disambibaantiilin baabadal. 30Kí yòon̄ ŋwiin gbanti kí tin sāā Yooyakiin kúm dalee, Babiloon bɔtiu di nìn tìì-u tin u máaǹ kí nīn cáá ki bí dimaŋfalinee.

english_text:
The Descendants of Adam
(Genesis 5.1-32; 10.1-32; 11.10-32)
1-4Adam was the father of Seth, and his descendants were Enosh, Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, and Noah, who had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
5Japheth was the father of Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras, and they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them. 6Gomer was the ancestor of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah. 7Javan was the ancestor of Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
8Ham was the father of Ethiopia, Egypt, Put, and Canaan, and they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them. 9Ethiopia was the ancestor of Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. Raamah was the ancestor of Sheba and Dedan. 10Ethiopia was also the father of Nimrod, the world's first mighty warrior. 11Egypt was the ancestor of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim, 12Pathrusim, Casluhim, and Caphtorim, the ancestor of the Philistines. 13Canaan's oldest son was Sidon; his other son was Heth. 14-16Canaan was also the ancestor of the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites, the Hivites, and Arkites, the Sinites, the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
17Shem was the ancestor of Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech; they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them. 18Arpachshad was Shelah's father and Eber's grandfather. 19Eber named his first son Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided into tribal regions. Eber's second son was Joktan, 20-23the ancestor of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah, Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah, Ebal, Abimael, Sheba, Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab.
24-27Shem's descendants included Arpachshad, Shelah, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, Terah, and Abram, later renamed Abraham.
Abraham's Family
(Genesis 25.1-4,12-16)
28Abraham was the father of Isaac and Ishmael.
29-31Ishmael had twelve sons, who were born in the following order: Nebaioth, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
32Abraham and his slave woman Keturah had six sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan. 33Midian was the father of Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah.
Esau's Family
(Genesis 36.1-14)
34Abraham's son Isaac was the father of Esau and Jacob. 35Esau was the father of Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. 36Eliphaz was the father of Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek. 37Reuel was the father of Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
The First Edomites and Their Kings
(Genesis 36.20-43)
38Seir was the father of Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. 39Lotan was the father of Hori and Homam; Lotan's sister was Timna. 40Shobal was the father of Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. Zibeon was the father of Aiah and Anah.
41Anah was the father of Dishon and the grandfather of Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran. 42Ezer was the father of Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. Dishan was the father of Uz and Aran.
43Before kings ruled in Israel, Bela son of Beor ruled the country of Edom from its capital of Dinhabah. 44After Bela's death, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king. 45After Jobab's death, Husham from the land of Teman became king. 46After Husham's death, Hadad son of Bedad became king and ruled from Avith. Earlier, Bedad had defeated the Midianites in the territory of Moab. 47After Hadad's death, Samlah from Masrekah became king; 48after Samlah's death, Shaul from the town of Rehoboth on the Euphrates River became king; 49and after Shaul's death, Baal Hanan son of Achbor became king. 50After Baal Hanan's death, Hadad ruled from Pai. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.
51The Edomite clans were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth, 52Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon, 53Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar, 54Magdiel, and Iram.
translation_text:
Kí yòon̄ Adam kí cáá sāā Eesayuu naantiibi
1Adam di màl̄ Seeti, ní Seeti màl̄ Eenɔsi, 2ní Eenɔsi màl̄ Keenan, ní Keenan màl̄ Maalaleeyeel, ní Maalaleeyeel màl̄ Jareedi, 3ní Jareedi màl̄ Eenɔki, ní Eenɔki màl̄ Matusaleem, ní Matusaleem màl̄ Lameeki, 4ní Lameeki màl̄ Noowa, ní Noowa màl̄ Seem nì Kaam nì Jafeeti.
5Jafeeti jipɔmbi di sá Goomeer nì Maagoogi nì Madayi nì Yafan nì Tubaal nì Meeseeki nì Tiiraasi. 6Goomeer jipɔmbi di sá Asikeenaasi nì Diifaati nì Toogarma. 7Yafan jipɔmbi di sá Eeliisa nì Taarsiisi nì Kiitiim nì Roodaniim.
8Kaam jipɔmbi di sá Kuusi nì Miisirayiim nì Puuti nì Kanaan. 9Kuusi jipɔmbi di sá Seeba nì Afiila nì Sabita nì Rama nì Sabiteeka. Rama jipɔmbi di sá Keeba nì Deedan. 10Kuusi di màl̄ Neemiroodi un sá ubaatandaan upeekaa kitiŋ puee. 11Miisirayiim di màl̄ Luudi yab nì Anam yab nì Leeyaab yab nì Nafituu yab, 12nì Patroosi yab nì Kasluu yab bin maaliŋu poon Fiiliistii yab nyánnée, nì Kafitoor yab. 13Kanaan màl̄ u-jipɔŋkpiliu Siidɔn, ní ki dū Eeti ki páaǹ. 14Kanaan naantiibi di sá Jeebusi yab nì Amɔɔr yab nì Giirgaasi yab, 15nì Ifii yab nì Arkii yab nì Siinii yab, 16nì Arfaadi yab nì Seemaar yab nì Amati yab.
17Seem jipɔmbi di sá Eelam nì Asuur nì Aripakisaadi nì Luudi nì Aram nì Usi nì Kuul nì Geeteer nì Meeseeki. 18Aripakisaadi màl̄ Seera, ní Seera màl̄ Eebeer. 19Eebeer màl̄ mbininjabiyaamu muli ní. Bi yíì ujipɔŋkpil yii Peeleegi, taapu di sá yii <diyakatil>, kun puee úǹ yuntiŋu ní binib nìn cúu yākatì tɔbin kitiŋ pu. U-naal ní bi nìn yíì Yɔkitan. 20Yɔkitan di màl̄ Almoodaadi nì Seeleefi nì Asarimafeeti nì Yeeraki, 21nì Adooram nì Usaal nì Diikila, 22nì Eebaal nì Abimayeel nì Seeba, 23nì Oofiiri nì Afiila nì Yoobaab. Yɔkitan jipɔmbi di sá bíǹ gbanti kɔkɔ.
24Seem màl̄ Aripakisaadi, ní Aripakisaadi màl̄ Seera, 25ní Seera màl̄ Eebeer, ní Eebeer màl̄ Peeleegi, ní Peeleegi màl̄ Reewu, 26ní Reewu màl̄ Seerugi, ní Seerugi màl̄ Naakɔɔr ní Naakɔɔr màl̄ Teera, 27ní Teera màl̄ Abram. Abram ní bi gíti yíì Abraam.
28Abraam jipɔmbi di sá Isaaki nì Isimaayeel. 29Bi-niboolii yiŋŋi sɔ̀.
Isimaayeel jipɔŋkpiliu di sá Neebayɔti. Bin páaǹee di sá Keedeer nì Adibeel nì Miibsam, 30nì Miisima nì Duma nì Maasa nì Adaadi nì Teema, 31nì Yeetuur nì Nafiisi nì Keedima. Isimaayeel jipɔmbi dee.
32Keetura, Abraam nimpuwaaki di màl̄ Siimran nì Yɔkisan nì Meedan nì Madiyan nì Yiisbaaki nì Suuwa. Yɔkisan jipɔmbi di sá Seeba nì Deedan. 33Madiyan jipɔmbi di sá Eefa nì Eefeer nì Anɔki nì Abiida nì Eeldaa. Keetura naantiibi di sá bíǹ gbanti kɔkɔ.
34Abraam di màl̄ Isaaki. Isaaki jipɔmbi di sá Eesayuu nì Jaakɔb. 35Eesayuu jipɔmbi di sá Eeliifaasi nì Reewuyeel nì Yeewusi nì Yalaam nì Koora. 36Eeliifaasi jipɔmbi di sá Teeman nì Oomaar nì Seefii nì Gaatam nì Keenaasi nì Tiimina nì Amaleeki. 37Reewuyeel jipɔmbi di sá Nakati nì Seera nì Sama nì Miisa. 38Seeyiir jipɔmbi di sá Lootan nì Soobaal nì Siibeeyɔn. Siibeeyɔn di nìn sá Ana baa nì Diisɔn nì Eeseer nì Diisan naanja. 39Lootan jipɔmbi di sá Oori nì Ɔmam. Lootan niisal di sá Tiimina. 40Soobaal jipɔmbi di sá Aliyan nì Manakaati nì Eebaal nì Seefii nì Oonam. Siibeeyɔn jipɔmbi di sá Aya nì Ana. 41Ana jipɔɔn di sá Diisɔn. Diisɔn jipɔmbi di sá Amiiran nì Eesban nì Yiitiran nì Keeran. 42Eeseer jipɔmbi di sá Biiliyan nì Saafan nì Yaakan. Diisɔn jipɔmbi di gíti sá Usi nì Aran.
Eedoom yab bɔtiibi nì bi-yidambi yiŋŋi
(Kpèè Diny 36.31-43)
43Bibɔtiibi bin nìn kāl̀ abee Eedoom tiŋki pu ki wāatì ní Isirayeel yab nín kíĺ ki kàantí bibɔtiibee yiŋŋi sɔ̀. Upeepeekaa di sá Beewɔɔr jipɔɔn Beela un sá Diinaba tiŋkinee. 44Beela kpíì ní Seera jipɔɔn Joobaab un sá Boosiraa tiŋkinee fōō dibeel. 45Joobaab kpíì ní Usaam un sá Teeman yab tiŋkinee fōō dibeel. 46Usaam kpíì ní Beedaadi jipɔɔn Adaadi fōō dibeel. Úǹ di nìn jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ Madiyan yab Moowaab satinee. U-tiŋki yindi di sá Afiiti. 47Adaadi kpíì ní Samla un sá Masireeka tiŋkinee fōō dibeel. 48Samla kpíì ní Sawuul un sá Reewoobooti, kitiŋ kin bí Eefiraati mɔɔkpaandi caŋinee fōō dibeel. 49Sawuul kpíì ní Akibɔɔr jipɔɔn Baal-Anan fōō dibeel. 50Baal-Anan kpíì ní Adaadi fōō dibeel. U-tiŋki yindi di sá Payii. U-nimpuu di sá Meetabeel un sá Matireedi bisal nì Meesayaab naantiiuee.
51Adaadi nín kpíìyee, bibɔtiibi bin kāl̀ kāl̀ Eedoom tiŋki pu dibeelee di sá Tiimina nì Aliya nì Yeeteeti, 52nì Ooliibama nì Eela nì Piinɔn, 53nì Keenaasi nì Teeman nì Miibsaar, 54nì Magidiyeel nì Iram. Eedoom yab bɔtiibi dee, ki nóó nì bi nín pēē pēē mmaal puee.

english_text:
The Descendants of Judah
1-2Jacob was the father of twelve sons: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
3Judah and his Canaanite wife Bathshua had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord had Er put to death, because he disobeyed and did what the Lord hated. 4Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar also had two sons: Perez and Zerah.
5Perez was the father of Hezron and Hamul. 6Zerah was the father of Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda. 7 Achan, who was a descendant of Zerah and the son of Carmi, caused trouble for Israel, because he kept for himself things that belonged only to the Lord. 8Ethan's son was Azariah.
The Ancestors of King David
9Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb. 10Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah. 11Nahshon's descendants included Salma, Boaz, 12Obed, and Jesse. 13-15Jesse had seven sons, who were born in the following order: Eliab, Abinadab, Shimea, Nethanel, Raddai, Ozem, and David. 16Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel. 17Abigail's husband was Jether, who was a descendant of Ishmael, and their son was Amasa.
The Descendants of Hezron
18Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon. 19After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur 20was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
21When Hezron was 60 years old, he married the daughter of Machir, who settled the region of Gilead. Their son Segub 22was the father of Jair, who ruled 23 villages in the region of Gilead. 23Some time later the nations of Geshur and Aram captured 60 towns in that region, including the villages that belonged to Jair, as well as the town of Kenath and the nearby villages. Everyone from the region of Gilead was a descendant of Machir.
24After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa.
The Descendants of Jerahmeel
25Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah. 26Jerahmeel had a second wife, Atarah, who gave birth to Onam. 27Ram was the father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker. 28Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada.
Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur. 29Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid. 30Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children; 31Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
32Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children, 33but Jonathan had two sons: Peleth and Zaza.
34-35Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai, 36the father of Nathan and the grandfather of Zabad. 37-41Zabad's descendants included Ephlal, Obed, Jehu, Azariah, Helez, Eleasah, Sismai, Shallum, Jekamiah, and Elishama.
The Descendants of Caleb
42Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, had the following descendants: Mesha, Ziph, Mareshah, Hebron, 43and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema. 44Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai, 45the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
46Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez. 47Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.
48Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah. 49Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah. 50-51All of these were Caleb's descendants.
Hur, the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath, had three sons: Shobal, Salma, and Hareph, who settled the town of Beth-Gader. 52Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan, 53and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
54Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites. 55Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_text:
Juuda naantiibi
1Jaakɔb ní bi gíti yíì yii Isirayeel. U-jipɔmbi di sá Rubeen nì Simeeyɔn nì Leefii nì Juuda nì Isakaar nì Sabulɔn, 2nì Daani nì Jooseefi nì Beenjameen nì Neefitalii nì Gaadi nì Aseer.
3Juuda jipɔmbi di sá Eer nì Oonan nì Seera. U-nimpuu, Suuwa bisal un sá Kanaan tiŋkinee di màl̄ u-jipɔmbi gbanti taatil. Ama ní u-jipɔŋkpiliu Eer nìn ŋá tin kaa fáatiǹ ti-Dindaanee ní úǹ yāntì u kpíì. 4Boonee ní Juuda coopu Taamaar dāa gíti màl̄-u Peereesi nì Seera. U-jipɔmbi kɔkɔ nìn nyáń biŋmoo dee. 5Peereesi jipɔmbi di sá Eesirɔn nì Amuul. 6Seera jipɔmbi di sá Simrii nì Eetan nì Eeman nì Kaalkool nì Daara. Bi mun nyáń binib biŋmoo dee. 7Kaarmii jipɔɔn di sá Akaar. Úǹ di nìn cáań nnaabu ki tɔ́ Isirayeel yab pu. Di sá yii u nìn yōoǹ tiwan tin bi jáń ki fōō kujaaun bi dūu sú Unimbɔtee. 8Eetan jipɔɔn di sá Asariya. 9Eesirɔn jipɔmbi di sá Yeerameeyeel nì Raam nì Kaleeb un bi gíti yíì yii Keelubaayee.
10Raam di màl̄ Amiinadaab ní Amiinadaab màl̄ Naasɔn un sá Juuda yab kpiliuee. 11Naasɔn di màl̄ Salima ní Salima màl̄ Boowaasi. 12Boowaasi di màl̄ Oobeedi ní Oobeedi màl̄ Jeesee. 13Isayi jipɔŋkpiliu di sá Eeliyaab, uliliiti di sá Amiinadaab, utataati di sá Simeeya, 14unanaati di sá Neetaneeyeel, uŋmooŋmooti di sá Radayi, 15ululuuti di sá Ooseem ní Daafiidi sá ululuúti. 16Bi-niisalib di sá Seeruya nì Abiigayiil. Seeruya jipɔmbi di sá Abisayi nì Joowaab nì Asayeel. Bi nyáń bita dee. 17Abiigayiil di màl̄ Amaasa. Amaasa baa di sá Yeeteer un sá Isimaayeel maaliŋunee.
18Eesirɔn jipɔɔn Kaleeb nimpoobi Asuuba nì Jeeriyɔɔti màl̄-u mbininjabiyaamu muta. Bíǹ di sá Jeeseer nì Soobaab nì Ardɔn. 19Asuuba kúm boonee ní Kaleeb cáá Eefiraati ní úǹ màl̄-u Uur. 20Uur màl̄ Urii ní Urii màl̄ Beesaleel.
21Eesirɔn nín bàn̄ abin imuŋku itee ní u cáá Galaadi baa Makiir bisal ní ki màl̄ Seeguub. 22Seeguub di màl̄ Yayiir un nìn ŋúb́ ntimu mmuŋku nì muta Galaadi tiŋkinee. 23Ama Geesuur nì Aram bɔtiibi nìn jáń ki fōō Yayiir timbilimmu nì Keenaati tiŋki nì ntimbilimu mun bí mu-taapuee. Ntimu gbanti nìn nyáń ntimu imuŋku ita ní. Galaadi baa Makiir naantiibi di nìn kóò ntimu gbanti kɔkɔn. 24Eesirɔn kúm boonee, Kaleeb nìn kpáfì nì u-baa Eesirɔn nimpuu Abiiya, Eefiraata tiŋkin ní ki màl̄ Aseekuur un náań Teekoowa tiŋkee.
25Eesirɔn jipɔŋkpiliu Jeerameeyeel jipɔmpeekaau di sá Raam. Bin kíǹee di sá Buuna nì Ooreen nì Ooseem nì Akiya. 26Jeerameeyeel gíti cáá unimpu ubɔ bi yíì-u yii Atara. Úǹ di sá Oonam na. 27Jeerameeyeel jipɔmpeekaau Raam jipɔmbi di sá Maasi nì Yamiini nì Eekeer. 28Oonam jipɔmbi di sá Samayii nì Yaada, ní Samayii jipɔmbi sá Nadaab nì Abiisuur. 29Abiisuur nimpuu Abiyayiil màl̄-u Akiban nì Mooliidi. 30Nadaab jipɔmbi di sá Seeleedi nì Apayiim. Ní Seeleedi kpíì kaa màl̄. 31Apayiim jipɔɔn di sá Yiseeyi. Yiseeyi jipɔɔn di sá Seesan. Seesan jipɔɔn di sá Alayi. 32Samayii naal Yaada jipɔmbi di sá Yeeteer nì Joonatan. Yeeteer kaa màl̄ ní ki kpíì. 33Joonatan jipɔmbi di sá Peeleeti nì Saasa. Yeerameel naantiibi dee.
34Seesan kaa cáá mbininjabiyaamu, u màl̄ nnimpubiyaamu ŋma ní. Ama Seesan cáá uyumbunaacimpɔɔn ubɔ u sá Eejipiti tiŋkin ní bi yíì-u yii Yaara. 35Ní Seesan lēē u-bisalib ubɔ ki tīī u-yumbuu gbanti u cáá, ní ki màl̄ Atayii. 36Atayii di màl̄ Naatan ní Naatan màl̄ Sabaadi. 37Sabaadi màl̄ Eefilaal ní Eefilaal màl̄ Oobeedi. 38Oobeedi màl̄ Jeewuu ní Jeewuu màl̄ Asariya. 39Asariya màl̄ Eeleesi ní Eeleesi màl̄ Eelaasa. 40Eelaasa màl̄ Siismayi ní Siismayi màl̄ Saluum. 41Saluum màl̄ Jeekamiya ní Jeekamiya màl̄ Eeliisama.
42Jeerameeyeel naal Kaleeb naantiibi di sá u-jipɔŋkpiliu Meesa, Siifi baa biyaamu nì Mareesa, Eebrɔn baa naantiibi. 43Eebrɔn jipɔmbi di sá Koora nì Tapuuwa nì Reekeem nì Seema. 44Seema di màl̄ Rakam ní Rakam màl̄ Jɔɔrkeeyam. Reekeem di màl̄ Samayii. 45Samayii màl̄ Mawɔn ní Mawɔn màl̄ Beeti-Suur. 46Kaleeb gíti cáá unimpu ubɔ bi yíì-u yii Eefa. Eefa di màl̄ Aran nì Moosa nì Gaseesi. Aran mun màl̄ kibininjabiki ní ki pú-kì diyindi yii Gaseesi. 47Yaadayi jipɔmbi di sá Reegeem nì Jootam nì Geesan nì Peeleeti nì Eefa nì Saafi. 48Kaleeb gíti cáá unimpu ubɔ bi yíì-u yii Maaka. Maaka di màl̄ Seebeer nì Tiirana. 49Boonee ní Maaka dāa gíti màl̄ Madimana baa Saafi, ní ki kútì Makibeena nì Giibeeya baa Seefa. Kaleeb cáá bisal ubɔ, bi yíì-u yii Akisa.
50Kaleeb dicaŋkun yab bin kíǹee sèé: U-nimpuu Eefiraata jipɔŋkpiliu Uur jipɔmbi nìn cáá mbininjabiyaamu muta. Múǹ di sá Soobaal un náań Kiiriyati-Yeeyariim tiŋkee, 51nì Salima un náań Beetileem tiŋkee, nì Areefi un náań Beeti-Geedeer tiŋkee. 52Soobaal un náań Kiiriyati-Yeeyariim tiŋkee naantiibi di sá binib bin kóò Aroowee tiŋkinee nì bin kóò Meenuwɔti tiŋkinee dijandi, 53nì Kiiriyati-Yeeyariim yab nín pēē pēē mmaal puee, an dàkà yii Yitirii yab nì Puuti yab nì Suuma yab nì Miisiraa yab. Binib gbanti kansikin biba di sá Soora tiŋki yab nì Eesitawool tiŋki yab.
54Salima naantiibi di sá Beetileem tiŋki yab nì Neetoofa tiŋki yab nì Atarooti-Beeti-Joowaab tiŋki yab nì Manaati tiŋki yab dijandi nì Koora yab, 55nì bigbannyiliibi bin kóò Jabeesi tiŋkin ki nóó nì bi nín pēē pēē mmaal puee, an dàkà yii Tiirati yab nì Simeeya yab nì Suuka yab. Bíǹ di sá Keen yab bin nyánní Amaati maaliŋun, ki sá Reekaab yab naanjee.

english_text:
The Descendants of King David
1-4 King David ruled from Hebron for seven years and six months, and during that time he had six sons, who were born in the following order: Amnon, Daniel, Absalom, Adonijah, Shephatiah, and Ithream. Ahinoam from Jezreel was the mother of Amnon; Abigail from Carmel was the mother of Daniel; Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur was the mother of Absalom; Haggith was the mother of Adonijah; Abital was the mother of Shephatiah; and Eglah was the mother of Ithream.
David then ruled from Jerusalem for 33 years, 5 and during that time, he had 13 more sons. His wife Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel gave birth to Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. 6-8David's other sons included Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet. 9David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter.
The Descendants of King Solomon
10-15Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz. 16Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
17Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel, 18Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah. 19Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister. 20He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed. 21Hananiah's descendants were Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, Rephaiah, Arnan, Obadiah, and Shecaniah, 22the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat. 23Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam. 24Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_text:
Daafiidi naantiibi
1Daafiidi jipɔmbi bin u màl̄ Eebrɔn tiŋkinee kansikinee, upeepeekaa di sá u-nimpuu Akiinoowam un sá Jisirayeel tiŋkinee jipɔɔn Aminɔn. Uliliiti di sá u-nimpuu Abiigayiil un sá Kaarmeel tiŋkinee jipɔɔn Daniyeel. 2Utataati di sá u-nimpuu Maaka un sá Geesuur bɔtiu Talimayi bisalee jipɔɔn Abisaloom. Unanaati di sá u-nimpuu Agiiti jipɔɔn Adooniyasi. 3Uŋmooŋmooti di sá u-nimpuu Abitaal jipɔɔn Seefatiya. Ululuuti di sá u-nimpuu Eegila jipɔɔn Itireeyaam. 4Daafiidi màl̄ u-jipɔmbi luutil gbanti Eebrɔn tiŋkin ní, ŋyunti ŋun u nìn kāl̀ kitiŋ gbantin abin aluli nì iŋmal iluu ki jíń dibeelee. Boon ní u nìkī ki cūtìi kāl̀ Jeerusaleem tiŋkin abin mmuŋku nì saalaa nì abin ata ki jíń dibeel. 5Jeerusaleem tiŋkin niin ní u-nimpuu Batiseeba, Amiyeel bisal màl̄-u mbininjabiyaamu munaa. Múǹ di sá Simeeya nì Soobaab nì Naatan nì Saloomɔn. 6Boonee ní u gíti màl̄ Ibaar nì Eeliisuwa nì Eel-Peeleeti, 7nì Nooga nì Neefeegi nì Jaafiya, 8nì Eeliisama nì Eeliyadaa nì Eeliifeeleeti. Bi nyáń binib biwa dee. 9Daafiidi jipɔmbi di sá bi-kɔkɔ, ní kí nín kūtì bin ní u-nimpuwaamu mun màl̄ màl̄-uee. Bi-niisal di sá Taamaar.
10Saloomɔn naantiibi di sá u-jipɔɔn Rooboowaam jipɔmbi Abiiya nì Asaa nì Joosafaati, 11nì Jooram nì Akasiyasi nì Joowaasi, 12nì Amasiyaawuu nì Asariyasi nì Yootam, 13nì Akaasi nì Eeseekiyaasi nì Manasee, 14nì Amɔn nì Joosiyaasi. 15Joosiyaasi jipɔŋkpiliu di sá Yoowanan, u-jipɔnliliitiu di sá Yooyakiim, utataati di sá Seedeekiyasi, ní unanaati sá Saluum. 16Yooyakiim jipɔɔn di sá Jeekooniya ní u-naantiiu sá Seedeekiyasi.
17Jeekooniya un bi nìn cúú ki cūnnì kuyuŋuee jipɔɔn di sá Saltiyeel, 18ní u-naantiibi sá Malkiiraam nì Peedaya nì Seenasaar nì Jeekamiya nì Oosama nì Neebadiya. 19Peedaya jipɔmbi di sá Sooroobabeel nì Simeeyii. Sooroobabeel jipɔmbi di sá Meesulam nì Ananiya, ní bi-niisal sá Seeloomiiti. 20U-jipɔmbi di gíti sá Asuuba nì Ookeel nì Beereekiya nì Asadiya nì Jusaab-Eeseedi. Bíǹ nyáń binib biŋmoo dee.
21Ananiya jipɔɔn di sá Peelatiya ní u-naantiibi sá Jeesaya nì Arinan nì Oobadiya nì Seekaniya. 22Seekaniya jipɔmbi di sá Seemaya nì Atuusi nì Igaal nì Bariya nì Neeyariya nì Safaati. Bi nyáń binib biluu dee. 23Neeyariya jipɔmbi di sá Eeliyooweenayi nì Isikiya nì Asiirikam. Bi nyáń binib bita dee. 24Eeliyooweenayi jipɔmbi di sá Ɔdafiya nì Eeliyasiib nì Peelaya nì Akuub nì Yoowanan nì Deelaya nì Ananii. Bi nyáń binib biluli dee.

english_text:
The Descendants of Judah
1Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal. 2Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
3-4Hur was the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath. Some of his descendants settled the town of Bethlehem. Hur's other descendants included Etam, Penuel, and Ezer. Etam's sons were Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash, and his daughter was Hazzelelponi. Penuel settled the town of Gedor, and Ezer settled the town of Hushah.
5Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah. 6Ashhur and Naarah were the parents of Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. 7Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
8Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
9Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family. 10One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
11Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton, 12whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
13Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai, 14who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
15Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
16Jehallelel was the father of Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
17-18Ezrah was the father of Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. Mered was married to Bithiah the daughter of the king of Egypt. They had a daughter named Miriam and two sons: Shammai and Ishbah. It was Ishbah who settled the town of Eshtemoa. Mered was also married to a woman from the tribe of Judah, and their sons were Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel. Jered settled the town of Gedor; Heber settled the town of Soco; and Jekuthiel settled the town of Zanoah.
19A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
20Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon.
Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
21-22Judah also had a son named Shelah, whose descendants included Jokim and the people of the town of Cozeba, as well as Er who settled the town of Lecah and Laadah who settled the town of Mareshah. The people who lived in Beth-Ashbea were also descendants of Shelah, and they were experts in weaving cloth. Shelah was the ancestor of Joash and Saraph, two men who married Moabite women and then settled near Bethlehem—but these family records are very old. 23The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king.
The Descendants of Simeon
24Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul. 25The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma. 26The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei. 27Shimei had 16 sons and 6 daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
28-31 Before David became king, the people of the Simeon tribe lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim. 32They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, 33as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
34-38As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza. 39When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located, 40and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites, 41but when Hezekiah was king of Judah, the descendants of Simeon attacked and forced the Hamites and Meunites off the land, then settled there.
42Some time later, 500 men from the Simeon tribe went into Edom under the command of Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel the sons of Ishi. 43They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_text:
Juuda naantiibi bin kíǹee
1Juuda naantiibi di gíti sá Peereesi nì Eesirɔn nì Kaarmii nì Uur nì Soobaal. 2Soobaal jipɔɔn Raaya di màl̄ Yakaati, ní Yakaati màl̄ Akumayi nì Lakaadi. Bíǹ di sá Soora tiŋki yab naanjab ki nóó nì bi nín pēē pēē mmaal puee.
3Jisirayeel nì Isima nì Idibasi di náań Eetaam tiŋki. Bi-niisal di sá Asileelpoonii. 4Eefiraata jipɔŋkpiliu Uur di náań Beetileem tiŋki. Úǹ nìn màl̄ mbininjabiyaamu: Peenuyeel un náań Geeduur tiŋkee nì Eeseer un náań Usa tiŋkee.
5Aseewuur di náań Teekoowa tiŋki. U nìn cáá binimpoobi bili ní. Bi yíì ubɔ Eela ní ki yíì un kíǹ Naara. 6Naara nìn màl̄-u Awusam nì Eefeer nì Teeminii nì Akastarii. Naara jipɔmbi dee. 7Eela jipɔmbi di sá Seereeti nì Soowaar nì Eetinan.
8Kɔɔsi di màl̄ Anuub nì Soobeeba ní ki sá Aruum jipɔɔn Areeyeel maaliŋun yab naanja.
9Jabeesi nìn cáá tinyool ki jítiǹ u-mambi nì u-naalib bin kíǹee kɔkɔ. Di sá yii u-na nín màl̄-uee, u pú-u diyindi yii Jabeesi ki lī yii: «An píĺ-mi ní m nín màl̄-u.» 10Dalbee ní Jabeesi mēē Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu ki lī yii: «A yaa lafun yú m-boon, á yàntī m-tinjandi ń wàan̄ kí kūtì. Wúń m-pu, ní kí jà nnaabu nì dinimbinaamandi kí wàatī-mi.» Unimbɔti nìn kíí ki ŋá tin Jabeesi mēē-uee ki tīī-u.
11Suuwa naal Keeluub di màl̄ Meekiir ní Meekiir màl̄ Eesitɔn. 12Ní Eesitɔn màl̄ Beeti-Raafa nì Paseeya nì Teekiina un náań Iir-Naasi tiŋkee. Bi-naantiibi nìn kāl̀ Reeka tiŋkin ní.
13Keenaasi jipɔmbi di sá Ootiniyeel nì Seeraya. Ootiniyeel jipɔmbi di sá Ataati nì Meeyɔnootayi. 14Meeyɔnootayi di màl̄ Oofiraa. Seeraya di màl̄ Joowaab un sá binib bin tūǹ ŋŋal pu tundi ki kóò Iŋal pu tɔntɔnliibi tantakalinee naanja.
15Yeefunee jipɔɔn Kaleeb jipɔmbi di sá Iruu nì Eela nì Naam. Eela jipɔɔn di sá Keenaasi.
16Yaleeleel jipɔmbi di sá Siifi nì Siifa nì Tiiriya nì Asareeyeel.
17-18Eesiraasi jipɔmbi di sá Yeeteer nì Meereedi nì Eefeer nì Yalɔn. Meereedi nìn cáá Eejipiti bɔtiu bisal Biitiya. Biitiya nìn màl̄-u Miiriyam nì Samayii nì Iseeba un náań Eesiteemoowa tiŋkee. Meereedi nìn gíti cáá unimpu ubɔ, u sá kijuudabiki. Úǹ di màl̄-u Yeereedi un náań Geedɔɔr tiŋkee, nì Eebeer un náań Sookoo tiŋkee, nì Yeekutiyeel un náań Sanoowa tiŋkee.
19Oodiya nìn cáá Naam niisal ubɔ. U-niboolii di sá Garimii maaliŋun yab bin kóò Keeyiila tiŋkinee nì Maaka maaliŋun yab bin kóò Eesteemoowa tiŋkinee.
20Siimɔn jipɔmbi di sá Aminɔn nì Riina nì Been-Anaani nì Tiilɔn. Iseeyii jipɔmbi di sá Sooweeti nì Been-Sooweeti.
21Juuda jipɔɔn Seera niboolii di sá Eer un náań Leeka tiŋkee, nì Laada un náań Mareesa tiŋkee, nì bin lù agbanjoo satab ki kóò Beeti-Asbeeya tiŋkinee maaliŋun yab, 22nì Yookiim nì binib bin kóò Kooseeba tiŋkinee nì Joowaasi nì Saraafi timmu. Binib gbanti nìn cáá Moowaab sapɔmbi ní ki nín dɔ́miń ki kāl̀ Beetileem tiŋkin. 23Bi-naantiibi nìn sá biyɔɔmaatiibi ní. Bi nìn kóòń Neetayiim nì Geedeera timmun ní ki tūǹ ditundi ki tìì ubɔti.
Simeeyɔn naantiibi
24Simeeyɔn jipɔmbi di sá Neemuyeel nì Yamiini nì Yariib nì Seera nì Saayuul. 25Saayuul maaliŋun yab di sá Saluum nì Miibsam nì Miisima. 26Miisima maaliŋun yab di sá Miiseema jipɔɔn Amuyeel nì Amuyeel jipɔɔn Sakuur nì Sakuur jipɔɔn Simeeyii. 27Simeeyii màl̄ mbininjabiyaamu saalku nì kiba nì nnimpubiyaamu muluu ní, ama ní u-nabiyaamu kaa màl̄ mbininjabiyaamu tikpil. An pu ní Simeeyɔn naakookun yab kaa wíiǹ ki bàn̄ Juuda naakookun yab.
28Ntimu mun bi nìn kóòyee di sá Beerseeba nì Moolada nì Asaar-Suwaal, 29nì Biila nì Eeseem nì Toolaadi, 30nì Beetuweel nì Ɔrima nì Siikilaagi, 31nì Beeti-Markabooti nì Asaar-Susiim nì Beeti-Biirii nì Saarayiim. Ntimu gbantin ní bi nìn kóò áli Daafiidi dāa kpántì ubɔti. 32Bi nìn gíti kóò Eetaam nì Ayiin nì Riimɔn nì Tookeen nì Asaan timbilimmun. Mu nìn nyáń ntimbilimu muŋmoo ní, 33ki kpáaǹ ntimbilimu mun māntìi tú-muee, ki tin cáa sāā Balaati tiŋki. Ntimu gbantin ní bi nìn kóò. Bi nìn ŋmàn̄ bi-dicaŋŋi kpilib yiŋŋi ki ŋá dikàandi gbɔŋkun.
34Simeeyɔn naakookun yab nín pēē pēē mmaal puee tindaŋkpilib di sá Meesoobaab nì Jamileeki nì Amasiya jipɔɔn Joosa, 35nì Jooweel nì Joosiiba jipɔɔn Jeewuu un sá Seeraya naantiiu nì Asiyeel naantitɔntɔkɔlee, 36nì Eeliyooweenayi nì Jakooba nì Jeesoowaya nì Asaya nì Adiyeel nì Jeesimiyeel nì Beenaya, 37nì Siifeeyii jipɔɔn Siisa. U-naanjab di sá Alɔn nì Yeedaya nì Simrii nì Seemaya. 38Bin yiŋŋi bi dáá yíiń nee nìn sá bi-maaliŋu poon kpilib, ní bi-dicaŋŋi nib nìn būtì tiŋan tiŋan pu. 39An pu ní bi nìn kpátìi gbí an kɔkɔ áli ki tin dūu gūū Geedɔɔr tiŋki, ditantakal ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú, ki nyàab̀ kupikpaapɔɔu kí kpàà bi-piii. 40Niin ní bi ká kupikpaapɔɔu kumɔntiiu timool bí ki sɔ̀m̀ fílfil. Kitiŋ gbanti nìn wāā ní ŋgbansɔŋfi bí ki-pu. Cannaakuee, Kaam naantiibi di nìn kóò niin. 41Ama ŋyunti ŋun Eeseekiyaasi nìn sá Juuda bɔtiuee ní bikpilib bin yiŋŋi ti dáá yíiń nee dūu bāań kitiŋ gbantin. Bi nìn nāaǹ tantib nì ikɔŋkoon laakin Kaam yab nìn kóòyee. Bi nìn kūū ki céetì bi-nib kɔkɔ ní báà ubɔ kaa ti kíǹ ki dāa sāā díǹ. Niinee ní bíǹ fōō bi-tiŋki ki kíǹ ki kóò, kun puee kupikpaapɔɔu nìn bí niin bí kpàà bi-piii.
42Simeeyɔn naakookun yab binib alaataa aŋmoo nìn yíkì ki nín jɔ́ḿ Seeyiir jool pu. Isii jipɔmbi Peelatiya nì Neeyariya nì Reefaya nì Usiyeel di nìn sá bi-yidambi. 43Bi bàn̄ee ní ki púntìi kūū ki céetì Amaleeki yab bin nìn sáǹ ki ŋmátì ki cūtìi kā niinee, ní ki fōō mpaan ki kāl̀. Bi-naantiibi dáá gbíntìi bí niin ki dāa sāā díǹ.

english_text:
The Descendants of Reuben
1 Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph, 2 even though it was the Judah tribe that became the most powerful and produced a leader.
3Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
4-6 The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
7-8The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon, 9and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
10When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead.
The Descendants of Gad
11The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah. 12Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat. 13Their relatives included Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.
14They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz. 15Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
16The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon. 17Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
18The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh had 44,760 soldiers trained to fight in battle with shields, swords, bows, and arrows. 19They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab. 20Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies. 21These Israelite tribes captured 50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep, 2,000 donkeys, and 100,000 people. 22Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria.
The Tribe of East Manasseh
23East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon. 24Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers.
The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
25The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan. 26 So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_text:
Rubeen naantiibi
1Jaakɔb biseebiki Rubeen jipɔmbi sèé. Rubeen di sá Jaakɔb jipɔŋkpiliu. Ama u nìn dōoǹ nì u-baa nimpoobi kansikin ubɔ. Míǹ boonee ní bi cúú tijipɔŋkpiti ki fōō u-cee ki dūu tīī Jooseefi jipɔmbi. Jooseefi mun nìn sá Isirayeel jipɔmbi kansikin ubɔ ní. Kí yòon̄ ŋyunti gbantee, baa nìn gíti dū Rubeen ki yíiń ujipɔŋkpil. 2Juuda di nìn sá u-mambi nì u-naalib kansikin un pɔ̄ɔ̄, ní u-dicaŋkun yab ubɔ dāa kpántì Isirayeel bɔtiuee. Ama Jooseefi ní bi dū tikpiti ki tīī. 3Jaakɔb jipɔŋkpiliu Rubeen jipɔmbi di sá Anɔki nì Palu nì Eesirɔn nì Kaarmii. 4Jooweel naantiibi di sá Seemaya nì Jooweel nì Gɔɔgi nì Simeeyii, 5nì Miika nì Raaya nì Baal, 6nì Baal jipɔɔn Beera. Beera nìn sá Rubeen naakookun yab kpiliu ubɔ ní Asuur bɔtiu Tiigilaati-Piilneeseer nìn cúú ki cūnnì kuyuŋu. 7Beera nabiyaamu ki nóó nì bi nín pēē pēē mmaal pu nì adican pu bi ŋmàn̄ bi-yiŋŋi ki bíl̀ee, upeekaa di sá Jeeyeel, ní ki páaǹ Seekariyawuu, 8ní ki páaǹ Asaasi jipɔɔn Beela. Beela sá Seema naantiiu nì Jooweel naantitɔntɔkɔl ní.
Rubeen yab nìn kóò kitiŋ kin dɔ̄ kí yòon̄ Arooweer tiŋki ŋgiil pú kí cáá sāā Neeboo jool nì Baal-Meeyɔn tiŋki ŋgan púee ní. 9Ŋwìiń nyalaŋki púee, bi nìn kóò kitiŋ kin dɔ̄ ki tin cáa sāā kuteeu kun yākatì bi nì Eefiraati mɔɔlee nín kífí púee ní, kun puee bi-waŋkuti nìn būtì Galaadi tiŋki pu tikpilku. 10Ubɔti Saayuul yuntiŋuee, bi nìn jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ Agaar maaliŋun yab ní ki fōō mpaan ki kāl̀ Galaadi tiŋki kin dɔ̄ ŋgan púee kɔkɔ.
Gaadi naantiibi
11Gaadi naakookun yab nìn kóò Rubeen yab tiŋki ŋgan pú ní, Baasan tiŋki kí tin cáá sāā Salka tiŋki. 12Baasan tiŋkin niinee, bi-kpiliu upeepeekaa di nìn sá Jooweel, uliliiti di sá Safan, ní ki páaǹ Jaanayi nì Safaati. 13Ki nóó nì bi nín pēē pēē mmaal puee, bi-nabiyaamu mun kíǹee kpilib di sá Miikayeel nì Meesulam nì Seeba nì Jooraayi nì Jakan nì Siiya nì Eebeer. Bi nìn nyáń binib biluli ní. 14Urii jipɔɔn Abiikayiil niboolii di sá bikpilib gbanti. Abiikayiil naanjab di sá Jaroowa nì Galaadi nì Miikayeel nì Jeesisaayi nì Jaadoo nì Buusi. 15Abidiyeel jipɔɔn nì Guuni naantiiu Akii di nìn sá Gaadi naakookun yab gbanti kɔkɔ kpiliu. 16Gaadi dicaŋkun yab nìn kóò Galaadi nì Baasan tiŋkpaammun ní. Bi nìn gíti kóò ntimu mun bí mu-taapuee nì Saarɔn naakpaapɔɔkun kí tin cáá sāā mu-kpaanyɔmmu.
17Bi nìn kàan̄ binib gbanti kɔkɔ ki ŋmàn̄ bi-yiŋŋi ki ŋá dikàandi gbɔŋkun ŋyunti ŋun Jootam nìn sá Juuda bɔtiu ní Jeerooboowaam sá Isirayeel bɔtiuee ní.
18Rubeen nì Gaadi naakɔtin yab nì Manasee naakooku dijandi diba yab sá bibaatandambi kutukub imuŋku ili nì binaa nì binib alaataa aluli nì imuŋku ita. Bi nìn cíkitì ki ŋūǹ kí já kujaau, kí ŋúb́ digbampɔɔl nì kitàataajiki kí tɔ̄ butɔbu. 19Bi nìn jáń nì Agrii yab nì Jeetuur nì Nafiisi nì Noodaab dicaŋŋi yab. 20Kujaau gbanti poonee, bi nìn dū bi-mákal ki páaǹ Unimbɔti pu ní ki mēē-u yii ú tūtuǹ-bi. Unimbɔti nìn fōō bi-wimmeem ní ki tútuǹ-bi. Míǹ ní bi nìn jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ Agrii yab nì bin nìn pá bi-boonee. 21Bi nìn cúú Agrii yab cee igutaamu kutukub imuŋku ili nì saalaa nì ipii nì iŋoobu kutukub alaataa ali nì imuŋku ili nì saalaa nì mmamu kutukub bili. Bi nìn cúú binib kutukub dilaataal mun kuyuŋu 22ní ki kūū binannanliibi tikpil. Di sá yii Unimbɔti di nìn līī bi-nyɔkɔpu ní bi jáń kujaau gbanti. Niinee ní bi gbíntì Agrii yab tiŋki gbantin ki kāl̀ ki dāa sāā ŋyunti ŋun bi dāa cúú Isirayeel yab ki cūnnì kuyuŋuee.
Manasee naantiibi bin kóòń Jɔɔdan buŋŋu ŋwìiń nyalaŋki púee
23Manasee naakooku dijandi diba yab nìn dɔ́miń ki kāl̀ kitiŋ kin dɔ̄ kí yòon̄ Baasan tiŋki ŋgiil pú kí cáá sāā Baal-Eermɔn tiŋki nì Seeniir nì Eermɔn jool ŋgan púee ní. 24Bi nín pēē pēē mmaal puee, bi-kpilib yiŋŋi di sá Eefeer nì Iseeyii nì Eeliyeel nì Asiriyeel nì Irimeeya nì Oodafiya nì Yaadiyeel. Bíǹ gbanti kɔkɔ nìn sá bibaatandambi nì bin nyáń diyindee ní.
25Ama Rubeen nì Gaadi naakɔtin yab nì Manasee naakooku dijandi din bí Jɔɔdan buŋŋu ŋwìiń nyalaŋki púee yab nìn fātì bi-boon ki tīī bi-naanjab Nimbɔtiu ní ki nìn bí ki tòotī atimbun ŋin nib Unimbɔti nìn jìn̄ ki nyántì ki wāatì-bi kitiŋee waaŋi. 26Niinee ní Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu sāal̀ Asuur bɔtiibi Puul nì Tiigilaati-Piilneeseer ní bíǹ dɔ́miń ki cúú-bi ki cūnnì Alaa nì Abɔɔr nì Ara timmun nì Goosan mɔɔl caŋin timmun kuyuŋu. Bi dáá gbíntìi bí niin ki dāa sāā díǹ.
Leefii naantiibi
27Leefii jipɔmbi di sá Geersɔn nì Keeyaati nì Meerarii. 28Keeyaati jipɔmbi di sá Amiiraam nì Isaar nì Eebrɔn nì Usiyeel. 29Amiiraam jipɔmbi di sá Aarɔn nì Mooyiisi ní u-bisal sá Miiriyam. Aarɔn jipɔmbi di sá Nadaab nì Abiyuu nì Eeleeyasaar nì Itamaar. 30Eeleeyasaar di màl̄ Piinaasi, ní Piinaasi màl̄ Abiisuwa, 31ní Abiisuwa màl̄ Bukii, ní Bukii màl̄ Usi, 32ní Usi màl̄ Seeraya, ní Seeraya màl̄ Meerayooti, 33ní Meerayooti màl̄ Amariya, ní Amariya màl̄ Ayiituub, 34ní Ayiituub màl̄ Saadooki, ní Sadooki màl̄ Ayiimaasi, 35ní Ayiimaasi màl̄ Asariya, ní Asariya màl̄ Yoowanan, 36ní Yoowanan màl̄ Asariya. Asariya gbanti di dāa kpántì usaraaŋakpil kunimbɔtidii kun Saloomɔn nìn máń Jeerusaleem tiŋkinee poon. 37Asariya di màl̄ Amariya, ní Amariya màl̄ Ayiituub, 38ní Ayiituub màl̄ Saadooki, ní Saadooki màl̄ Saluum, 39ní Saluum màl̄ Ilikiya, ní Ilikiya màl̄ Asariya, 40ní Asariya màl̄ Seeraya, ní Seeraya màl̄ Joosadaaki. 41Neebukadineesaar nìn cúú Joosadaaki ki cūnnì kuyuŋu ŋyunti ŋun ní ti-Dindaan nìn yāntì bi cúú Juuda yab nì Jeerusaleem yab ki cūnnì kuyuŋuee.

english_text:
The Descendants of Levi
1Levi was the father of Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
2Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. 3Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.
Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
4-14Eleazar's descendants included Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, Ahimaaz, Azariah, Johanan, Azariah the priest who served in the temple built by King Solomon, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, Shallum, Hilkiah, Azariah, Seraiah, and Jehozadak. 15King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
16 Levi's three sons had sons of their own. 17Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei. 18Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. 19Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
20-21Gershon's descendants included Libni, Jahath, Zimmah, Joah, Iddo, Zerah, and Jeatherai.
22-24Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
25Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth. 26-27Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
28Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
29-30Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah.
The Temple Musicians
31After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship. 32These musicians served at the sacred tent and later at the Lord's temple that King Solomon built.
33-38Here is a list of these musicians and their family lines:
Heman from the Kohathite clan was the director. His ancestors went all the way back to Jacob and included Joel, Samuel, Elkanah, Jeroham, Eliel, Toah, Zuph, Elkanah, Mahath, Amasai, Elkanah, Joel, Azariah, Zephaniah, Tahath, Assir, Ebiasaph, Korah, Izhar, Kohath, Levi.
39-43Asaph was Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Asaph's ancestors included Berechiah, Shimea, Michael, Baaseiah, Malchijah, Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah, Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei, Jahath, Gershon, and Levi.
44-47Ethan was also Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Ethan belonged to the Merari clan, and his ancestors included Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.
48The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent.
The Descendants of Aaron
49Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
50-53Aaron's descendants included his son Eleazar, Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, and Ahimaaz.
The Towns for the Levites
(Joshua 21.1-42)
54Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in. 55They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it. 56But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh. 57-59So Aaron's descendants received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Hebron, Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth-Shemesh. 60From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
61The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
62The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
63The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
64So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them. 65All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
66Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim. 67-69These families received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Shechem in the hill country, Gezer, Jokmeam, Beth-Horon, Aijalon, and Gath-Rimmon. 70And from West Manasseh they received Aner and Bileam, together with their pastureland.
71The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them. 72-73The Gershonites also received four towns from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh, Daberath, Ramoth, and Anem, including the pastureland around them. 74-75The Gershonites received four towns from the tribe of Asher: Mashal, Abdon, Hukok, and Rehob, including the pastureland around them. 76Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
77The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun. 78-79They also received four towns east of the Jordan River from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the flatlands, Jahzah, Kedemoth, and Mephaath, including the pastures around them. 80-81And from the tribe of Gad the Merarites received the towns of Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim, Heshbon, and Jazer, including the pastureland around them.
translation_text:
Leefii naantiibi bin kíǹee
1Leefii jipɔmbi di sá Geersɔm nì Keeyaati nì Meerarii. 2Geersɔm jipɔmbi di sá Liibinii nì Simeeyii. 3Keeyaati jipɔmbi di sá Amiiraam nì Isaar nì Eebrɔn nì Usiyeel. 4Meerarii jipɔmbi di sá Maalii nì Musii. Leefii naakookun yab naanjab yiŋŋi dee, ki nóó nì bi nín pēē pēē mmaal puee.
5Geersɔm niboolii di sá u-jipɔɔn Liibinii nì u-naantiibi Jaati nì Siimina, 6nì Joowa nì Idoo nì Seera nì Jootiraayi.
7Keeyaati niboolii di sá u-jipɔɔn Amiinadaab nì u-naantiibi Koora nì Asiir, 8nì Eelkana nì Eebiyasaafi nì Asiir, 9nì Taati nì Uriyeel nì Usiya nì Saawuul.
10Eelkana jipɔmbi biba mun di sá Amasaayi nì Ayiimooti, 11nì Eelkana. Eelkana naantiibi di sá Soofaayi nì Naati, 12nì Eeliyaab nì Jeeroowaam nì Eelkana. 13Samiyeel jipɔŋkpiliu di sá Jooweel, ní u-jipɔnliliitiu sá Abiiya. 14Meerarii niboolii di sá u-jipɔɔn Maalii nì u-naantiibi Liibinii nì Simeeyii nì Usa, 15nì Siima nì Agiiya nì Asaaya.
16Daafiidi nìn lēē Leefii naantiibi biba bí nīn bí dilaŋgaal tundin ti-Dindaan Diikun, ŋyunti ŋun bi nìn cáań Dipoondi Dakaau ki kɔ́ǹ ki síiǹ niinee. 17Kí wàatī Saloomɔn ń mā Unimbɔti diiku Jeerusaleem tiŋkinee, binib gbanti di nìn pée yūlifí circir kɔŋkooŋŋu nyɔkɔpu ki gà ilan, ki nóó nì marab bin bi nìn síiǹ-bee. 18Binib bin bi nìn lēē bí nīn bí dilaŋgaal tundi gbantinee nì bi-jipɔmbi yiŋŋi sɔ̀.
Keeyaati maaliŋu poonee, ulaŋgaakpil di sá Jooweel jipɔɔn Eeman. U-naanjab di sá Samiyeel, 19nì Eelkana nì Jeeroowaam nì Eeliyeel nì Toowa, 20nì Suufi nì Eelkana nì Maati nì Amasaayi, 21nì Eelkana nì Jooweel nì Asariya nì Seefaniya, 22nì Taati nì Asiir nì Abiyasafi nì Koora, 23nì Isaar nì Keeyaati nì Leefii nì Jaakɔb.
24Eeman nabiki kin yūlifí u-ŋaŋgiil pú bi gà ilanee di sá Beereekiya jipɔɔn Asaafi. Úǹ naanjab di sá Simeeya, 25nì Miikayeel nì Baseeya nì Maalkiya, 26nì Eetinii nì Seera nì Adaaya, 27nì Eetan nì Siima nì Simeeyii, 28nì Yaati nì Geersɔm nì Leefii.
29Bi-nabiyaamu Meerarii maaliŋun yab di yūlifí bi-ŋaŋgan pú ki gà ilan. Bi-laŋgaakpiliu di sá Kiisi jipɔɔn Eetan. Eetan naanjab di sá Abidii nì Maluuki, 30nì Asabiya nì Amasiya nì Ilikiya, 31nì Amisii nì Banii nì Seemeer, 32nì Maalii nì Musii nì Meerarii nì Leefii.
33Bi-nabiyaamu Leefii naakookun yab bin kíǹee di tūǹ atuun ŋin kɔkɔ sá bí tɔ̄ circir kɔŋkooŋŋun, Unimbɔti diikunee.
34Aarɔn nì u-dicaŋkun yab tundi di nìn sá bí nīn ŋáań saraabi saraawɔkaa faŋŋu pu, ki tùutī talaalutuukaa talaalu saraafaŋŋu pu. Bíǹ di nìn kpèé tin kɔkɔ bi nìn dūu sú Unimbɔtee. Bi nìn tí ŋáań ikpiti pɔ̄tam koobiliŋ nín sá puee Isirayeel yab yil pu ki nóó nì Unimbɔti tɔntɔnliu Mooyiisi nín yóoǹ yii bí nīn ŋáań puee. 35Aarɔn dicaŋkun yab di sá u-jipɔɔn Eeleeyasaar nì u-naantiibi Piinaasi nì Abiisuwa, 36nì Bukii nì Usii nì Seeraya, 37nì Meerayooti nì Amaariya nì Ayiituub, 38nì Saadooki nì Ayiimaasi.
Ntimu mun bi nìn tīī Leefii yabee
39Ntimu mun bi nìn tīī Aarɔn naantiibi bin sá Keeyaati maaliŋun bí nīn kóòyee sèé. Bi nín nìn tɔ́ kasi kí yàkatī ntimuee, Keeyaati maaliŋun yab gbanti yiŋŋi di nìn péé péé ki nyáń. 40Bi nìn tīī-bi Juuda tiŋki Eebrɔn nì kupikpaapɔɔu kun nìn māntìi tú-kèe kɔkɔ. 41Ama ní ki dū Eebrɔn sati nì ntimbilimu mun bí ki-taapuee ki tīī Jeefunee jipɔɔn Kaleeb. 42Ntimu mun bi nìn tīī Aarɔn naantiibi án nīn sá-bi ntimu mun unil yaa kaa nyí ki kūū u-juti ú sāǹ kí kɔ́ee di sá Eebrɔn tiŋki nì Liibina tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Jatiir tiŋki, nì Eesiteemoowa tiŋki nì ki-sati, 43nì Ileesi tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Deebiir tiŋki nì ki-sati, 44nì Asaan tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Beeti-Seemeesi tiŋki nì ki-sati. 45Bi nìn lēē Beenjameen naakookun yab tinjandi pu ntimu ki kútì-bi. Ntimu gbanti di sá Geeba tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Aleemeeti tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Anatooti tiŋki nì ki-sati. Bi nín pēē pēē mmaal puee, ntimu mun bi nìn tīī-bee nìn nyáń saalaa nì muta ní.
46Bi nìn gíti tɔ́ kasi ní Keeyaati maaliŋun yab bin kíǹee fōō ntimu saalaa Eefiraayiim nì Daani naakɔti nì Manasee naakooku dijandi din bí ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki púee yab timmu poon. 47Bi nìn lēē Isakaar nì Aseer nì Neefitalii naakɔtin nì Manasee naakookun yab dijandi din nìn kóò Baasan tiŋkinee poon ntimu saalaa nì muta ki tīī Geersɔm naantiibi. 48Bi gíti tɔ́ kasi ní ki lēē Rubeen nì Gaadi nì Sabulɔn naakɔti yab tinjaŋŋi poon ntimu saalaa nì muli ki tīī Meerarii naantiibi. 49Isirayeel yab nìn dū ntimu gbanti ki kpáaǹ mu-sati kɔkɔ ki tīī Leefii yab. 50Bi nìn tɔ́ kasi ní ki lēē Juuda nì Simeeyɔn nì Beenjameen naakɔtin yab timmu mun bɔti ti sòon̄ee ki tīī Leefii yab.
51Eefiraayiim naakookun yab tinjandi poon ní bi nìn lēē ntimu ki tīī Keeyaati maaliŋun yab bin kíǹee. 52Ntimu mun poon unil yaa kaa nyí ní kūū u-juti u ŋūǹ kí sāǹ kí kɔ́ee, mun bi nìn tīī-bee di sá Siikeem tiŋki kin bí Eefiraayiim jool puee nì ki-sati, nì Geeseer tiŋki nì ki-sati, 53nì Yɔkineeyam tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Beeti-Oorɔn tiŋki nì ki-sati, 54nì Ayalɔn tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Gaati-Riimɔn tiŋki nì ki-sati. 55Manasee naakooku dijandi din bí ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki púee tinjandi poonee, bi nìn tīī-bi Aneer tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Biileeyam tiŋki nì ki-sati.
56Manasee naakooku dijandi din bí Jɔɔdan buŋŋu ŋwìiń nyalaŋki púee tinjandi poonee, bi nìn tīī Geersɔm maaliŋun yab Goolan tiŋki kin bí Baasan tiŋkinee nì ki-sati, nì Asitarooti tiŋki nì ki-sati. 57Isakaar naakookun yab tinjandi poonee, bi nìn tīī-bi Keedeesi tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Dabeerati tiŋki nì ki-sati, 58nì Ramooti tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Aneem tiŋki nì ki-sati. 59Aseer naakookun yab tinjandi poonee, bi nìn tīī-bi Masaal tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Abidɔn tiŋki nì ki-sati, 60nì Ukooki tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Reewoob tiŋki nì ki-sati. 61Neefitalii naakookun yab tinjandi poonee, bi tīī-bi Keedeesi tiŋki kin bí Galiilee tiŋkinee nì ki-sati, nì Amɔn tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Kiiriyatayiim tiŋki nì ki-sati.
62Sabulɔn naakookun yab tinjandi poonee, bi nìn tīī Meerarii maaliŋun yab bin kíǹee Riimoonoo tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Tabɔɔr tiŋki nì ki-sati. 63Jɔɔdan buŋŋu ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú, Jeeriikoo tiŋki caŋinee, bi nìn tīī-bi Rubeen naakooku yab tinjandi poon Beeseer tiŋki kin bí kuteeunee nì ki-sati, nì Yaasa tiŋki nì ki-sati, 64nì Keedeemooti tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Meefaati tiŋki nì ki-sati. 65Gaadi naakookun yab tinjandi poonee, bi nìn tīī-bi Ramooti tiŋki kin bí Galaadi tiŋkinee nì ki-sati, nì Maanayiim tiŋki nì ki-sati, 66nì Eesbɔn tiŋki nì ki-sati, nì Jaseer tiŋki nì ki-sati.

english_text:
The Descendants of Issachar
1Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
2Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were 22,600 people in Tola's family by the time David became king.
3Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders. 4Their families were so large that they had 36,000 soldiers in their clans. 5In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of 87,000 warriors.
The Descendants of Benjamin and Dan
6Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
7Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was 22,034.
8Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. 9The official family records listed 20,200 soldiers in the families of this clan, as well as their family leaders.
10Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar. 11They were family leaders in their clan, which had 17,200 soldiers prepared to fight in battle. 12Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan.
Dan was the father of Hushim.
The Descendants of Naphtali
13Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum.
The Descendants of Manasseh
14Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead. 15Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah.
Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
16Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem. 17Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
18Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
19Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
The Descendants of Ephraim
20Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath, 21Zabad, and Shuthelah.
Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath. 22Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him. 23Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
24Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
25Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan, 26Ladan, Ammihud, Elishama, 27Nun, and Joshua.
28The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
29The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages.
The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages.
The Descendants of Asher
30Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
31Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith. 32Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua. 33Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. 34Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram. 35And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal. 36Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah, 37Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera. 38Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
39Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
40These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of 26,000 soldiers.
translation_text:
Isakaar naakookun yab
1Isakaar nìn cáá jipɔmbi binaa ní. Bíǹ di sá Toola nì Puuwa nì Jasuub nì Simroon. 2Toola jipɔmbi di sá Usii nì Reefaya nì Jeeriyeel nì Yaamayi nì Yibisam nì Seemiyeel. Bíǹ di sá Toola maaliŋun dicaŋŋi kpilib, ní ki nìn sá bibaatandambi bi-dicaŋŋi poon. Ubɔti Daafiidi yuntiŋuee, Toola maaliŋun yab gbanti nìn sá binib kutukub mmuŋku nì bili nì binib alaataa aluu ní. 3Usii jipɔɔn di sá Isiraya ní Isiraya jipɔmbi sá Miikayeel nì Oobadiya nì Jooweel nì Isiya. Bi-ŋmootil nìn sá adican kpilib ní. 4Bi-dicaŋkun yab nìn cáá binimpoobi nì jipɔmbi tikpil. An puee, an nìn sá bí tīī binib kutukub mmuŋku nì saalaa nì biluu bin bàn̄ kí cù kujaauee.
5Bi nín kàan̄ Isakaar naakookun yab bin sá bibaatandambee, bi nìn nyáń binib kutukub imuŋku inaa nì biluli ní.
Beenjameen nì Neefitalii naakɔtin yab
6Beenjameen nìn cáá jipɔmbi bita ní. Bíǹ di sá Beela nì Beekeer nì Yeediyeel. 7Beela naantiibi di sá Eesbɔn nì Usii nì Usiyeel nì Yeereemooti nì Irii. Bibaatandambi gbanti kɔkɔ nìn sá bi-dicaŋŋi kpilib ní.
