11u nyí unil landɔkɔi kɔkɔ!
U nyí i nín kaa bí tibanee.
12Ti-Dindaan, unil un tafal a dátí,
ki cáá a-marab ki dàkà-uee bí mmɔnneeee!
13Dinimbinaamandi yuntiŋuee, a yàntī u bí ŋgbansɔŋfin,
ki cí bí gbà mbòó kí cīití binikpitib.
14Di sá yii ti-Dindaan kaa dù u-nibul kí fá,
waa fàtī u-boon kí tīī bin sá u-yabee.
15Bi làá dāá fàtīí sòoǹ binib bɔti nì ibaamɔn,
ní bin kɔkɔ pɔbil bí dibee ń dāá kíí míǹ.
16Ŋma di làá sòoǹ m-bɔti bikpitib nee cee kí tīī-mi?
Ŋma di làá mɔ̄tì m-pu bikpitiŋaliibi nee cee?
17Ti-Dindaan yaa kaa bàà jòoń-mi,
an bàà kíǹ fiii m-naŋki ń kɔ́ diŋmiŋŋmidikil tiŋkin.
18M yaa bí yii: «M-taaŋi bíi yɔ̀tēe»,
ní sii ti-Dindaan neeŋkpaandi ń tíkiń-mi.
19Ilandɔkɔ yaa bàà wíiǹ m-ni ki nyīŋfì m-puee,
ní á ŋméeǹ-mi kí tīī-mi dipɔɔsɔŋkil.
20Sii nì bibɔsoonliibi binikpitib nee ŋá mpèéee?
Bíǹ bin nāantí falaa kaa dū mara ki yíiń tibee.
21Bi kpáfí kinyɔkɔ ki lèekī deedeedaan maŋfal,
ki sòoǹ maanyiiba bɔti ki kù-u.
22Ama ti-Dindaan di nìn kpántì m-balilaŋki.
M-Nimbɔtiu di nìn sá kutaŋkpanaakoou
kun m sáǹ ki kɔ́ee.
23U yāntì bi-kpitii gítì bi-pu,
u dū bi-kpitii ki nāaǹ-bi.
Ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu di nāaǹ-bi.

english_text:
Worship and Obey the Lord
1Sing joyful songs to the Lord!
Praise the mighty rock
where we are safe.
2Come to worship him
with thankful hearts
and songs of praise.
3The Lord is the greatest God,
king over all other gods.
4He holds the deepest part
of the earth in his hands,
and the mountain peaks
also belong to him.
5The ocean is the Lord's
because he made it,
and with his own hands
he formed the dry land.
6Bow down and worship
the Lord our Creator!
7 The Lord is our God,
and we are his people,
the sheep he takes care of
in his own pasture.
Listen to God's voice today!
8 Don't be stubborn and rebel
as your ancestors did
at Meribah and Massah
out in the desert.
9For forty years
they tested God and saw
the things he did.
10Then God got tired of them
and said,
“You never show good sense,
and you don't understand
what I want you to do.”
11 In his anger, God told them,
“You people will never enter
my place of rest.”
translation_text:
Dāam̄maan tí cùú nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan
1Dāam̄maan tí cùú nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan,
tí fáámaan iwiliili kí dàntì
kutaŋkpanaakoou kun fìil̄-tee.
2Tí cùmaan u-nimbiin kí jāam̀-u,
tí gāāmaan ilan nì dipɔɔpindi kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u.
3Di sá yii ti-Dindaan di sá Unimbɔtikpaan,
úǹ di sá ubɔtikpaan un tɔ́kɔ́ inimbɔti kɔkɔ puee.
4Kitiŋ taapu taapu kā u-ŋaan ní,
úǹ di tí yì ajoon yilpu kúnti kunti.
5Úǹ di tí yì tiŋku, di sá yii úǹ di náań-u,
ní ki yì kitiŋ kin ní u dū u-ŋal ki máńee.
6Dāam̄maan, tí bòom̄maan kí gbàan̄ kí jāam̀-u,
tí gbàam̄maan ti-tabiŋyiliŋ pu
ti-Dindaan un náań-tee nimbiin.
7Di sá yii úǹ di sá ti-Nimbɔtiu,
ní timbi sá dinibul din u kpàáyee,
kupicaŋkpuŋu kun u kpòotēe.
Díǹ nee, ni yaa gbìl̄ tin u sòon̄ee,
8ní taa ŋá mpɔɔgbifin kii ni nín nìn ŋá pu Meeriibayee,
a lì kii tin nìn jítì Maasa, kuteeunee.
9Ni-naanjab nìn kpákáǹ-mi ki nìn cɔ́ŋkì-mi niin,
min kamaa bin nìn ká tin m ŋée.
10Abin imuŋku ilee, binib gbanti nìn yāntì m-naŋki nyáń nì bi,
ní m nìn bí yii: «An sá dinibul din yiliŋ gáatèe ní,
baa nyí kun m lèe.»
11Niinee, m-ŋuul poonee ní m pūtì ki lī yii:
«Bi kpá kí kɔ́ m-ŋuŋfil laŋki!»

english_text:
Sing a New Song to the Lord
1Sing a new song to the Lord!
Everyone on this earth,
sing praises to the Lord,
2sing and praise his name.
Day after day announce,
“The Lord has saved us!”
3Tell every nation on earth,
“The Lord is wonderful
and does marvelous things!
4The Lord is great and deserves
our greatest praise!
He is the only God
worthy of our worship.
5Other nations worship idols,
but the Lord created
the heavens.
6Give honor and praise
to the Lord,
whose power and beauty
fill his holy temple.”
7 Tell everyone of every nation,
“Praise the glorious power
of the Lord.
8He is wonderful! Praise him
and bring an offering
into his temple.
9Everyone on earth, now tremble
and worship the Lord,
majestic and holy.”
10Announce to the nations,
“The Lord is King!
The world stands firm,
never to be shaken,
and he will judge its people
with fairness.”
11Tell the heavens and the earth
to be glad and celebrate!
Command the ocean to roar
with all its creatures
12and the fields to rejoice
with all their crops.
Then every tree in the forest
will sing joyful songs
13to the Lord.
He is coming to judge
all people on earth
with fairness and truth.
translation_text:
Gāāmaan nlampɔɔn kí pàkà ti-Dindaan
(Kpèè 1 Kroo 16.23-33)
1Gāāmaan nlampɔɔn kí pàkà ti-Dindaan,
duulinya kɔkɔ nib, gāāmaan ilan kí pàkà ti-Dindaan.
2Gāāmaan ilan kí pàkà ti-Dindaan,
ní nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan u-yindi.
Ní nīn sòoǹ u-fiil pu ŋwiin kamaa.
3Ní māafìmaan u-nyooti atimbun poon,
kí māafì maamaacib bin u ŋáaǹee anibul kɔkɔ poon.
4Di sá ti-Dindaan sá ukpaan ní ki máaǹ inyɔŋki,
úǹ di sá kuwambiiu ki jítiǹ inimbɔti kɔkɔ.
5Anibul ŋin kíǹee nimbɔtii kɔkɔ sá fám ní,
ama ti-Dindaan di náań yilpu.
6Tinyool nì jilma bí u-nimbiin,
mpɔn nì kunyaaŋŋu gbí u-kɔŋkooŋŋun.
7Kitiŋ pu nibuliŋ, tīīmaan ti-Dindaan
u-nyooti kí sòoǹ u-pɔŋŋu pu.
8Tīīmaan ti-Dindaan u-yindi nyooti,
ní cáaḿmaan ni-saraabi, ní kɔ́maan u-cindin.
9Bòom̄maan taapu ti-Dindaan nimbiin,
ŋyunti ŋun ní u yaa lēē u nín bí circir puee ki dàkēe.
Nín̄ jìkìmaan nì tifaandi u-nimbiin, kitiŋ pu nib kɔkɔ.
10Tùkùmaan atimbun nib kɔkɔ yii: «Ti-Dindaan jīǹ dibeel,
duulinya bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄, kaa cìŋkī.
U sòoǹ anibul bɔti nì ibaamɔn ní.»
11Yilpu ń nīn fàal̀, kitiŋ ń nīn bí dipɔɔpindin,
tiŋku ń nīn gà kuwoou, ki kpáaǹ tin kɔkɔ bí u-poonee!
12Tisati ń nīn fàal̀ ki kpáaǹ tin kɔkɔ bí ti-poonee!
Isufi in yú kubambaŋŋunee ń nīn kūuntí nì dipɔɔpindi
13ti-Dindaan nimbiin. Di sá yii u dòoń,
u dòoń kí dāá sòoǹ kitiŋ pu nib bɔti.
U làá dū deedee kí sòoǹ duulinya bɔti,
kí dū u-baamɔŋyi kí sòoǹ anibul bɔti.

english_text:
The Lord Brings Justice
1The Lord is King!
Tell the earth to celebrate
and all islands to shout.
2Dark clouds surround him,
and his throne is supported
by justice and fairness.
3Fire leaps from his throne,
destroying his enemies,
4and his lightning is so bright
that the earth sees it
and trembles.
5Mountains melt away like wax
in the presence of the Lord
of all the earth.
6The heavens announce,
“The Lord brings justice!”
Everyone sees God's glory.
7Those who brag about
the useless idols they worship
are terribly ashamed,
and all the false gods
bow down to the Lord.
8When the people of Zion
and of the towns of Judah
hear that God brings justice,
they will celebrate.
9The Lord rules the whole earth,
and he is more glorious
than all the false gods.
10Love the Lord
and hate evil!
God protects his loyal people
and rescues them
from violence.
11If you obey and do right,
a light will show you the way
and fill you with happiness.
12You are the Lord's people!
So celebrate and praise
the only God.
translation_text:
Ti-Dindaan sá ubɔti, kitiŋ pu nib kɔkɔ ń nīn fàal̀
1Ti-Dindaan sá ubɔti,
kitiŋ pu nib kɔkɔ ń nīn fàal̀,
bin kóò ntimu mun kɔkɔ nnyim
māntìi túee poonee ń nīn bí mmɔnni!
2Ditagbandi nì dibɔmbɔndi māntìi tú-u.
U-beejal tɔ́kɔ́ deedee nì tin tèen̄ee pu ní.
3Ŋŋmi līī u-nyɔkɔpu,
ní ki wù u-nannanliibi bin māntìi tú-uee.
4U yàntī itaaŋmɔŋmɔ ŋmíntí duulinya pu,
kitiŋ kāntí-i ní ki jìkì nì tifaandi.
5Ajoon dùntī kii nsikampimuee
kitiŋ kɔkɔ Dindaan nimbiin.
6Yilpu sòoǹ u-deedeeu pu,
ní anibul kɔkɔ kāntí u-nyooti.
7Icoo ń cúú bin kɔkɔ tòotī awaayee,
bin nyɔ́ŋkí awaa ŋin kaa bí tibanee!
Inimbɔti kɔkɔ, gbàam̄maan ti-Dindaan nimbiin.
8 Siiyɔn yab gbìl̄ ní an mɔ́ɔkiǹ-bi.
Ti-Dindaan, a-bɔsooŋyi puee,
Juuda timmu bíi fàal̀.
9Di sá yii sii ti-Dindaan,
Yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu un kpòotī kitiŋ kɔkɔee,
sii di tɔ́kɔ́ inimbɔti kɔkɔ pu.
10Nimbi bin néeń ti-Dindaanee, nín̄ námaan ikpiti.
Ti-Dindaan wúǹ u-deedeedambi maŋfal pu,
u fìil̄-bi ki nyāntí binikpitib ŋaan.
11Ŋwalifi ŋmíntí deedeedambi,
ní bin pɔbil bí diba nì Unimbɔtee fàal̀.
12Deedeedambi, ti-Dindaan puee, nín̄ fàal̀maan,
ní kí nīn nyɔ́ŋkí u-circir yindi.

english_text:
The Lord Works Miracles
1Sing a new song to the Lord!
He has worked miracles,
and with his own powerful arm,
he has won the victory.
2The Lord has shown the nations
that he has the power to save
and to bring justice.
3God has been faithful
in his love for Israel,
and his saving power is seen
everywhere on earth.
4Tell everyone on this earth
to sing happy songs
in praise of the Lord.
5Make music for him on harps.
Play beautiful melodies!
6Sound the trumpets and horns
and celebrate with joyful songs
for our Lord and King!
7Command the ocean to roar
with all its creatures,
and the earth to shout
with all its people.
8Order the rivers
to clap their hands,
and all the hills
to sing together.
9Let them worship the Lord!
He is coming to judge
everyone on the earth,
and he will be honest
and fair.
translation_text:
Tí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan un dòońee
1Inyɔŋki laŋŋu.
Gāāmaan nlampɔɔn kí pàkà ti-Dindaan,
di sá yii u ŋáań maamaacib.
U-ŋaŋgiil, u-ŋal ŋun bí circiree yāntì u jáń ki jíń.
2Ti-Dindaan dàkā yii u sá u-fiil,
u lēē u nín bí deedee puee ki dàkā atimbun kɔkɔ.
3U téetì u-neeŋkpaandi nì u-deedeeu
un u cáá Isirayeel yab puee pu.
Kí cáá sāā kitiŋ gbeennyɔkɔee,
bi ká ti-Nimbɔtiu fiil.
4Kitiŋ pu nib kɔkɔ, fáámaan iwiliili kí dàntì ti-Dindaan,
gāāmaan ilan mpɔn nì dipɔɔpindi kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u.
5Bɔ̀ɔ̀maan kubeeu kí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan,
bɔ̀ɔ̀maan kubeeu kí gāā ilan kí kìntī.
6Ní búḿmaan akantán nì iyin kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u,
ní fáámaan iwiliili kí dàntì ti-Dindaan, ubɔti.
7Tiŋku ń nīn gà kuwoou, ki kpáaǹ tin kɔkɔ bí u-poonee!
Kitiŋ nì tin kɔkɔ bí ki-puee mun ń gāā kuwoou.
8Ibun ń kpāafì abaal,
ajoon ń kpāfì dicilpuee kí gāā ilan nì dipɔɔpindi
9ti-Dindaan nimbiin. Di sá yii u dòoń
kí sòoǹ kitiŋ pu nib bɔti.
U làá sòoǹ duulinya bɔti nì ibaamɔn,
ní kí sòoǹ anibul bɔti deedee.

english_text:
Our Lord Is King
1 Our Lord, you are King!
You rule from your throne
above the winged creatures,
as people tremble
and the earth shakes.
2You are praised in Zion,
and you control all nations.
3Only you are God!
And your power alone,
so great and fearsome,
is worthy of praise.
4You are our mighty King,
a lover of fairness,
who sees that justice is done
everywhere in Israel.
5Our Lord and our God,
we praise you
and kneel down to worship you,
the God of holiness!
6Moses and Aaron were two
of your priests.
Samuel was also one of those
who prayed in your name,
and you, our Lord,
answered their prayers.
7 You spoke to them
from a thick cloud,
and they obeyed your laws.
8Our Lord and our God,
you answered their prayers
and forgave their sins,
but when they did wrong,
you punished them.
9We praise you, Lord God,
and we worship you
at your sacred mountain.
Only you are God!
translation_text:
Ti-Dindaan sá ubɔti, úǹ baba di sá Unimbɔtibaamɔn
1Ti-Dindaan di sá ubɔti,
anibul ń nīn jìkì nì tifaandi!
U kā u-beejal din tɔ́kɔ́ keerubimbi puee,
kitiŋ ń cìŋkì!
2Ti-Dindaan sá ukpaan Siiyɔn tiŋkin,
- ní ki tɔ́kɔ́ anibul kɔkɔ pu.
3Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì a-yiŋkpaandi din cáá tifaandee!
- Dì sá circir yindi ní!
4Kun tìì ubɔti mpɔnee di sá ú nīn néeń ibaamɔn.
Sii di yóoǹ marab bin tèen̄ee.
Sii di ŋá tin bí deedee nì tin tèen̄ee Isirayeel tiŋkin.
5Ní nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu,
ní gbàam̄maan u-beejal taapu!
- U sá circirdaan ní.
6Mooyiisi nì Aarɔn bin nìn sá u-saraaŋaliibi kansikin bibee,
nì Samiyeel un nìn sá bin yíì u-yindee kansikin ubɔee,
nìn yíì ti-Dindaan ní u nìn kíikí-bi.
7Unimbɔti nìn sòoǹ nì bi ditagbancancaal poon.
Bi nìn ŋúb́ u-bɔkpaaŋi,
nì marab bin u nìn tīī-bee.
8Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti, sii a-ba di nìn kíikí-bi.
A nìn sá Unimbɔti un jīǹ bi-pu kimɔtiiyee,
ama a nìn dátí bi-tafal bi-yìntitam pu.
9Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu.
Gbàam̄maan kí túĺ u-circir jool.
- Di sá yii ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu sá circirdaan ní.

english_text:
(A psalm of praise.)
The Lord Is God
1Shout praises to the Lord,
everyone on this earth.
2Be joyful and sing
as you come in
to worship the Lord!
3You know the Lord is God!
He created us,
and we belong to him;
we are his people,
the sheep in his pasture.
4Be thankful and praise the Lord
as you enter his temple.
5 The Lord is good!
His love and faithfulness
will last forever.
translation_text:
Ti sá u-nibul
1Ijaam saraau laŋŋu.
Kitiŋ kɔkɔ nib, ní fáámaan iwiliili kí dàntì ti-Dindaan.
2Jāam̀maan-u nì ifaal,
dāam̄maan u-nimbiin nì dipɔɔpindi.
3Béémaan yii ti-Dindaan di sá Unimbɔti,
úǹ di náań-ti ní ki yì-ti.
Ti sá u-nibul nì kupicaŋkpuŋu kun u kpàáyee.
4Ní dīmaan u-diiku punyɔmmu kí kɔ́ kí nīn jáaḿ-u,
ní kɔ́ u-cindin kí nīn nyɔ́ŋkí-u.
Ní nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u, ní pàkàmaan u-yindi.
5Di sá yii ti-Dindaan ŋān̄,
u-neeŋkpaandi bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan,
ní u-baamɔŋyi bí kí nīn cá abin abin.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A King and His Promises
1I will sing to you, Lord!
I will celebrate your kindness
and your justice.
2Please help me learn
to do the right thing,
and I will be honest and fair
in my own kingdom.
3I refuse to be corrupt
or to take part
in anything crooked,
4and I won't be dishonest
or deceitful.
5Anyone who spreads gossip
will be silenced;
no one who is conceited
will be my friend.
6I will find trustworthy people
to serve as my advisors;
only an honest person
will serve as an official.
7No one who cheats or lies
will have a position
in my royal court.
8Each morning I will silence
any lawbreakers I find
in the countryside
or in the city of the Lord.
translation_text:
Ubɔti pōoǹ Unimbɔti nimbiin kí nīn tɔ́ u-marab
1Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee.
M làá gāā ilan a-neeŋkpaandi nì a-deedeeu pu.
Sii ti-Dindaan ní m làá gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì.
2M làá nóó deedeedambi saŋŋu.
Ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní a làá dāan̄ m-cee ní?
- M làá nīn bí nì dipɔbil diba m-dicaŋkun.
3Maa là tiwan tin kaa bí tibanee.
M ná bin fātì bi-boon ki tīī Unimbɔtee tuuŋŋi,
atuun gbanti kpá kí dáb́-mi.
4Biibiidambi làá nīn dátiǹ-mi,
maa là kí béé ukpitiŋal gba.
5Bin cāab̀ bi-jutiibi disambiil dibalinee,
m làá nàan̄-bi.
Bilambidambi nì bin yòontí bi-ba yilpuee,
maa gèetíǹ-bi.
6M-nimbikpeeŋu làá nīn cɔ́ kitiŋ nee baamɔndambi pu,
ní bí nīn kàal̀ ki kɔ́l̀-mi.
Un còom̄ deedeedambi saŋkindee
di làá nīn bí m-tundin.
7Un mùul̄ u-jutee kaa làá nīn cáá mpaan m-dicaŋkun.
M-nimbil kaa là kí wāl̀ un sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔtee.
8Kutaafaau kamaayee, m làá nīn nàantí
binikpitib bin kɔkɔ bí kitiŋ nee puee,
kí kúntí bikpitiŋaliibi kɔkɔ ti-Dindaan tiŋkin.

english_text:
(A prayer for someone who hurts and needs to ask the Lord for help.)
A Prayer in Time of Trouble
1I pray to you, Lord!
Please listen.
2Don't hide from me
in my time of trouble.
Pay attention to my prayer
and quickly give an answer.
3My days disappear like smoke,
and my bones are burning
as though in a furnace.
4I am wasting away like grass,
and my appetite is gone.
5My groaning never stops,
and my bones can be seen
through my skin.
6I am like a lonely owl
in the desert
7or a restless sparrow
alone on a roof.
8My enemies insult me all day,
and they use my name
for a curse word.
9Instead of food,
I have ashes to eat
and tears to drink,
10because you are furious
and have thrown me aside.
11My life fades like a shadow
at the end of day
and withers like grass.
12Our Lord, you are King forever
and will always be famous.
13You will show pity to Zion
because the time has come.
14We, your servants,
love each stone in the city,
and we are sad to see them
lying in the dirt.
15Our Lord, the nations
will honor you,
and all kings on earth
will praise your glory.
16You will rebuild
the city of Zion.
Your glory will be seen,
17and the prayers of the homeless
will be answered.
18Future generations must also
praise the Lord,
so write this for them:
19“From his holy temple,
the Lord looked down
at the earth.
20He listened to the groans
of prisoners,
and he rescued everyone
who was doomed to die.”
21All Jerusalem should praise
you, our Lord,
22when people from every nation
meet to worship you.
23I should still be strong,
but you, Lord, have made
an old person of me.
24You will live forever!
Years mean nothing to you.
Don't cut my life in half!
25 In the beginning, Lord,
you laid the earth's foundation
and created the heavens.
26They will all disappear
and wear out like clothes.
You change them,
as you would a coat,
but you last forever.
27You are always the same.
You are God for all time.
28Every generation of those
who serve you
will live in your presence.
translation_text:
Dinimbinaamandi nì dimákal
1Ufalaadaan un kaa ti cáá mpɔn ní ki tíminsí ti-Dindaan nimbiinee wimmeem.
2Ti-Dindaan, pīlifì m-wimmeem,
yàntī m-biilii ń bàń-si.
3Á taa fàtī a-boon kí tīī-mi
dinimbinaamandi wiiŋŋu dal.
Kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifiǹ-mi.
Daliŋkin m yaa yíiń-see,
á kíí-mi malaa.
4M-maŋfal wiiŋyi bíi jītí kii nnyiimee,
m-kpabiŋ bíi wù kii amɔsiŋkoonee.
5M-pɔbil bíi kōō kii kumoou kun bi gāāyee,
m súntí kí jī m-jinti gba.
6Aniim ŋin m fátée puee,
m dúntìi kíǹ akpab ŋma ní.
7Man nì kuteeun tulinjool di kíǹ ki náań,
m bí kii kitulinjakpatibooi kin bí adigbuŋkatinee ní.
8Ŋgeem kaa ti bí-mi,
m kpántì kii unoon un tɔ́kɔ́ kudii yilpu u-babee ní.
9M-nannanliibi sìí-mi ní baabadal,
bi bèel̄-mi ní ki cáá m-yindi ki tòó binib mbusu.
10Ŋfantam di kpántì m-jinti,
nyinnyim ní m cáa ŋmàlintí m-nyɔkaatin.
11A-ŋuul nì a-bum poonee,
a dúkutì-mi ki tɔ́ ki fá ndandati.
12M-maŋfal wiiŋyi bíi jītí ki cá kii mboonee,
ní m bíi kōō kii kumoouee.
13Ama sii ti-Dindaanee, a làá nīn kā dibeel ní kí nīn cá jaanjaan,
ní bi làá nīn téetí a-pu abin abin.
14A làá yīkì kí dàkà Siiyɔn a-ŋanti,
di sá yii ŋyunti bàn̄ á sɔ̄ ki-saai,
tiŋman, ŋyunti lafun bàn̄.
15Timbi a-tɔntɔnliibi néeń ki-taŋkpeeŋi,
ki-tam gba cútí-ti isaa.
16Atimbun làá fàŋkì sii ti-Dindaan yindi,
ní kitiŋ pu bɔtiibi kɔkɔ ń fàŋkì a-nyooti.
17Di sá yii ti-Dindaan làá fàtīí mā Siiyɔn tiŋki,
u làá dāá lēē u-ba kí dàkà u-nyooti poon.
18U làá dāá pīlifiǹ bin bi fúkúl̀ee,
ní kaa làá dāá gbāfì bi-wimmeem.
19Bí ŋmà tin bí nee kí síiń bin làá dāá páanní boonee,
ní dinibul din bi fātìi náańee ń dāá nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan.
20U gbóonní doooo yilpu u-circir kɔŋkooŋŋun ki kpēē,
ti-Dindaan gbóonní doooo yilpu ki kpēē kitiŋ
21kí pīlifì bisarkadambi timinsii,
ní kí gbìntī bin an sá yii bi lēē kí kpɔ̀ee kí líí.
22Niinee bi làá dāá sòoǹ ti-Dindaan yindi pu Siiyɔn tiŋkin,
ní kí dāá sòoǹ u-nyɔŋkii pu Jeerusaleem tiŋkin,
23ŋyunti ŋun anibul nì abee yaa láa kpáfì
kí jāam̀ ti-Dindaanee.
24M dáá bí nsanni ki cá
ní u bātì m-pɔŋŋu pu.
U bātì m-maŋfal wiiŋyi pu.
25An pu ní m téeń mpɔn yii:
«M-Nimbɔtiu,
sii un bí kí nīn cá jaanjaanee,
taa yòon̄-mi m-maŋfal wiiŋyi kansikin.»
26Dooooyee ní a náań kitiŋ,
a dū a-ŋalii ní ki náań yilpu.
27Tíǹ gbanti kɔkɔ làá wāŋkì, ama sii làá nīn pée bí ní.
Kitiŋ nì yilpu làá sátí kii tiwampeeŋkaalee,
a làá kpántí-bi kii bi nín kpántí dibɔkutil puee ní,
ní bí pɔ̄ mpaan.
28Ama siiyee, aa kpántí,
ní a-maŋfal wiiŋyi kaa kúntí mun.
29Timbi a-tɔntɔnliibi biyaamu làá nīn cáá ŋkɔŋkoon,
ní mu-naantiibi ń nīn bí a-nimbiin.

english_text:
(By David.)
The Lord's Wonderful Love
1With all my heart
I praise the Lord,
and with all that I am
I praise his holy name!
2With all my heart
I praise the Lord!
I will never forget
how kind he has been.
3The Lord forgives our sins,
heals us when we are sick,
4and protects us from death.
His kindness and love
are a crown on our heads.
5Each day that we live,
he provides for our needs
and gives us the strength
of a young eagle.
6For all who are mistreated,
the Lord brings justice.
7He taught his Law to Moses
and showed all Israel
what he could do.
8 The Lord is merciful!
He is kind and patient,
and his love never fails.
9The Lord won't always be angry
and point out our sins;
10he doesn't punish us
as our sins deserve.
11How great is God's love for all
who worship him?
Greater than the distance
between heaven and earth!
12How far has the Lord taken
our sins from us?
Farther than the distance
from east to west!
13Just as parents are kind
to their children,
the Lord is kind
to all who worship him,
14because he knows
we are made of dust.
15We humans are like grass
or wild flowers
that quickly bloom.
16But a scorching wind blows,
and they quickly wither
to be forever forgotten.
17The Lord is always kind
to those who worship him,
and he keeps his promises
to their descendants
18who faithfully obey him.
19God has set up his kingdom
in heaven, and he rules
the whole creation.
20All of you mighty angels,
who obey God's commands,
come and praise your Lord!
21All of you thousands
who serve and obey God,
come and praise your Lord!
22All of God's creation
and all that he rules,
come and praise your Lord!
With all my heart
I praise the Lord!
translation_text:
M làá jāam̀ ti-Dindaan
1Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee.
M làá jāam̀ ti-Dindaan nì m-naŋki kɔkɔ,
m làá jāam̀ u-circir yindi nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ.
2M làá jāam̀ ti-Dindaan nì m-naŋki kɔkɔ,
kaa làá súntí u-ŋanti báà tiba pu.
3Úǹ di cáá m-yìntitam kɔkɔ ki pūǹ-mi,
ní ki cāantí m-weeŋyi kɔkɔ.
4U nyāntí-mi ŋkúm bookun,
ní ki cáá dineeŋkpaandi nì disaasɔl
ki cīkintí-mi kii kibeefuuliiyee.
5U tìì-mi tiwammɔntiil m-puti poon,
u yàntī m fàtīi kpántí unipɔɔn kii ukaalunee.
6Ti-Dindaan tūǹ deedee tuuŋŋi,
u sòoǹ bin kɔkɔ bi sàantée bɔti nì ibaamɔn.
7U nìn yāntì Mooyiisi béè u-sàmbiyaamu,
ní Isirayeel yab béè u-tuŋkpaaŋŋi.
8Ti-Dindaan poon mɔ̄ ní ki cáá kulaŋŋaŋfitiiu,
waa gífí diŋuul malaa ní u-neendi wīikí tikpilku.
9Waa sòoǹ unil bɔti kaa gbèentí,
kaa tí díkì ubɔ pu an kaa kúntí.
10Waa dátí ti-tafal kii ti-kpitii nín bàà máaǹ puee,
waa tí pà ti-yìntitam paati nín bàà máaǹ puee.
11Kii kitiŋ nì kutagbɔŋu nín dátì nì tɔb puee,
míǹ ní dineeŋkpaandi din u cáá bin fàŋkí-uee puee wīikí.
12Kii ŋwìiń nyalaŋki nín dátì nì ŋu-jeetilaŋki puee,
míǹ ní u kàkatī ti-kpitii ki wàatī-ti.
13Kii ubaati poon nín mɔ̄ u-biyaamu pu puee,
míǹ ní ti-Dindaan mun poon mɔ̄ bin fàŋkí-uee pu.
14Di sá yii úǹ nyí kun u dūu máń-tee,
waa súntí yii ntam ní ti sá.
15Unilee, u-maŋfal wiiŋyi bí kii kumoouee ní,
kii tisatin supumpukumee, míǹ ní u púkuḿ.
16Di sá yii kubuŋu yaa fáá nsupumpukumee, mì wáŋkí ní,
aa ti béetí laakin mì nìn bée.
17Ama ti-Dindaan neeŋkpaandi
bí bin fàŋkí-uee pu ní ki cá talku.
U-deedeeu làá nīn bí bi-naantiibi pu,
18ŋyunti ŋun bi yaa ŋúb́ u -poondi
ní ki dàkafī kí ŋá u-bɔkpaaŋi nín bí yii bí ŋá puee.
19Ti-Dindaan dū u-beejal ki yóoǹ yilpu,
ní ki jīǹ dibeel tin kɔkɔ pée bée pu.
20Jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan, nimbi u-tuuŋyi
in di cáá mpɔn ki ŋáań u-nyɔɔbundi nín lī puee,
ki tɔ́-u ŋyunti ŋun ni yaa gbìl̄ u-nyɔkɔpuee.
21Jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan, nimbi u-janjakitiŋ kɔkɔ,
nimbi u-tɔntɔnliibi bin ŋáań u nín là puee.
22Ní jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan nimbi u-wannaaŋkaati,
laakin kamaa ní ni yaa bí u-beelinee.
M làá jāam̀ ti-Dindaan nì m-naŋki kɔkɔ.

english_text:
The Lord Takes Care of His Creation
1I praise you, Lord God,
with all my heart.
You are glorious and majestic,
dressed in royal robes
2and surrounded by light.
You spread out the sky
like a tent,
3and you built your home
over the mighty ocean.
The clouds are your chariot
with the wind as its wings.
4 The winds are your messengers,
and flames of fire
are your servants.
5You built foundations
for the earth, and it
will never be shaken.
6You covered the earth
with the ocean that rose
above the mountains.
7Then your voice thundered!
And the water flowed
8down the mountains
and through the valleys
to the place you prepared.
9Now you have set boundaries,
so that the water will never
flood the earth again.
10You provide streams of water
in the hills and valleys,
11so that the donkeys
and other wild animals
can satisfy their thirst.
12Birds build their nests nearby
and sing in the trees.
13From your home above
you send rain on the hills
and water the earth.
14You let the earth produce
grass for cattle,
plants for our food,
15wine to cheer us up,
olive oil for our skin,
and grain for our health.
16Our Lord, your trees
always have water,
and so do the cedars
you planted in Lebanon.
17Birds nest in those trees,
and storks make their home
in the fir trees.
18Wild goats find a home
in the tall mountains,
and small animals can hide
between the rocks.
19You created the moon
to tell us the seasons.
The sun knows when to set,
20and you made the darkness,
so the animals in the forest
could come out at night.
21Lions roar as they hunt
for the food you provide.
22But when morning comes,
they return to their dens,
23then we go out to work
until the end of day.
24Our Lord, by your wisdom
you made so many things;
the whole earth is covered
with your living creatures.
25But what about the ocean
so big and wide?
It is alive with creatures,
large and small.
26 And there are the ships,
as well as Leviathan,
the monster you created
to splash in the sea.
27All of these depend on you
to provide them with food,
28and you feed each one
with your own hand,
until they are full.
29But when you turn away,
they are terrified;
when you end their life,
they die and rot.
30You created all of them
by your Spirit,
and you give new life
to the earth.
31Our Lord, we pray
that your glory
will last forever
and that you will be pleased
with what you have done.
32You look at the earth,
and it trembles.
You touch the mountains,
and smoke goes up.
33As long as I live,
I will sing and praise you,
the Lord God.
34I hope my thoughts
will please you,
because you are the one
who makes me glad.
35Destroy all wicked sinners
from the earth
once and for all.
With all my heart
I praise you, Lord!
I praise you!
translation_text:
Unimbɔti unáanli, m jáaḿ-si
1M làá jāam̀ ti-Dindaan nì m-naŋki kɔkɔ!
Ti-Dindaan m-Nimbɔtiu, a sá ukpaan tikpilku!
Tinyool nì jilma ní a pēē,
2ní ki dū ŋwalifi ki bīiǹ a-ba pu kii dibɔkutikpaandee.
A kpátì kutagbɔŋu kii tantee.
3A máń a-kɔŋkooŋŋu inyiŋfi in bí yilpuee pu.
Atagban di sá-si janjatɔrɔku,
a còom̄ kubuŋu feeŋyi pu ní.
4Kubuŋu di sá a-tuuŋyi,
ní aŋmilimbil sá a-tɔntɔnliibi.
5A dū kitiŋ ki tɔ́kɔǹ ki-nyeel pu,
kì kpá kí cìŋkì ŋwindal.
6A dū tiŋku ki bīiǹ ki-pu kii dibɔkutilee,
inyiŋfi nìn bīī ajoon pu.
7Ama ní a kpātì i-pu ní i sáǹ ki kátì.
A téeń i-pu kii ditaadundee ní i sáǹ
8ki dàb̄ ajoon, ki sīntì atantakan
ki nín cá laakin a bɔ́ntì ki síiǹ-iee.
9A síiǹ-i kikpaanyɔkɔ kin iaa máaǹ kí pùub̀ kí jītée,
án nín làá ŋá pu i taa ti dāan̄ kí bìin̄ kitiŋ puee.
10A cáǹ nnyim min nyēē anyimbulnimbilinee ibunni,
mì pùub̀ ajoon kansikin,
11ní ipeel kɔkɔ dòoń ki nyù.
Niin ní kumooun mammu nyù.
12Inoon kóò ki kɔ́ĺ-mì,
ní ki gà ilan tifaalin.
13A yàntī utaa nyēeń yilpu ki nì ajoon pu,
a yàntī nnyim bà kitiŋ.
14Sii di yàntī timool nyēē ní tiwaŋkuti kāntí ki jīǹ,
ní ki yàntī tin unil kùee nyēē.
Kitiŋ di tìì unil u-jikaati.
15Kíǹ di tìì unil ndaam min u nyù an mɔ̄ǹ-uee,
ki tìì-u ŋkpam min u ŋmìtī u-nimbiin ŋān̄ee,
ní ki tìì-u tijin tin u jīǹ ki kāntí mpɔnee.
16Ti-Dindaan sufii kāntí ntaanyim min máaǹee,
Leebanɔn sufii in u cóoǹ bi yíì seediree.
17Inoon pāantí i-diti i-pu,
ní naakpaapiimbi kóò siipreesi sufii pu.
18Njooŋɔjamu kóò ajoon ŋin fɔ̀kɔ̀ee pu,
ní itaŋkpalɔkɔ sá ŋkɔŋkoon ki tīī ijangbeenapul.
19A náań uŋmal tí nīn cáa béetí iyunti,
nì ŋwìiń ŋu nyí kukúluu kun ŋu máaǹ kí jēetée.
20A yaa cáań dibɔmbɔndee ní kunyeeu ń mɔ́,
ní kubambaŋŋun peelii kɔkɔ ń kíĺ ki bíi còom̄.
21Agbikintipɔmbil mùuǹ ki nyàab̀ upeel kí ŋmɔ́,
ní ki bàlifī sii Unimbɔti á tīī-ŋi ŋi-jinti.
22Ŋwìiń yaa nyáńee ní ŋí jītíi kɔ́
kí dòon̄ ŋi-diiŋŋin,
23ní unil ń nyā kí búntí u-tundi,
kí gbàfì kí cáá sāā kujoou.
24Ti-Dindaan, a-tuuŋŋi wīikéeee!
A dū iciin ní ki ŋá atuun gbanti kɔkɔ,
a-wannaaŋkaati di gbí kitiŋ kɔkɔ.
25Kpèè tiŋku di dɔ̄ pàaa kí cée,
tiwaŋkuti tikpaandi nì ŋwaamu
gbí poon an kaa cáá ŋkaan.
26Meelab tɔ́kɔ́ u-pu ki cá ki gítiń,
ní kupeebiliŋŋu Leefiyatan kun a náańee
bí u-poon ki gbíiĺ.
27Tiwaŋkuti gbanti kɔkɔ máká a-pu
á tīī-tì tijin ŋyunti ŋun a máaǹee tí jī.
28A yaa tīī-tèe ní tí yòon̄ kí jī,
a yaa tāntì a-ŋalee ní tí ká kí jī kí díkí.
29Ama a yaa fātì a-boon ki tīī-tèe, ní tifaandi ń cúú-tì.
A yaa cúú ti-fooku ki lēēyee ní tí kpú
kí fàtīí gítí ntamin.
30A yaa tīī-tì a-fookuee, a náań-tì dee,
ní kí fàtīí pɔ̀ntī tikɔkɔ kitiŋ pu.
31Ti-Dindaan nyooti ń nīn bí ki cá jaanjaan!
An nīn mɔ̄ǹ ti-Dindaan u-tuuŋŋi pu!
32U yaa kpēē kitiŋee, kì cìŋkī ní,
u yaa gbēē ajoonee, ŋi dùkù ní.
33M-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poonee,
m làá gāā ilan kí pàkà ti-Dindaan,
iwiin in kíǹ-mi nee, m làá dūú gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì m-Nimbɔtiu ní.
34M-yaliŋkii ń nīn fáatiǹ-u.
Mamee, ti-Dindaan pu ní m làá nīn fàal̀.
35Bikpitiŋaliibi ń kúntí kitiŋ pu,
binikpitib ń taa ti nín̄ bí!
Tiŋman, m làá jāam̀ sii ti-Dindaan!
Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_text:
The Lord Can Be Trusted
1 Praise the Lord
and pray in his name!
Tell everyone
what he has done.
2Sing praises to the Lord!
Tell about his miracles.
3Celebrate and worship
his holy name
with all your heart.
4Trust the Lord
and his mighty power.
5Remember his miracles
and all his wonders
and his fair decisions.
6You belong to the family
of Abraham, his servant;
you are his chosen ones,
the descendants of Jacob.
7The Lord is our God,
bringing justice
everywhere on earth.
8He will never forget
his agreement or his promises,
not in thousands of years.
* 9 God made an eternal promise
10 to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob,
11when he said, “I'll give you
the land of Canaan.”
12At the time there were
only a few of us,
and we were homeless.
13We wandered from nation
to nation, from one country
to another.
14 God did not let anyone
mistreat our people.
Instead he protected us
by punishing rulers
15and telling them,
“Don't touch my chosen leaders
or harm my prophets!”
16 God kept crops from growing
until food was scarce
everywhere in the land.
17 But he had already sent Joseph,
sold as a slave into Egypt,
18 with chains of iron
around his legs and neck.
19Joseph remained a slave
until his own words
had come true,
and the Lord had finished
testing him.
20 Then the king of Egypt
set Joseph free
21 and put him in charge
of everything he owned.
22Joseph was in command
of the officials,
and he taught the leaders
how to use wisdom.
23 Jacob and his family
came and settled in Egypt
as foreigners.
24 They were the Lord's people,
so he let them grow stronger
than their enemies.
25They served the Lord,
and he made the Egyptians plan
hateful things against them.
26 God sent his servant Moses.
He also chose and sent Aaron
27to his people in Egypt,
and they worked miracles
and wonders there.
28 Moses and Aaron obeyed God,
and he sent darkness
to cover Egypt.
29 God turned their rivers
into streams of blood,
and the fish all died.
30 Frogs were everywhere,
even in the royal palace.
31 When God gave the command,
flies and gnats
swarmed all around.
32 In place of rain,
God sent hailstones
and flashes of lightning.
33He destroyed their grapevines
and their fig trees,
and he made splinters
of all the other trees.
34 God gave the command,
and more grasshoppers came
than could be counted.
35They ate every green plant
and all the crops that grew
in the land of Egypt.
36 Then God took the life
of every first-born son.
37 When God led Israel from Egypt,
they took silver and gold,
and no one was left behind.
38The Egyptians were afraid
and gladly let them go.
39 God hid them under a cloud
and guided them by fire
during the night.
40 When they asked for food,
he sent more birds
than they could eat.
41 God even split open a rock,
and streams of water
gushed into the desert.
42God never forgot
his sacred promise
to his servant Abraham.
43When the Lord rescued
his chosen people from Egypt,
they celebrated with songs.
44 The Lord gave them the land
and everything else
the nations had worked for.
45He did this so that his people
would obey all his laws.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Unimbɔti deedee tuuŋŋi bɔti
(B. 1-15. kpèè 1 Kroo 16.8-22)
1Ní nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan kí yòon̄ u-yindi yilpu,
ní yàntīmaan anibul kɔkɔ ń béé u-tuŋkpaaŋŋi.
2Ní gāāmaan ilan kí pàkà-u, kí gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u,
ní dàkafìmaan u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ pu.
3Nimbi bin nyàab̀ ti-Dindaanee,
án nīn mɔ̄ǹ-ni u-circir yindi pu,
ní nīn bí dipɔɔpindin.
4Ní nyàab̀maan ti-Dindaan nì u-pɔŋŋu,
nyàab̀maan kí nīn bí u-nimbiin.
5Ní téetímaan maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin u ŋáaǹee
nì u-tuŋkpaaŋŋi pu,
nì ibɔsoon in kɔkɔ ní u sòon̄ee.
6Nimbi u-tɔntɔnliu Abraam naantiibi,
nimbi Jaakɔb naantiibi bin u lēēyee, téetímaan.
7Úǹ di sá ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu,
úǹ di sòoǹ kitiŋ pu nib kɔkɔ bɔti.
8Waa pée súntí u-poondi pu dalba dalba,
tibɔti tin u yóoǹ án nīn sá mara ki tīī anaantitɔntɔkɔ kutuku puee.
9Dipoondi gbanti ní u nìn pōoǹ Abraam,
díǹ ní u nìn pūtì ki pōoǹ Isaaki mun,
10díǹ ní u nìn dūu síiǹ Jaakɔb dibɔkpaal,
talku poondi gbanti ní u nìn pōoǹ Isirayeel,
11ki lī-u yii: «M làá tīī-si Kanaan tiŋki,
án nīn sá sii nì a-naantiibi wanti.»
12Baa nìn náaǹ báà fiii,
bi nìn pée sá binikaaŋkaabi ní ki kāl̀ niin kunicaŋu.
13Bi nìn kàal̀ atimbun ní ki kpántí,
ki kàal̀ dibeel diba poon ní ki yíkí ki nìkì din kíǹ poon.
14Ama Unimbɔti kaa kíí báà unil ń sàaǹ-bi,
bi-pu ní u dáaĺ bibɔtiibi tafal ki lī yii:
15«Ní taa gbēē bin m lēēyee,
ní taa pée ŋá m-bɔnaatiliibi tikpitil tiba.»
16U nìn cáań ŋkùm kitiŋee pu,
tijin kaa nìn gíti bí binib ń jī.
17U nìn dū unil ubɔ ki tú bi-nyɔkɔpu,
Jooseefi un bi nìn nyáfì u kpántì uyumbuee.
18Bi nìn bá u-taaŋi akpambaa,
bi nìn dū ikusaka ki tɔ́ u-neen,
19ki cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋun ní tin u nìn sòon̄ee
dāa jítì míǹ deedeedeeyee.
Ti-Dindaan nyɔɔbundi nìn cɔ́ŋkì-u ki pɔ̀n̄-u.
20Ubɔti nìn pú kinyɔkɔ bí báatí-u u-kpambaaŋi,
anibul kpiliu nìn yāntì bi líì-u.
21U nìn dū-u ki kāaǹ u-dicaŋku pu ukpil,
ní ki nìn yāntì u kpòotī tin kɔkɔ u cááyee,
22kí ŋmā kí dàkà u-bɔtibiliŋ u nín là puee,
ní kí ŋmā kí tīī bitindaŋkpilib iciin.
23Míǹ boonee, Isirayeel nìn cūtì Eejipiti tiŋkin,
Jaakɔb nìn kpántì unicaan Kaam tiŋkin.
24Ti-Dindaan nìn pú u-nibul mmaal
ní ki tīī-bi mpɔn ki jítiǹ bi-nannanliibi.
25U nìn cúú Eejipiti yab pɔbiliŋ ki kpántì,
bi nìn kíǹ ki ná u-nibul
ní ki nìn ŋmātiǹ u-tɔntɔnliibi.
26Niinee ní u dū u-tɔntɔnliu Mooyiisi
nì Aarɔn un u nìn lēēyee ki tú.
27Unimbɔti nìn yāntì bi ŋáaǹ maamaaci daanti Eejipiti tiŋkin,
bi nìn ŋáaǹ maamaaci tuuŋŋi Kaam tiŋkin.
28Unimbɔti nìn cáań dibɔmbɔndi ní an dūu mɔ́,
ama báà ubɔ kaa nìn kpákáǹ u-nyɔɔbundi.
29U nìn yāntì nnyim kpántì fatiku
ní ki yāntì ijɔm in bí mi-poonee kpíì.
30Kpaabi nìn gbí Eejipiti tiŋkin
ki kpáaǹ bi-bɔtiu diiŋŋin.
31Unimbɔti nìn sòon̄ ní ikpiŋki dɔ́miń
ní inaacib gbí kitiŋ kɔkɔ pu.
32An nín bàà sá utaa ń nèe, u nìn yāntì ataanyiŋkumbil di lítì,
ní utaa tɔ́ ní bi-tiŋki fōō ŋŋmi,
33ki bíil̀ bi-fiinyi nì bi-fiigi sufii,
ní ki kɔ́fì bi-tiŋki pu sufii.
34Unimbɔti nìn tí sòon̄ ní inaakicaan,
nì inaakitoon in baa ŋūǹ kí kàaǹee dɔ́miń.
35I nìn ŋmɔ́ bi-tiŋki pu mooti kɔkɔ,
i nìn ŋmɔ́ kitiŋ nín lòon̄ tikpaajin tiŋyee.
36U nìn kūū Eejipiti yab biseebiyaamu nninjabiyaamu kɔkɔ,
mun bi péé ki màl̄ ŋyunti ŋun bi-fatikuu dáá tùm̀ee.
37U nìn nyántì u-nibul bi tú animbil nì sindaariya.
Bi-naakɔti kansikinee, ubɔ kaa nìn gbíntì boon.
38Bi nín nyáńee, an nìn mɔ́ɔkiǹ Eejipiti yab,
di sá yii dinyoondi nìn kɔ́-bi.
39U nìn kpátì ditagbandi ki bīiǹ bi-pu,
ní ki dū ŋŋmi ki ŋmíntì-bi kunyeeu.
40Bi nìn mēē ní u yāntì njikpacimamu dɔ́miń,
u nìn dū yilpu jinti ki kpíiǹ-bi.
41U nìn yāntì ditaŋkpal poon nnyim nyáń,
ki pùub̄ ki jítì kuteeu pu kii mbunee.
42Di sá yii waa nìn súntì u-circir poondi
din u nìn pōoǹ u-tɔntɔnliu Abraamee pu.
43U nìn nyántì u-nibul nì ifaal,
bin bin u nìn lēēyee iwiliili poon.
44U nìn fōō atimbun aba timmu ki tīī-bi,
ní bíǹ jíń anibul aba tuuŋŋi paati,
45án nín làá ŋá pu bí nīn ŋúb́ u-bɔkpaaŋi
kí nīn tɔ́ u-marabee.
Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_text:
A Nation Asks for Forgiveness
1 We will celebrate
and praise you, Lord!
You are good to us,
and your love never fails.
2No one can praise you enough
for all the mighty things
you have done.
3You bless those people
who are honest and fair
in everything they do.
4Remember me, Lord,
when you show kindness
by saving your people.
5Let me prosper with the rest
of your chosen ones,
as they celebrate with pride
because they belong to you.
6We and our ancestors
have sinned terribly.
7 When they were in Egypt,
they paid no attention
to your marvelous deeds
or your wonderful love.
And they turned against you
at the Red Sea.
8But you were true to your name,
and you rescued them to prove
how mighty you are.
9 You said to the Red Sea,
“Dry up!”
Then you led your people across
on land as dry as a desert.
10You saved all of them
11and drowned every one
of their enemies.
12 Then your people trusted you
and sang your praises.
13But they soon forgot
what you had done
and rejected your advice.
14 They became greedy for food
and tested you there
in the desert.
15So you gave them
what they wanted,
but later you destroyed them
with a horrible disease.
16 Everyone in camp was jealous
of Moses and of Aaron,
your chosen priest.
17Dathan and Abiram rebelled,
and the earth opened up
and swallowed them.
18Then fire broke out
and destroyed all
of their followers.
19 At Horeb your people
made and worshiped the statue
20of a bull, instead of you,
their glorious God.
21You worked powerful miracles
to save them from Egypt,
but they forgot about you
22and the fearsome things
you did at the Red Sea.
23You were angry and started
to destroy them,
but Moses, your chosen leader,
begged you not to do it.
24 They would not trust
you, Lord,
and they did not like
the promised land.
25They would not obey you,
and they grumbled
in their tents.
26So you threatened them
by saying, “I'll kill you
out here in the desert!
27 I'll scatter your children
everywhere in the world.”
28 Your people became followers
of a god named Baal Peor,
and they ate sacrifices
offered to the dead.
29They did such terrible things
that you punished them
with a deadly disease.
30But Phinehas helped them,
and the sickness stopped.
31Now he will always
be highly honored.
32 At Meribah Spring
they turned against you
and made you furious.
33Then Moses got into trouble
for speaking in anger.
34 Our Lord, they disobeyed you
by refusing to destroy
the nations.
35Instead they were friendly
with those foreigners
and followed their customs.
36Then they fell into the trap
of worshiping idols.
37 They sacrificed their sons
and their daughters to demons
38 and to the gods of Canaan.
Then they poured out the blood
of these innocent children
and made the land filthy.
39By doing such gruesome things,
they also became filthy.
40 Finally, Lord, you were angry
and terribly disgusted
with your people.
41So you put them in the power
of nations that hated them.
42They were mistreated and abused
by their enemies,
43but you saved them
time after time.
They were determined to rebel,
and their sins caused
their downfall.
44You answered their prayers
when they were in trouble.
45You kept your agreement
and were so merciful
46that their enemies
had pity on them.
47 Save us, Lord God!
Bring us back
from among the nations.
Let us celebrate and shout
in praise of your holy name.
48 Lord God of Israel,
you deserve to be praised
forever and ever.
Let everyone say, “Amen!
Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_text:
Isirayeel yab bíi bìitī bi-kpitii pu
(B. 1.47-48. kpèè 1 Kroo 16.34-36)
1 Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!
Tí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan, di sá yii u ŋān̄,
ní u-neeŋkpaandi bí ki cá jaanjaan.
2Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí sòoǹ ti-Dindaan tuŋkpaaŋŋi pu?
Ŋma di làá yàntī bí gbìl̄ u-nyɔŋkii pu?
3Bin ŋúb́ Unimbɔti marab,
ki ŋáań ŋyunti kamaa tin bí deedeeyee bí mmɔnneeee!
4Ti-Dindaan, a yaa bíi dàkà a-nibul a-ŋantee,
á téetí m-pu!
Jòoń-mi a-fiil pu.
5Yàntī ḿ ká bin a lútèe naam,
kí yàntī ḿ fàal̀ nì a-nibul
ní kí nīn bí dipɔɔpindin nì bin sá a-yabee.
6Ti ŋá ikpiti kii ti-baabee,
ti ŋá tin kaa kítèe ki fōō dibɔkpil.
7Ŋyunti ŋun ti-baabi nìn bí Eejipiti tiŋkinee,
baa nìn gbìl̄ ti-Dindaan maamaaci tuuŋŋi taapu.
Bi nìn súntì u-neeŋkpaandi din u dàkā-bi ŋfunyɔm tikpilee pu,
bi nìn jáń nì u dimɔɔl caŋin, Tikati mɔɔl caŋin.
8Ama úǹ u-ba yindi puee, u nìn fīī-bi,
ki lēē u-pɔŋŋu ki dàkā.
9U nìn kpātì Tikati mɔɔl pu
ní díǹ fóotì.
U nìn yāntì bi cōom̀ dimɔɔl poon
kii bi nín còom̄ kuteeun puee.
10U nìn fīī-bi ki nyántì bin kaa nìn là bi-bɔtee ŋaan,
u nìn dá-bi bi-nannanliibi ŋaan ki líì.
11Nnyim nìn fātìi gbí ki léeǹ bi-nannanliibi pu,
bi-kansikin báà ubɔ kaa nìn kíǹ.
12Niinee ní bi fōō Unimbɔti nyɔɔbundi ki kíí,
ní ki gāā ilan ki nyɔ́ŋkì-u.
13Ama an kaa nìn pée súŋkì ní bi súntì tin u ŋée pu,
baa nìn cíitì ú ŋá tin u nìn bɔ́ntì kí ŋée.
14Bi nìn ŋá nnimbitaataam kuteeun.
Laakin ubɔ kaa nìn bée, bi nìn cɔ́ŋkì Unimbɔti.
15U nìn tīī-bi tin bi nìn bālifèe,
ama ní ki dū didúntil weeŋŋu ki tɔ́ bi-pu.
16Bi nìn ŋá Mooyiisi pu ipoompoon dinaapaal pu
ki kpáaǹ Aarɔn un ní bi nìn dūu sú ti-Dindaanee.
17Kitiŋ nìn cúu látì ní ki dū Daatan ki náĺ,
kì nìn bīiǹ Abiiram kitil pu.
18Ŋŋmi nìn wùn̄ dikitil gbanti kɔkɔ,
aŋmilimbil nìn wùn̄ binikpitib gbanti.
19Bi nìn mɔ́ɔ́ dinabil Ooreeb jool taapu,
bi nìn dū tikúti ki mɔ́ɔ́ diwaal ki gbāaǹ ki jáam̀-dì.
20Bi nìn dū unaa un ŋmóò timoolee naŋku
ki kpántì Unimbɔti un sá bi-nyootee.
21Bi nìn súntì Unimbɔti bi-fiiliu
un di nìn túń atuŋkpaan Eejipiti tiŋkinee pu.
22Bi nìn súntì maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin u nìn ŋá Kaam tiŋkinee,
titumbilindi tin u nìn ŋá Tikati mɔɔl caŋinee.
23Unimbɔti nìn lēē yii u làá kúntí-bi,
ama Mooyiisi, unil un u nìn lēēyee
nìn yúl̀ u-nimbiin ki pīiǹ-u nsan
ú taa kpɔ̀-bi u-ŋuul poon.
24Míǹ boonee, bi nìn kpēē kitimmɔntii nee fám,
di sá yii baa nìn fōō Unimbɔti poondi ki kíí.
25Bi nìn bí bi-tantibin ki gbùkum̄,
baa nìn tɔ́ ti-Dindaan nyɔkɔ.
26Niinee ní u yōoǹ u-ŋal yilpu ki pūtì
kí kpɔ̀-bi kuteeun,
27kí jà bi-naantiibi bí yàl̄ atimbun kɔkɔn,
ní kí yàntī bí kpú nnicantimun.
28Bi bàn̄ Peewɔɔree ní ki kíĺ ki bíi tòotī diwaal Baal,
ní ki ŋmɔ́ tiwaŋkuti tin bi dūu tōotì bitaŋkpiibee nanti.
29Bi nìn ŋá míǹ ki gbítì Unimbɔti ŋuul
ní nnaabu jéetì bi-pu.
30Ama Piinaasi nìn yíkìi yúl̀ ki ŋáŋkì tibɔti,
ní nnaabuee gbēeǹ.
31An pu ní ti-Dindaan yíiń-u deedeedaan
kí nīn pée cáa cá abin abin.
32Bi nìn tí gbítì ti-Dindaan ŋuul
Meeriiba nyimbuliŋu caŋin,
ki kɔ́ǹ Mooyiisi digìńdin.
33Bi nìn kɔ́ Mooyiisi poon ki lēē baadakam,
ní úǹ sòon̄ kaa dākafì.
34Ti-Dindaan nín nìn bí-bi yii bí kpɔ̀ kí céetí atimbun ŋiŋyee,
baa nìn ŋá míǹ.
35Ama bi nì binib bin kaa nyí Unimbɔtee nìn ŋá mpèé
ní bi bífì bi-koobiliŋ ki kíǹ ki ŋáań míǹ.
36Bi nìn tōotì bi-waaŋi
ní ŋíǹ kpántì-bi kutaliŋŋu.
37Bi nìn kūū bi-jipɔmbi nì bi-bisalib
ki ŋá saraabi ki tīī arasiniibi.
38Bi kūū maanyiibab,
ki kūū bi-jipɔmbi nì bi-bisalib
ki ŋá saraa ki tīī Kanaan yab waaŋi.
Bi kūū binib míǹ ki kɔ́ǹ kitiŋ tijɔkɔndi.
39Bi-tuuŋŋi gbanti kɔ́ǹ-bi tijɔkɔndin,
bi-bimbim yāntì bi kpántì kii kinimpulaakpaayee.
40Niinee ti-Dindaan fōō u-nibul pu diŋuul,
u nìn kíǹ ki ná bin sá u-yabee.
41U nìn dū-bi ki líì nì atimbun aba,
u nìn dū-bi ki ŋá bi-nannanliibi taapu.
42Bi-nannanliibi nìn sāaǹ-bi
ní ki nyīī-bi ki múĺ bi-taapu.
43Iyunti tikpilee, ti-Dindaan nìn fīī-bi,
ama bíǹ nìn gbíntìi jáà nì u,
ní ki nìn mɔ̀tīi múl̀ bi-kpitii poon.
44Ti-Dindaan nìn ká dinimbinaamandi din poon bi bée
ŋyunti ŋun ní u gbìl̄ bi-biilii puee.
45U nìn téetì dipoondi din u nìn pōoǹ-bee pu.
U-neeŋkpaandi puee, u nìn kpántì u-landɔkɔŋu.
46U nìn yāntì bin kɔkɔ cúú-bi
ki cūnnì kuyuŋuee súń bi-saai.
47Ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu, fīī-ti!
Nyāntí-ti atimbuncaan ŋaan kí kóoǹ-ti kí kpāfì.
Niinee ní tí jāam̀ a-circir yindi,
ní kí nīn nyɔ́ŋkí-si dipɔɔpindin.
48Tí jāam̀ ti-Dindaan, Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu
kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.
Ní samaa kɔkɔ ń kíí yii:
«Ameeni! Tiŋman, an lafun ŋá míǹ!
Aleeluya, Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!»

english_text:
BOOK V
(Psalms 107–150)
The Lord Is Good to His People
1 Shout praises to the Lord!
He is good to us,
and his love never fails.
2Everyone the Lord has rescued
from trouble
should praise him,
3everyone he has brought
from the east and the west,
the north and the south.
4Some of you were lost
in the scorching desert,
far from a town.
5You were hungry and thirsty
and about to give up.
6You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
7At once he brought you
to a town.
8You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
9To everyone who is thirsty,
he gives something to drink;
to everyone who is hungry,
he gives good things to eat.
10Some of you were prisoners
suffering in deepest darkness
and bound by chains,
11because you had rebelled
against God Most High
and refused his advice.
12You were worn out
from working like slaves,
and no one came to help.
13You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
14He brought you out
of the deepest darkness
and broke your chains.
15You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
16He breaks down bronze gates
and shatters iron locks.
17Some of you had foolishly
committed a lot of sins
and were in terrible pain.
18The very thought of food
was disgusting to you,
and you were almost dead.
19You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
20By the power of his own word,
he healed you and saved you
from destruction.
21You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
22You should celebrate
by offering sacrifices
and singing joyful songs
to tell what he has done.
23Some of you made a living
by sailing the mighty sea,
24and you saw the miracles
the Lord performed there.
25At his command a storm arose,
and waves covered the sea.
26You were tossed to the sky
and to the ocean depths,
until things looked so bad
that you lost your courage.
27You staggered like drunkards
and gave up all hope.
28You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
29He made the storm stop
and the sea be quiet.
30You were happy because of this,
and he brought you to the port
where you wanted to go.
31You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
32Honor the Lord
when you and your leaders
meet to worship.
33If you start doing wrong,
the Lord will turn rivers
into deserts,
34 flowing streams
into scorched land,
and fruitful fields
into beds of salt.
35But the Lord can also turn
deserts into lakes
and scorched land
into flowing streams.
36If you are hungry,
you can settle there
and build a town.
37You can plant fields
and vineyards that produce
a good harvest.
38The Lord will bless you
with many children
and with herds of cattle.
39Sometimes you may be crushed
by troubles and sorrows,
until only a few of you
are left to survive.
40But the Lord will take revenge
on those who conquer you,
and he will make them wander
across desert sands.
41When you are suffering
and in need,
he will come to your rescue,
and your families will grow
as fast as a herd of sheep.
42You will see this because
you obey the Lord,
but everyone who is wicked
will be silenced.
43Be wise! Remember this
and think about the kindness
of the Lord.
translation_text:
KUGBƆŊŊMOOŊMOOTIIU
(Ilan 107–150)
Tí jāam̀ Unimbɔti ufiil
1Tí Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, di sá yii u ŋān̄,
ní u-neeŋkpaandi bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan.
2Bin kɔkɔ ti-Dindaan dá ki líìyee ń lì míǹ.
Bin ní ti-Dindaan dá ki nyántì unannanli ŋaanee,
3bin u kóoǹní ntimu kɔkɔn,
ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú nì ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki pú,
ŋgan pú nì ŋgiil pú ki kpáfèe ń lì míǹ.
4Biba nìn tú ki yìiǹ kuteeun,
ki còom̄ ki cá kitiŋkuliŋŋin,
kaa nìn ká nsan ŋun cá kitiŋ kin poon binib kóòyee.
5Ŋkùm nì nnyinnyoo nìn cúú-bi,
ní bi-wunti yɔ̄tì.
6Bi-gìŋ́ŋi poonee, bi nìn fáá mbiil ti-Dindaan watil pú,
ní úǹ nìn fīī-bi ki nyántì bi-nimbinaamandi poon.
7U nìn dū-bi ki tākaǹ nsan ŋun tèen̄ee poon
ki cūnnì-bi kitiŋ kin poon binib kóòyee.
8Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan u-neeŋkpaandi
nì u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin u ŋáań ki tìì binibee pu!
9Di sá yii un ní nnyinnyoo nìn cááyee, u tīī-u u nyùn̄,
ní ki tīī un ŋkùm nìn cááyee u jíń ki díkí.
10Biba nìn kā dibɔmbɔndin nì ŋkúm jiliŋku booŋŋun,
bi nìn bí falaa sarkaun ní bi bóob́-bi ikusaka.
11Di sá yii bi nìn jáń nì Unimbɔti marab,
bi nìn kpēē Yilpu Fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu bɔkpaaŋi fám.
12U nìn dū falaa ki sīntì-bi taapu,
bi nìn gbéetì ki làá lítí ní báà ubɔ kaa nìn tútuǹ-bi.
13Bi-gìŋ́ŋi poonee, bi nìn fáá mbiil ti-Dindaan watil pú,
ní úǹ nìn fīī-bi ki nyántì bi-nimbinaamandi poon.
14U nìn dáaĺ-bi ki nyántì dibɔmbɔndi
nì ŋkúm jiliŋku booŋŋuee poon
ní ki nìn tīfì bi-kusakai.
15Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan u-neeŋkpaandi,
nì u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin u ŋáań ki tìì binibee pu!
16Di sá yii u wīil̀ tasa kúti punuubi
ní ki nákatì tikpàlkaal tin sá tikútee.
17Biba nìn kpántì bigbaambi ki jíń falaa bi-saŋkpitii pu,
bi-kpitii puee, bi nìn jíń falaa tikpil.
18Tijin kɔkɔ nìn núutì-bi,
baa nìn gíti dátiǹ ŋkúm.
19Bi-gìŋ́ŋi poonee, bi nìn fáá mbiil ti-Dindaan watil pú,
ní úǹ nìn fīī-bi ki nyántì bi-nimbinaamandi poon.
20U nìn dū u-nyɔɔbundi ki cáaǹ-bi
ní ki fīī-bi ki nyántì ŋkúm ŋaan.
21Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan u-neeŋkpaandi,
nì u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin u ŋáań ki tìì binibee pu!
22Bí ŋá saraabi kí jāam̀ Unimbɔti,
bí fáá iwiliili kí dàntì-u u-tuuŋŋi pu.
23Biba nìn kɔ́ meelab ki tɔ́kɔ́ tiŋku pu,
bi nìn bí tiŋku pu ki bàntī.
24Bíǹ gbantee nìn ká ti-Dindaan tuuŋŋi
nì maamaacib bin u ŋáań tiŋku puee.
25U sòoǹ ní kubuŋkpaaŋŋu ń kíĺ
ki yòontí tinyiŋgban.
26Tinyiŋgbanee nìn yòontí bi-meelab ki tòó yilpu,
ní ki fàtīi dù-bi ki múl̀ nnyimin.
An nìn bíi ŋáań mimmee ní bi nyùn̄ ŋkpatim.
27Bi-nimbiliŋ nìn bíi bɔ̀ntī ní bi kpìntī kii udanyɔgbilee.
Baa nìn gíti nyí tin bi làá ŋée.
28Bi-gìŋ́ŋi poonee, bi nìn fáá mbiil ti-Dindaan watil pú,
ní úǹ nìn fīī-bi ki nyántì bi-nimbinaamandi poon.
29U nìn yāntì kubuŋkpaaŋŋuee ŋmíl̀,
ní tinyiŋgban mun dōoǹ soooo.
30An ŋmíl̀ mimmee ní an mɔ́ɔkiǹ-bi,
ní ti-Dindaan kpōotì-bi ki cūnnì meelayulilaŋki,
laakin bi nìn là kí cùee.
31Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan u-neeŋkpaandi,
nì u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin u ŋáań ki tìì binibee pu!
32Bí yòon̄ u-yindi yilpu samaa kansikin,
kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u bitindaŋkpilib kpafil poon.
33Úǹ di yàntī mbun ń fóotí kí kpántí kuteeu,
ní anyimbulnimbil ń gúń kí kpā,
34kí yàntī kitiŋ kin cáá ntiŋkpamee ń kpántí kitiŋ kin kpíìyee,
binib bin kóò ki-puee tuŋkpitiŋ pu.
35U tí ŋūǹ kí yàntī kuteeu ń kpántí kubɔɔu,
ní kí yàntī kitiŋkuliŋŋi ń kpántí anyimbulnimbil.
36U cāabìń bin ŋkùm cááyee kí kàan̄ niin,
bí náań kitiŋ kí nīn kíǹ ki kóò ki-pu.
37Bi kù akpaan kí bɔ̄l̀,
ní kí cóoń fiinyi sufii
ní kí dāá kìtī abil.
38Ti-Dindaan bìintí bi-boon ní bi bùtī,
waa bàtī bi-waŋkuti wíiŋŋu pu.
39Ama biba wíiŋŋu nìn bātì,
ní bi nìn dū diwɔ́bil nì nnaabu nì kunimbaau
ki nyīī-bi ki sīntì taapu.
40Ti-Dindaan yāntì bi kíǹ ki kpèé abɔtibil fám.
U yāntì ŋi tú ki yìiǹ kuteeu kun pu nsan kpée.
41Ama u nyāntí ufalaadaan u-falaaun,
ní ki yàntī bi-dicaŋŋi bùtī kii tiwaŋkutee.
42Bin pɔbiliŋ bí dibee yaa ká mimmee, bi fàal̀ ní,
ama binikpitib kɔkɔ pìintí bi-nyɔmmu!
43Ŋma sá uciŋfiti ní?
Udaan ń kpāafì tibɔti nee,
ní kí béé ti-Dindaan neeŋkpaandi!
Udaan ń béé yii ti-Dindaan ŋān̄.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by David.)
With God on Our Side
1Our God, I am faithful to you
with all my heart,
and you can trust me.
I will sing
and play music for you
with all that I am.
2I will start playing my harps
before the sun rises.
3I will praise you, Lord,
for everyone to hear;
I will sing hymns to you
in every nation.
4Your love reaches higher
than the heavens,
and your loyalty extends
beyond the clouds.
5Our God, may you be honored
above the heavens;
may your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
6Answer my prayers
and use your powerful arm
to give us victory.
Then the people you love
will be safe.
7Our God, from your holy place
you made this promise:
“I will gladly divide up
the city of Shechem
and give away Succoth Valley
piece by piece.
8The lands of Gilead
and Manasseh are mine.
Ephraim is my war helmet,
and Judah is my symbol
of royal power.
9Moab is merely my washbasin,
and Edom belongs to me.
I shout with victory
over the Philistines.”
10Our God, who will bring me
to the fortress
or lead me to Edom?
11Have you rejected us?
You don't lead our armies.
12Help us defeat our enemies!
No one else can rescue us.
13Only you give us victory
and crush our enemies.
translation_text:
M làá péeǹ kutaa kí fìntī
(B. 2-6. kpèè 57.8-12, B. 7-14. kpèè 60.7-14)
1Nlan. Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee.
2M cáá dimákal, m-Nimbɔtiu,
m làá gāā nlan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si nì m-naŋki kɔkɔ.
3Iŋmii saalaa beeku nì saŋgu, fìntīmaanee,
m làá péeǹ kutaa kí fìntī.
4Ti-Dindaan, m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si anibul kansikin,
m làá gāā ilan kí pàkà-si atimbun kansikin.
5Di sá yii a-neeŋkpaandi wīikí ki jítiǹ kutagbɔŋu,
ní a-baamɔŋyi wīikí ki tin sāā atagban.
6Unimbɔti, a sá ukpaan ki jítiǹ kutagbɔŋu,
yàntī a-nyooti ń gbí kitiŋ kɔkɔ!
7Dū a-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu kí fīī-ti kí fōō ti-wimmeem,
án nín làá ŋá pu a-nib bin a néeńee ń ká difiilee.
8Unimbɔti sòon̄ u-circir diiku poon.
M jáń ki jíń! M làá yàkatī Siikeem tiŋki,
ní kí ŋmàntī Sukooti tantakal.
9Man di yì Galaadi, man di tí yì Manasee mun.
Eefiraayiim di sá man janjafuuliiki,
ní Juuda sá m-beel pɔŋŋu.
10Moowaab sá kusampeeu kun poon m fùul̀ee ní.
M tákatì m-naatakal ki lúkú Eedoom tiŋki pu,
m fátí dijajil kuŋkuuntii Fiiliistii tiŋki pu.
11Ŋma di làá cùnnì-mi kitiŋ kin
bi máń digundi ki túee poon ní?
Ŋma di làá cùnnì-mi Eedoom tiŋkin,
12an yaa kaa sá sii Unimbɔti un di dū-ti ki fá,
kaa ti cēentí ti-janjakitiŋee?
13Dāá tūtuǹ-ti tí já nì unannanli,
di sá yii unil tūtuntam sá fám ní.
14Unimbɔti yaa bí ti-ceeyee, ti làá já kí jī,
úǹ di làá tāā kí mátí ti-nannanliibi.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1I praise you, God!
Don't keep silent.
2Destructive and deceitful lies
are told about me,
3and hateful things are said
for no reason.
4I had pity and prayed
for my enemies,
but their words to me
were harsh and cruel.
5For being friendly and kind,
they paid me back
with meanness and hatred.
6My enemies said,
“Find some worthless fools
to accuse him of a crime.
7Try him and find him guilty!
Consider his prayers a lie.
8 Cut his life short
and let someone else
have his job.
9Make orphans of his children
and a widow of his wife;
10make his children beg for food
and live in the slums.
11“Let the people he owes
take everything he owns.
Give it all to strangers.
12Don't let anyone be kind to him
or have pity on the children
he leaves behind.
13Bring an end to his family,
and from now on let him be
a forgotten man.
14“Don't let the Lord forgive
the sins of his parents
and his ancestors.
15Don't let the Lord forget
the sins of his family,
or let anyone remember
his family ever lived.
16He was so cruel to the poor,
homeless, and discouraged
that they died young.
17“He cursed others.
Now place a curse on him!
He never wished others well.
Wish only trouble for him!
18He cursed others more often
than he dressed himself.
Let his curses strike him deep,
just as water and olive oil
soak through to our bones.
19Let his curses surround him,
just like the belt and clothes
he wears each day.”
20Those are the cruel things
my enemies wish for me.
Let it all happen to them!
21Be true to your name, Lord God!
Show your great kindness
and rescue me.
22I am poor and helpless,
and I have lost all hope.
23I am fading away
like an evening shadow;
I am tossed aside
like a crawling insect.
24I have gone without eating,
until my knees are weak,
and my body is bony.
25 When my enemies see me,
they say cruel things
and shake their heads.
26Please help me, Lord God!
Come and save me
because of your love.
27Let others know that you alone
have saved me.
28I don't care if they curse me,
as long as you bless me.
You will make my enemies fail
when they attack,
and you will make me glad
to be your servant.
29You will cover them with shame,
just as their bodies
are covered with clothes.
30I will sing your praises
and thank you, Lord,
when your people meet.
31You help everyone in need,
and you save them from death.
translation_text:
Unil un bi bíi kɔ́kɔĺee bíi yíì Unimbɔti ń jòoń-u
1Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.
Unimbɔti un m nyɔ́ŋkée, taa nín̄ ŋmí míǹ,
2di sá yii binikpitib nì binyimɔndambi kɔ́kɔĺ-mi,
bi sòoǹ ki bíiĺ-mi.
3Bi nín ná-mi ki sòoǹ tiŋyee māntìi tú-mi an kɔkɔ pu,
maa ŋá-bi tiba ní bi jáà nì mi.
4M yaa bíi dàkà-bi m-neendee ní bíǹ bí ki kɔ́kɔĺ-mi,
ama ní m mèé ki tìì-bi.
5M yaa ŋá-bi tiŋanee, tikpitil ní bi dùú téeǹ-mi,
ní m yaa tí dàkā-bi dineendee, bí dū kináŋ kí téeǹ-mi.
6Bi sòoǹ m-pu yii: «Tí lēē unil ubɔ ú jáǹ-u,
ukɔkɔli ubɔ ń yūĺ u-ŋaŋgiil pú.
7Bi yaa sòon̄ u-bɔtee, ú jī dibɔkpil,
ní u-wimmeem ń kpántí-u ikpiti.
8U-maŋfal wiiŋyi ń bàtī,
ubɔ ń fōō u-tundi.
9U-jipɔmbi ń kpántí ataŋkpiibil
ní u-nimpuu ń kpántí ukpiipu!
10U-jipɔmbi ń kpántí naayeekub kí nīn mèé ki jīǹ,
bí nīn nyēē bi-digbuŋkatiŋ poon ki mèé ki jīǹ!
11Un u jíń dipɔndee ń dāá kóoǹ u-wanti kɔkɔ,
ní binicambi ń dāá fūkul̀ u nín túń ditundi ki ká tiŋyee.
12Ubɔ ń taa dàkà-u kulaŋŋaŋfitiiu,
ubɔ ń taa sɔ̄ u-taŋkpiibiliŋ saai!
13U-naantiibi ń kúntí
bí taa ti gbìl̄ bi-yiŋŋi pu abin ŋin dòońee poon!
14Bí téetí ti-Dindaan u-baabi kpitii pu,
tiba ń taa pítí u-na kpitii!
15Ti-Dindaan ń nīn pée téetí bi-kpitii pu
ní kí yàntī bí taa ti téetí bi-pu kitiŋ pu!
16Di sá yii kijapaai nee kaa pée dākafì kí ŋá tiŋan,
ama ní ki sāaǹ ki tin kūū ufalaadaan nì unandaan
un wunti yɔ̄tèee.
17U nìn néeń ki tòó binib mbusu,
mbusu ń gítí u-pu.
Waa nìn pée néeń dibiindi bɔti,
dibiindi ń sāǹ kí wàatī-u.
18U nìn dū mbusu ki pēeǹ kii dibɔkutikpaandee,
dí kɔ́ u-poon kii nnyimee
ní kí kɔ́ u-kpabiŋin kii ŋkpamee.
19Dí nīn bīī u-pu kii tiwampeeŋkaalee,
kí nīn pée gbìn̄ u-caŋ kii dambalee!»
20Ti-Dindaan nín làá pà bin kɔ́kɔĺ-mi
ki sòoǹ ki bíiĺ-mee puee dee!
21Ama sii ti-Dindaan m-Nimbɔtiu,
a-yindi puee, ŋá-mi tiŋan,
a-neeŋkpaandi ŋanti puee, fīī-mi.
22Di sá yii ufalaadaan nì unandaan ní m sá,
m-poon kaam cɔ́tì.
23M bíi cá dee kii mboon nín wáŋkí puee,
bi bíi jì-mi kii unaakitoonee.
24M bóob́ kinyɔkɔ áli m-tabiŋyiliŋ kíǹ ki jìkì,
ní m dúntì ki kíǹ akpab ŋma.
25Bi bèel̄-mi,
ní bi yaa ká-mee, bi gbákafí bi-yiliŋ.
26Ti-Dindaan m-Nimbɔtiu, jòoń-mi,
a-neeŋkpaandi puee, fīī-mi.
27Yàntī bí béé yii sii di ŋá,
sii ti-Dindaan di ŋá míǹ ki tīī-mi.
28Bi tòó mbusu, ama ní sii bìintí.
Bi yaa bíi jáà nì mi, icoo làá cúú-bi,
ní man a-tɔntɔnliu ń nīn fàal̀.
29Yàntī icoo ń cúú bin kɔ́kɔĺ-mee,
bí dū bi-cooi kí bìin̄ bi-ba pu kii dibɔkutikpaandee!
30M làá gāā ilan mpɔn kí jāam̀ ti-Dindaan,
m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-u kunipaau kansikin.
31Di sá yii u yú ufalaadaan ŋaŋgiiliŋu pú
kí fīī-u kí nyāntí bin bíi kù u-bɔtee ŋaan.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
The Lord Gives Victory
1 The Lord said to my Lord,
“Sit at my right side,
until I make your enemies
into a footstool for you.”
2The Lord will let your power
reach out from Zion,
and you will rule
over your enemies.
3Your glorious power
will be seen on the day
you begin to rule.
You will wear the sacred robes
and shine like the morning sun
in all of your strength.
4 The Lord has made a promise
that will never be broken:
“You will be a priest forever,
just like Melchizedek.”
5The Lord is at your right side,
and when he gets angry
he will crush
the other kings.
6He will judge the nations
and crack their skulls,
leaving piles of dead bodies
all over the earth.
7He will drink from any stream
that he chooses, while winning
victory after victory.
translation_text:
Ubɔti nì usaraaŋakpil
1Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee.
Ti-Dindaan nín sòon̄ pu ki tùkū m-Dindaanee sèé:
«Dāá kàl̄ m-ŋaŋgiil pú
kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun m làá dū a-nannanliibi
kí bíĺ a-taaŋi taapu á tāāyee.»
2Doooo Siiyɔn jool pu
ní ti-Dindaan wāaǹ a-beel pɔŋŋu!
Jī a-nannanliibi bin māntìi tú-see pu dibeel.
3Anibul dòoń nì tininjati
ŋwiin ŋun a kóoǹ a-janjakitil ki kpáfèe.
Unimbɔti jool puee,
a-nipɔmbi dòoń a-cee,
kii dimalindi nín tòó pu ntaafaabɔmbɔmin puee ní.
4Ti-Dindaan di pūtì ki pōoǹ,
u kpá kí kɔ́ntí u-nyɔkɔ yii:
«A sá usaraaŋakpil ní kí nīn cá talku,
kii Meelkiiseedeeki nín nìn sá puee.»
5Ti-Dindaan bí a-ŋaŋgiil pú.
U-ŋuul wiiŋŋu dalee, u làá nà bibɔtiibi ní.
6U làá sòoǹ atimbun bɔti,
ní anikpil ń nīn dɔ̄ an kɔkɔ fìlfil,
u làá nà bikpootiliibi kitiŋ kɔkɔ pu.
7Ubɔti làá nyɔ̀ mbunni nyim nsanni,
míǹ boonee ní kí gántí u-yil.

english_text:
Praise the Lord for All He Has Done
1Shout praises to the Lord!
With all my heart
I will thank the Lord
when his people meet.
2The Lord has done
many wonderful things!
Everyone who is pleased
with God's marvelous deeds
will keep them in mind.
3Everything the Lord does
is glorious and majestic,
and his power to bring justice
will never end.
4The Lord God is famous
for his wonderful deeds,
and he is kind and merciful.
5He gives food to his worshipers
and always keeps his agreement
with them.
6He has shown his mighty power
to his people
and has given them the lands
of other nations.
7God is always honest and fair,
and his laws can be trusted.
8They are true and right
and will stand forever.
9God rescued his people,
and he will never break
his agreement with them.
He is fearsome and holy.
10 Respect and obey the Lord!
This is the first step
to wisdom and good sense.
God will always be respected.
translation_text:
Kí téetí ti-Dindaan maamaaci tuuŋŋi pu
1 Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!
M làá nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ
deedeedambi kpafil kansikin.
2Ti-Dindaan tuuŋŋi sá akpaan,
bin kɔkɔ néeń-ŋee dàkafī ŋi-pu ní.
3U-tuuŋŋi sá tinyool nì jilma ní.
U-deedeeu bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
4U là yii tí nīn téetí u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi pu.
Ti-Dindaan sá ulaŋŋaŋfiti ní u-poon mɔ̄.
5U tìì bin fàŋkí-uee tijin bi jīǹ,
waa súntí u-poondi pu jaanjaan.
6U dàkā u-nibul u-tuuŋŋi pɔŋŋu
ŋyunti ŋun ní u fōō atimbun aba timmu ki tīī-bee.
7Tin u ŋáańee sá ibaamɔn nì deedee ní.
Unil ŋūǹ kí nīn máká u-bɔkpaaŋi pu.
8Ŋaa kpántí dalba dalba.
Ibaamɔn nì deedee ní u dūu náań-ŋi.
9U fīī u-nibul ki líì
ní ki pūtì ki pōoǹ-bi talku poondi.
U-yindi bí circir ki cáá tifaandi.
10Á fàŋkì ti-Dindaanee di sá iciin kílilaŋki.
Bin fàŋkí-u mimmee wálifì ní.
Ti-Dindaan nyɔŋkii bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_text:
God Blesses His Worshipers
1Shout praises to the Lord!
The Lord blesses everyone
who worships him and gladly
obeys his teachings.
2Their descendants will have
great power in the land,
because the Lord blesses
all who do right.
3They will get rich and prosper
and will always be remembered
for their fairness.
4They will be so kind
and merciful and good,
that they will be a light
in the dark for others
who do the right thing.
5Life will go well for those
who freely lend
and are honest in business.
6They won't ever be troubled,
and the kind things they do
will never be forgotten.
7Bad news won't bother them;
they have decided
to trust the Lord.
8They are dependable
and not afraid,
and they will live to see
their enemies defeated.
9 They will always be remembered
and greatly praised,
because they were kind
and freely gave to the poor.
10When evil people see this,
they angrily bite their tongues
and disappear.
They will never get
what they really want.
translation_text:
Deedeedambi naam!
1 Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!
Unil un fàŋkí ti-Dindaan
ní ki néeń u-marab tikpilee bí mmɔnneeee!
2U-naantiibi làá nīn sá bin cáá mpɔn kitiŋ puee ní.
Ti-Dindaan bìintí bin pɔbiliŋ bí dibee maaliŋu pu ní.
3Tigaajawan nì tigaajati bí u-dumpu,
ní u yú nì ti-Dindaan deedee kí nīn cá jaanjaan.
4Dibɔmbɔndi poonee, ŋwalifi nyēē ní
ki ŋmíntí bin pɔbil bí dibee.
Ti-Dindaan sá ulaŋŋaŋfiti
ní u-poon mɔ̄ ní u sá deedeedaan.
5An ŋān̄ unil ń sɔ̄ isaa kí nīn pìntí,
kí nīn tūǹ u-tuuŋŋi ki nóó nì marab!
6Tiba kaa pée ŋūǹ kí cìŋkì deedeedaan,
u-kpátam boonee, binib làá nīn pée téetí u-pu ní.
7Waa fàŋkí kubɔbiiu,
u máká ti-Dindaan pu ní u-pɔbil sɔ̀m̀.
8U-mákal bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄ ní waa fàŋkí tiba,
ní ki cí kí ká u-nannanliibi lítitam.
9U pūǹ bifalaadambi tiwan nì tiniti,
ní u-deedeeu bí ki cá jaanjaan.
U-pɔŋŋu yíkí yilpu nì tinyool.
10Unikpiti yaa ká-uee ní ú gíí diŋuul,
u ŋmóò u-nyiŋŋi ní u-wunti ń yɔ̀tī.
Unikpiti nín dàkafī puee dāa kúntí fám ní.

english_text:
The Lord Helps People in Need
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Everyone who serves him,
come and praise his name.
2Let the name of the Lord
be praised now and forever.
3From dawn until sunset
the name of the Lord
deserves to be praised.
4The Lord is far above
all of the nations;
he is more glorious
than the heavens.
5No one can compare
with the Lord our God.
His throne is high above,
6and he looks down to see
the heavens and the earth.
7God lifts the poor and needy
from dust and ashes,
8and he lets them take part
in ruling his people.
9When a wife has no children,
he blesses her with some,
and she is happy.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Laakin dimákal kpée, ti-Dindaan nāantí dimákal
1 Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!
Nimbi bin sá ti-Dindaan tɔntɔnliibee, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u,
nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan yindi.
2Tí jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan
kɔŋkɔnnee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan!
3Kí yòon̄ ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú
kí cáá sāā ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki púee,
bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan yindi!
4Ti-Dindaan di tɔ́kɔ́ atimbun kɔkɔ pu,
ní u-nyooti jítì kutagbɔŋu pu.
5Ŋma di bí kii ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu?
U bí doooo yilpu ki kā u-beejal pu,
6ní ki kpèeń kutagbɔŋu nì kitiŋ.
7U yòontí unandaan ntamin kí síiń,
u nyāntí ufalaadaan titampummool poon,
8kí dū-u kí kàan̄ abɔtibil kansikin,
u-nibul bɔtibiliŋ kansikin.
9U tìì unimpuŋmaŋŋmanti kucadii,
ní ú kpántí un bí mmɔnnee.
Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_text:
Come Praise the Lord
1 All of you nations,
come praise the Lord!
Let everyone praise him.
2God's love for us is wonderful;
his faithfulness never ends.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Atimbun kɔkɔ, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan
1Atimbun kɔkɔ, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!
Anibul kɔkɔ, pàkàmaan-u!
2Di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi din u cáá ti-puee pɔ̄ɔ̄.
Ti-Dindaan baamɔŋyi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_text:
The Lord Is Always Merciful
1 Tell the Lord
how thankful you are,
because he is kind
and always merciful.
2Let Israel shout,
“God is always merciful!”
3Let the family of Aaron
the priest shout,
“God is always merciful!”
4Let every true worshiper
of the Lord shout,
“God is always merciful!”
5When I was really hurting,
I prayed to the Lord.
He answered my prayer,
and took my worries away.
6 The Lord is on my side,
and I am not afraid
of what others can do to me.
7With the Lord on my side,
I will defeat
my hateful enemies.
8It is better to trust the Lord
for protection
than to trust anyone else,
9including strong leaders.
10Nations surrounded me,
but I got rid of them
by the power of the Lord.
11They attacked from all sides,
but I got rid of them
by the power of the Lord.
12They swarmed around like bees,
but by the power of the Lord,
I got rid of them
and their fiery sting.
13Their attacks were so fierce
that I nearly fell,
but the Lord helped me.
14 My power and my strength
come from the Lord,
and he has saved me.
15From the tents of God's people
come shouts of victory:
“The Lord is powerful!
16With his mighty arm
the Lord wins victories!
The Lord is powerful!”
17And so my life is safe,
and I will live to tell
what the Lord has done.
18He punished me terribly,
but he did not let death
lay its hands on me.
19Open the gates of justice!
I will enter and tell the Lord
how thankful I am.
20Here is the gate of the Lord!
Everyone who does right
may enter this gate.
21I praise the Lord
for answering my prayers
and saving me.
22 The stone that the builders
tossed aside
has now become
the most important stone.
23The Lord has done this,
and it is amazing to us.
24This day belongs to the Lord!
Let's celebrate
and be glad today.
25 We'll ask the Lord to save us!
We'll sincerely ask the Lord
to let us win.
26 God bless the one who comes
in the name of the Lord!
We praise you from here
in the house of the Lord.
27The Lord is our God,
and he has given us light!
Start the celebration!
March with palm branches
all the way to the altar.
28The Lord is my God!
I will praise him and tell him
how thankful I am.
29Tell the Lord
how thankful you are,
because he is kind
and always merciful.
translation_text:
M làá nīn bí dimaŋfalin kí māafì tin ti-Dindaan ŋée
1Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, di sá yii u ŋān̄,
ní u-neeŋkpaandi bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan.
2Isirayeel yab ń lì yii:
«U-neeŋkpaandi bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan!»
3 Aarɔn naantiibi ń lì yii:
«U-neeŋkpaandi bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan!»
4Bin bin fàŋkí ti-Dindaanee ń lì yii:
«U-neeŋkpaandi bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan!»
5M-nimbinaamandi poonee, m kúuǹ ki yíiń ti-Dindaan,
ti-Dindaan kíí-mi ní ki yāntì m tɔ́ m-ba.
6Ti-Dindaan bí m-cee, an puee maa fàŋkí tiba,
ba ní unil làá ŋmā kí ŋá-mi?
7Ti-Dindaan bí m-cee ní ki tútúǹ-mi,
m-nimbil làá ká bin ná-mee lítitam.
8An ŋān̄ á sāǹ kí kɔ́ ti-Dindaan
ki jítiǹ á nīn máká unil pu!
9An ŋān̄ á sāǹ kí kɔ́ ti-Dindaan
ki jítiǹ á nīn máká kitiŋ pu nikpaambi pu!
10Atimbun kɔkɔ nib nìn māntìi tú-mi,
ama ti-Dindaan yindi puee, m nāaǹ-bi.
11Ŋi nìn māntìi tú-mi an kɔkɔ pu,
ama ti-Dindaan yindi puee, m nāaǹ-bi.
12Ŋi nìn māntìi tú-mi kii inaŋgbansiiyee.
Bi kpíì malaa kii ikuŋkum ŋmiŋuee,
ti-Dindaan yindi puee, m nāaǹ-bi.
13Bi téé-mi mpɔn ḿ bàà lítí,
ama ní ti-Dindaan jòoń-mi.
14Ti-Dindaan di sá m-pɔŋŋu nì m-nyɔŋkii laŋŋu,
úǹ di fīī-mi.
15Ifaal nì dijajil laŋŋu
nyēeń deedeedambi tantib poon yii:
«Ti-Dindaan ŋaŋgiil tūǹ atuŋkpaan!
16Ti-Dindaan yōoǹ u-ŋaŋgiil yilpu,
ti-Dindaan ŋaŋgiil tūǹ atuŋkpaan.»
17Maa làá kpú, m làá nīn bí dimaŋfalin
kí māafì tin ti-Dindaan ŋée.
18Tiŋman ti-Dindaan dáaĺ m-tafal,
ama waa dū-mi ki ŋá ŋkúm ŋaan.
19Pìitīmaan-mi deedee punyɔmmu,
ḿ dī kí kɔ́ kí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan.
20Ti-Dindaan punyɔkɔki sèé:
deedeedambi ń dī kí kɔ́!
21M làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, di sá yii a kíí-mi,
ní ki fīī-mi.
22Ditaŋkpal din bidimaliibi nìn dūu fée
di kpántì ditaŋkpal din ŋúb́ kudii pɔŋŋuee.
23An nyánní ti-Dindaan cee ní,
an gbí mmaam ti-cee!
24Ŋwiin ŋun ti-Dindaan ŋée sɔ̀.
Ŋu-puee, tí nīn fàal̀ kí nīn bí dipɔɔpindin.
25Áù ti-Dindaan, fīī-ti!
Áù ti-Dindaan, tīī-ti dijajil!
26- Ti-Dindaan ń bìin̄ un dòoń u-yindi puee boon.
Doooo ti-Dindaan diikun ní ti mèé ki bìintí ni-pu.
27- Ti-Dindaan di sá Unimbɔti ní ki ŋmíntí-ti!
- Nín̄ ŋúb́maan asupan ki nóó tɔb
kí tin bà nsaraafan yiŋyi.
28Sii di sá m-Nimbɔtiu, ní m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si.
M-Nimbɔtiu, m làá yòon̄ a-yindi yilpu.
29Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, di sá yii u ŋān̄
ní u-neendi bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_text:
In Praise of the Law of the Lord
1Our Lord, you bless everyone
who lives right
and obeys your Law.
2You bless all those
who follow your commands
from deep in their hearts
3and who never do wrong
or turn from you.
4You have ordered us always
to obey your teachings;
5I don't ever want to stray
from your laws.
6Thinking about your commands
will keep me from doing
some foolish thing.
7I will do right and praise you
by learning to respect
your perfect laws.
8I will obey all of them!
Don't turn your back on me.
9Young people can live
a clean life
by obeying your word.
10I worship you
with all my heart.
Don't let me walk away
from your commands.
11I treasure your word
above all else;
it keeps me from sinning
against you.
12I praise you, Lord!
Teach me your laws.
13With my own mouth,
I tell others the laws
that you have spoken.
14Obeying your instructions
brings as much happiness
as being rich.
15I will study your teachings
and follow your footsteps.
16I will take pleasure
in your laws
and remember your words.
17Treat me with kindness, Lord,
so that I may live
and do what you say.
18Open my mind
and let me discover
the wonders of your Law.
19I live here as a stranger.
Don't keep me from knowing
your commands.
20What I want most
and at all times
is to honor your laws.
21You punish those boastful,
worthless nobodies who turn
from your commands.
22Don't let them sneer
and insult me
for following you.
23I keep thinking about
your teachings, Lord,
even if rulers plot
against me.
24Your laws are my greatest joy!
I follow their advice.
25I am at the point of death.
Let your teachings
breathe new life into me.
26When I told you my troubles,
you answered my prayers.
Now teach me your laws.
27Help me to understand
your teachings,
and I will think about
your marvelous deeds.
28I am overcome with sorrow.
Encourage me,
as you have promised to do.
29Keep me from being deceitful,
and be kind enough
to teach me your Law.
30I am determined to be faithful
and to respect your laws.
31I follow your rules, Lord.
Don't let me be ashamed.
32I am eager to learn all
that you want me to do;
help me to understand more.
33Point out your rules, Lord,
and I won't disobey
even one of them.
34Help me to understand your Law;
I promise to obey it
with all my heart.
35Direct me by your commands!
I love to do what you say.
36Make me want to obey you,
rather than to be rich.
37Take away my foolish desires,
and let me find life
by walking with you.
38I am your servant!
Do for me what you promised
to those who worship you.
39Your wonderful teachings
protect me from the insults
that I hate so much.
40I long for your teachings.
Be true to yourself
and let me live.
41Show me your love
and save me, Lord,
as you have promised.
42Then I will have an answer
for everyone who insults me
for trusting your word.
43I rely on your laws!
Don't take away my chance
to speak your truth.
44I will keep obeying your Law
forever and ever.
45I have gained perfect freedom
by following your teachings,
46and I trust them so much
that I tell them to kings.
47I love your commands!
They bring me happiness.
48I love and respect them
and will keep them in mind.
49Don't forget your promise
to me, your servant.
I depend on it.
50When I am hurting,
I find comfort in your promise
that leads to life.
51Conceited people sneer at me,
but I obey your Law.
52I find true comfort, Lord,
because your laws have stood
the test of time.
53I get furious when evil people
turn against your Law.
54No matter where I am,
your teachings
fill me with songs.
55Even in the night
I think about you, Lord,
and I obey your Law.
56You have blessed me
because I have always followed
your teachings.
57You, Lord, are my choice,
and I will obey you.
58With all my heart
I beg you to be kind to me,
just as you have promised.
59I pay careful attention
as you lead me,
and I follow closely.
60As soon as you command,
I do what you say.
61Evil people may set a trap,
but I obey your Law.
62Your laws are so fair
that I wake up and praise you
in the middle of the night.
63I choose as my friends
everyone who worships you
and follows your teachings.
64Our Lord, your love is seen
all over the world.
Teach me your laws.
65I am your servant, Lord,
and you have kept your promise
to treat me with kindness.
66Give me wisdom and good sense.
I trust your commands.
67Once you corrected me
for not obeying you,
but now I do obey.
68You are kindhearted,
and you do good things,
so teach me your laws.
69My reputation is being ruined
by conceited liars,
but with all my heart
I follow your teachings.
70Those liars have no sense,
but I find happiness
in your Law.
71When you corrected me,
it did me good
because it taught me
to study your laws.
72I would rather obey you
than to have a thousand pieces
of silver and gold.
73You created me
and put me together.
Make me wise enough to learn
what you have commanded.
74Your worshipers will see me,
and they will be glad
that I trust your word.
75Your decisions are correct,
and you were right
to punish me.
76I serve you, Lord.
Comfort me with your love,
just as you have promised.
77I love to obey your Law!
Have mercy and let me live.
78Put down those proud people
who hurt me with their lies,
because I have chosen
to study your teachings.
79Let your worshipers come to me,
so they will learn
to obey your rules.
80Let me truly respect your laws,
so I won't be ashamed.
81I long for you to rescue me!
Your word is my only hope.
82I am worn out from waiting
for you to keep your word.
When will you have mercy?
83My life is wasting away
like a dried-up wineskin,
but I have not forgotten
your teachings.
84I am your servant!
How long must I suffer?
When will you punish
those troublemakers?
85Those proud people reject
your teachings,
and they dig pits
for me to fall in.
86Your laws can be trusted!
Protect me from cruel liars.
87They have almost killed me,
but I have been faithful
to your teachings.
88Show that you love me
and let me live,
so that I may obey
your commands.
89Our Lord, you are eternal!
Your word will last as long
as the heavens.
90You remain faithful
in every generation,
and the earth you created
will keep standing firm.
91All things are your servants,
and the laws you made
are still in effect today.
92If I had not found happiness
in obeying your Law,
I would have died in misery.
93I won't ever forget
your teachings,
because you give me new life
when I follow them.
94I belong to you,
and I have respected your laws,
so keep me safe.
95Brutal enemies are waiting
to ambush and destroy me,
but I obey your rules.
96Nothing is completely perfect,
except your teachings.
97I deeply love your Law!
I think about it all day.
98Your laws never leave my mind,
and they make me much wiser
than my enemies.
99Thinking about your teachings
gives me better understanding
than my teachers,
100and obeying your laws
makes me wiser than those
who have lived a long time.
101I obey your word
instead of following a way
that leads to trouble.
102You have been my teacher,
and I won't reject
your instructions.
103Your teachings are sweeter
than honey.
104They give me understanding
and make me hate all lies.
105Your word is a lamp
that gives light
wherever I walk.
106Your laws are fair,
and I have given my word
to respect them all.
107I am in terrible pain!
Save me, Lord,
as you have promised.
108Accept my offerings of praise
and teach me your laws.
109I never forget your teachings,
although my life is always
in danger.
110Some merciless people
are trying to trap me,
but I never turn my back
on your teachings.
111They will always be
my most prized possession
and my source of joy.
112I have made up my mind
to obey your laws forever,
no matter what.
113I hate anyone
whose loyalty is divided,
but I love your Law.
114You are my place of safety
and my shield.
Your word is my only hope.
115All you worthless people,
get away from me!
I am determined to obey
the commands of my God.
116Be true to your word, Lord.
Keep me alive and strong;
don't let me be ashamed
because of my hope.
117Keep me safe and secure,
so that I will always
respect your laws.
118You reject all deceitful liars
because they refuse
your teachings.
119As far as you are concerned,
evil people are garbage,
and so I follow your rules.
120I tremble all over
when I think of you
and the way you judge.
121I did what was fair and right!
Don't hand me over to those
who want to mistreat me.
122Take good care of me,
your servant,
and don't let me be harmed
by those conceited people.
123My eyes are weary from waiting
to see you keep your promise
to come and save me.
124Show your love for me,
your servant,
and teach me your laws.
125I serve you,
so let me understand
your teachings.
126Do something, Lord!
They have broken your Law.
127Your laws mean more to me
than the finest gold.
128I follow all your commands,
but I hate anyone
who leads me astray.
129Your teachings are wonderful,
and I respect them all.
130Understanding your word
brings light to the minds
of ordinary people.
131I honestly want to know
everything you teach.
132Think about me and be kind,
just as you are to everyone
who loves your name.
133Keep your promise
and don't let me stumble
or let sin control my life.
134Protect me from abuse,
so I can obey your laws.
135Smile on me, your servant,
and teach me your laws.
136When anyone disobeys you,
my eyes overflow with tears.
137Our Lord, you always do right,
and your decisions are fair.
138All your teachings are true
and trustworthy.
139It upsets me greatly
when my enemies neglect
your teachings.
140Your word to me, your servant,
is like pure gold;
I treasure what you say.
141Everyone calls me a nobody,
but I remember your laws.
142You will always do right,
and your teachings are true.
143I am in deep distress,
but I love your teachings.
144Your rules are always fair.
Help me to understand them
and live.
145I pray to you, Lord!
Please answer me.
I promise to obey your laws.
146I beg you to save me,
so I can follow your rules.
147Even before sunrise,
I pray for your help,
and I put my hope
in what you have said.
148I lie awake at night,
thinking of your promises.
149Show that you love me, Lord,
and answer my prayer.
Please do the right thing
and save my life.
150People who disobey your Law
have made evil plans
and want to hurt me,
151but you are with me,
and all your commands
can be trusted.
152From studying your laws,
I found out long ago
you made them to last forever.
153I have not forgotten your Law!
Look at the trouble I am in,
and rescue me.
154Be my defender and protector!
Remember your promise
and save my life.
155Evil people won't obey you,
and so they have no hope
of being saved.
156You are merciful, Lord!
