Please do the right thing
and save my life.
157I have a lot of brutal enemies,
but still I never turn
from your laws.
158Those unfaithful people
who refuse to obey you
are disgusting to me.
159Remember how I love your laws,
and show your love for me
by keeping me safe.
160All you say can be trusted;
your teachings are true
and will last forever.
161Rulers are cruel to me
for no reason.
But with all my heart
I respect your words,
162because they bring happiness
like treasures taken in war.
163I can't stand liars,
but I love your Law.
164I praise you seven times a day
because your laws are fair.
165You give peace of mind
to all who love your Law.
Nothing can make them fall.
166You are my only hope
for being saved, Lord,
and I do all you command.
167I love and obey your laws
with all my heart.
168You know everything I do.
You know I respect every law
you have given.
169Please, Lord, hear my prayer
and give me the understanding
that comes from your word.
170Listen to my concerns
and keep me safe,
just as you have promised.
171If you will teach me your laws,
I will praise you 172and sing
about your promise,
because all your teachings
are what they ought to be.
173Be ready to protect me
because I have chosen
to obey your laws.
174I am waiting for you
to save me, Lord.
Your Law makes me happy.
175Keep me alive,
so I can praise you,
and let me find help
in your teachings.
176I am your servant,
but I have wandered away
like a lost sheep.
Please come after me,
because I have not forgotten
your teachings.
translation_text:
Unimbɔti marab nyɔŋkii
1Unil un baa kāntí tikpitil tiba u-saŋkindi poon,
ní u ŋáań ti-Dindaan marab nín bí yii ú ŋá puee bí mmɔnneeee!
2Bin ŋúb́ u-bɔkpaaŋi
ní ki nyàab̀-u nì bi-pɔbiliŋ kɔkɔee bí mmɔnneeee!
3An nibee kaa ŋáań tikpitil,
bi nóó u-saŋŋu ní.
4Sii ti-Dindaan di tīī-ti a-bɔkpaaŋi
ní ki là yii tí nīn ŋúb́-ŋi tiŋan.
5Yàntī ḿ nīn cáá mbimbimɔntiim
kí nīn tɔ́ a-koobiliŋ.
6Niinee, m-nimbikpeeŋu yaa bá a-marab kɔkɔ puee,
icoo kaa làá cúú-mi.
7M làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si nì dipɔbil diba
kí nīn bífí tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹ tì bí deedeeyee.
8M làá nīn ŋúb́ a-koobiliŋ,
taa dū-mi kí fá kɔkɔ.
*
9Mana ní unaacimpɔɔn ŋūǹ kí nīn cáá mbimbim min bí circiree?
- See ú nīn ŋúb́ a-nyɔɔbundi.
10M nyàab̄-si nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ,
taa yàntī ḿ kàkatī kí wàatī a-marab.
11M kpáafí a-nyɔɔbundi m-pɔbilin
án nín làá ŋá pu ḿ taa yìntīǹ-see.
12Ti-Dindaan, si nì ditundi,
a nín dàkā-mi a-koobiliŋee pu.
13M-nyɔkɔ làá māafì
tin ní a sòon̄ ki síiǹee.
14M yaa nóó a-bɔkpaaŋee, an mɔ̄ǹ-mi
kii m ká tigaajakpaandee.
15M làá dàkafì a-bɔkpaaŋi pu
ní m-nimbikpeeŋu ń nīn bá a-saŋyi pu.
16An mɔ̄ǹ-mi a-koobiliŋ pu,
maa súntí a-nyɔɔbundi pu.
*
17Ŋá man a-tɔntɔnliu tiŋan
ḿ nīn bí dimaŋfalin, ní kí nīn ŋúb́ a-nyɔɔbundi.
18Ŋúbití m-nimbiliŋ ní ḿ ŋmā kí wāl̀
maamaacib bin bí a-marab poonee.
19Unicaan ní m sá kitiŋ nee pu,
taa dū a-marab kí báĺ-mi.
20M-naŋki fèefī ki nyàab̀
tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee ŋyunti kamaa.
21A kpàtī bilambidambi bin bi tɔ́ mbusu,
bi fàtī bi-boon ki tìì a-marabee pu.
22Kàkatī icoo nì kpeefam kí wàatī-mi,
di sá yii m ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi.
23Báà abɔtibil yaa kpáfì ki bíi sòoǹ
ki bɔ́ntí m-pu tibɔkpitilaaa,
man a-tɔntɔnliu làá nīn pée dàkafī a-koobiliŋ pu ní.
24An mɔ̄ǹ-mi a-bɔkpaaŋi pu,
ŋíǹ di sá m-saŋkiliibi.
*
25M dɔ̄ kitiŋ ntamin,
fàtīí tīī-mi dimaŋfal kí nóó nì a-nyɔɔbundi.
26M tùkū-si m-bimbim nín bí puee ní a kíí-mi,
dàkà-mi a-koobiliŋ.
27Yàntī ḿ gbìl̄ a-bɔkpaaŋi taapu,
ní ḿ dàkafì a-maamaaci tuuŋŋi pu.
28Kunimbaau yāntì nnyinnyim nyáń-mi,
fàtīí tīī-mi mpɔn kí nóó nì a-nyɔɔbundi.
29Kàkatī nnyimɔn saŋŋu kí wàatī-mi,
ní a-laŋŋaŋfitiiku poonee, á yàntī ḿ béé a-marab.
30M lēē ibaamɔn saŋŋu,
m tɔ́ tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee.
31M dū m-ba ki nákáǹ a-bɔkpaaŋi,
ti-Dindaan, taa yàntī icoo ń jī-mi.
32M bìǹ ki nyàab̀ kí nóó a-marab saŋŋu,
di sá yii a yāntì m tɔ́ m-ba.
*
33Ti-Dindaan, dàkà-mi a-koobiliŋ saŋŋu,
m làá nīn nóó-ŋu kí tin cáá kátí.
34Tīī-mi dinyil ḿ dūú ŋúb́ a-marab,
m làá nīn tɔ́-bi nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ.
35Kpòotī-mi kí tàkan̄ a-marab saŋŋu pu,
di sá yii bi-poon ní m kāntí m-mɔŋŋu.
36Kpòon̄ m-pɔbil kí gíiǹ a-bɔkpaaŋi watil pú
kí taa yàntī dí kpòon̄ kí gítí dulim gaajati pú.
37Cúú m-nimbikpeeŋu kí páatí tin kaa bí tibanee pu,
kí yàntī ḿ nīn bí a-saŋŋu poon.
38A nín pōoǹ kí ŋá kí tīī bin fàŋkí-see puee,
ŋá míǹ kí tīī man a-tɔntɔnliu.
39Kàkatī m-cooi in fàantí-mi nee kí wàatī-mi,
di sá yii tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee di ŋān̄.
40Tiŋman, m lafun néeń a-bɔkpaaŋi,
a-deedeeu puee, fàtīí tīī-mi dimaŋfal.
*
41Ti-Dindaan, dàkà-mi a-neeŋkpaandi,
fīī-mi kí nóó nì a nín lī puee.
42Niinee m làá ká dinyɔɔbundi kí kíí bin sìí-mee,
di sá yii a-nyɔɔbundi pu ní m máká.
43Yàntī ibaamɔn nyɔɔbuŋŋi ń nīn pée nyēē m-nyɔkɔn ŋyunti kamaa,
di sá yii tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee pu ní m máká.
44M làá nīn pée ŋúb́ a-marau ní
kí nīn pée cáa cá jaanjaan.
45M làá nīn còom̄ ki tɔ́ m-ba,
di sá yii a-bɔkpaaŋi ní m nyàab̀.
46M làá sòoǹ a-bɔkpaaŋi pu bibɔtiibi nimbiin
ní an kaa làá nīn cáá-mi icoo.
47A-marab tìì mmɔn,
di sá yii m néeń-bi ní.
48M yòontí m-ŋalii kí túĺ a-marab watil pú,
di sá yii m néeń-bi.
M làá dàkafì a-bɔkpaaŋi pu.
*
49Téetí dinyɔɔbundi din a lī man a-tɔntɔnliu puee,
di-pu ní m máká.
50Báà m yaa bí falaa poonaaa, m kāntí diŋmeendi,
di sá yii tin a sòon̄ee di tìì-mi dimaŋfal.
51Bilambidambi bēel̀-mi tikpil,
ama maa fātì m-boon ki tīī a-marab.
52Ti-Dindaan, m téetí tin a nìn sòon̄ ki síiǹ dooooyee pu,
an di tìì-mi diŋmeendi.
53M yaa ká binikpitib nín féeń a-marab puee,
m fòol̄ mbum ŋkpitim pu ní.
54Kitiŋ kin pu m kā kunicaŋu nee,
a-bɔkpaaŋi di kpántì m-laŋyi.
55Ti-Dindaan, m téetí a-yindi pu kunyeeu,
ní ki ŋúb́ a-marab.
56Tin di sá m-yatee
di sá ḿ nīn ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi.
*
57Ti-Dindaan, m lī yii dijandi din m lēēyee
di sá ḿ nīn ŋúb́ a-nyɔɔbundi.
58M nyàab̄ kí nīn fáatiǹ-si nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ,
sɔ̄ m-saai kí nóó nì tin a sòon̄ee.
59M dākafì m-saŋkindi pu,
m là kí fàtīí nīn tɔ́ a-bɔkpaaŋi.
60M làá ŋá malaa, maa làá tàan̄
kí ŋúb́ a-marab.
61Binikpitib ŋmiii māntìi tú-mi,
ama maa súntí a-marab pu.
62M yíkí kunyataasiiu ní kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si,
di sá yii tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee bí deedee.
63M-bɔɔbi di sá bin kɔkɔ fàŋkí-si
ní ki ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋee.
64Ti-Dindaan, a-neeŋkpaandi gbí kitiŋ kɔkɔ pu,
dàkà-mi a-koobiliŋ.
*
65Ti-Dindaan, a ŋá man a-tɔntɔnliu tiŋan
ki nóó nì a-nyɔɔbundi.
66Dàkà-mi nlandɔkɔmɔnti nì dinyil,
di sá yii m máká a-marab pu.
67Kí wàatī á sìntīǹ-mi taapuee, m nìn gáatì ní,
ama kɔŋkɔnnee, m kíǹ ki ŋúb́ tin a sòon̄ee ní.
68A ŋān̄ ní ki ŋáań tin ŋān̄ee,
dàkà-mi a-koobiliŋ.
69Bilambidambi sòon̄ tinyimɔmbɔti ki bíil̀-mi,
ama mamee, m ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ ní.
70Bi-pɔbiliŋ tīlifì,
ama mamee, a-marab di tìì-mi mmɔn.
71A nín sīntiǹ-mi taapuee ŋá-mi tiŋan,
di sá yii an tútuǹ-mi m bífì a-koobiliŋ.
*
72Marab bin nyáń a-nyɔkɔnee ŋān̄ m-cee
ki jítiǹ sindaariya nì animbil kúti kutukub cutimaanyi.
73A dū a-ŋalii ní ki máń-mi ní ki tīī-mi mpɔn,
tīī-mi dinyil ḿ dūú bīfì a-marab.
74Bin fàŋkí-see yaa ká-mee, bi fàal̀ ní,
di sá yii a-nyɔɔbundi pu ní m máká.
75Ti-Dindaan, m nyí tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee nín sá deedeeyee,
ní a cáá ibaamɔn a nín sīntiǹ-mi taapuee.
76A-neeŋkpaandee ń dāan̄ kɔŋkɔnnee kí ŋméeǹ-mi,
kii a nín sòon̄ man a-tɔntɔnliu puee.
77Dàkà-mi a-poommɔŋŋu ḿ nīn bí dimaŋfalin,
di sá yii a-marab di tìì-mi mmɔn.
78Icoo ń cúú bilambidambi bin kɔ́kɔĺ-mi fámee!
Mamee, m làá nīn dàkafī a-bɔkpaaŋi pu.
79Bin fàŋkí-see ń dāan̄ m-cee
kí béé a-bɔkpaaŋi.
80M làá nīn ŋúb́ a-koobiliŋ nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ,
án nín làá ŋá pu icoo ń taa cúú-mee.
*
81M kāl̀ ki cíitì a-fiil ki tin kpáàa gīī,
m kā ki máká a-nyɔɔbundi pu.
82M kpēē tin a sòon̄ee saŋŋu pú m-nimbiliŋ tin kpáàa lóoĺ,
ní m bàlifī yii: «Ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní a làá ŋméeǹ-mi ní?»
83M sá kii kuloou kun ŋŋminyiim ŋɔ́fì ku bɔ̄ntèe ní,
ama maa súntì a-koobiliŋ pu.
84Iwiin iŋa di kíǹ man a-tɔntɔnliu ḿ nīn bí dimaŋfalin ní?
Ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní a làá sòoǹ bin sàantí-mee bɔti ní?
85Bin yòontí bi-ba yilpu kaa fātìi tɔ́ a-marabee
gbìn̄ mbòó ki píĺ kí sàl̄-mi.
86A-marab kɔkɔ sá ibaamɔn marab ní,
maa ŋá tiba ní bi bíi sàantí-mi, dāá jòoń-mi.
87Bi nìn ŋman kūū-mi ki dóò ní,
ama maa dū a-bɔkpaaŋi ki fá.
88A-neeŋkpaandi puee, tīī-mi dimaŋfal
ní ḿ nīn ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi.
*
89Ti-Dindaan, a-nyɔɔbundi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,
dì bá yilpu ki pɔ̄ɔ̄ kiŋkiŋ.
90A-deedeeu bí kí nīn cá abin abin.
A báaǹ kitiŋ ní kì bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄.
91Tikɔkɔ bí ti-laŋki ki dāa sāā díǹ ki nóó nì tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee,
di sá yii tin kɔkɔ bí duulinyanee sá a-tɔntɔnliibi ní.
92A-marab yaa kaa bàà sá kun tìì-mi mmɔnnee,
kɔnampu falaa bàà kūū-mi.
93M kpá kí súntí a-bɔkpaaŋi pu jaanjaan,
di sá yii a dī ŋi-pu ní ki tīī-mi dimaŋfal.
94Sii di yì-mi, fīī-mi,
di sá yii a-bɔkpaaŋi bɔti di páb́-mi.
95Binikpitib cí kí lēē m-maŋfal,
ama m dàkafī a-bɔkpaaŋi pu.
96M dáań ki ká yii ki kpáaǹ tin ŋān̄ee cáá kigbeennyɔkɔ,
ama a-marab bí ní ki cá talku.
*
97M néeń a-marabeeee!
M dàkafī bi-pu ŋwiin kamaa.
98A-marab yāntì m cáá iciin ki jítiǹ m-nannanliibi,
di sá yii m dū-bi ki gāā m-bindi kí nīn cá jaanjaan.
99M nyíǹ m-dàkaliibi kɔkɔ,
di sá yii m dàkafī a-bɔkpaaŋi pu.
100M nyíǹ bitikpilib,
di sá yii m kpáafí a-bɔkpaaŋi.
101M yíì kí nóó isaŋkpiti
kí ŋmā kí nīn ŋúb́ a-nyɔɔbundi.
102Maa fātì m-boon ki tīī a nín sòon̄ pu ki síiǹee,
di sá yii sii di dàkà-mi.
103Tin a sòon̄ee mɔ̄ m-nyɔkɔn cɔ́ncɔŋ
ki jítiǹ tisiil.
104A-bɔkpaaŋi puee, m cáá dinyil,
an pu ní m ná tinyimɔmbɔti kɔkɔ.
*
105A-nyɔɔbundi sá fitila ní ki ŋmíntí laakin m còom̄ee,
ŋwalifi ki ŋmíntí m-saŋŋu.
106M pūtì ki pōoǹ kí ŋúb́ tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹ tì bí deedeeyee,
ní ki lafun làá ŋá míǹ.
107M jíń falaa tikpilku,
ti-Dindaan, tīī-mi dimaŋfal kí nóó nì a-nyɔɔbundi.
108Ti-Dindaan, nlammɔntiim saraau un nyēē m-nyɔkɔnee ń fáatíǹ-si,
kí dàkà-mi tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee.
109M bí dinimbinaamandin ní baabadal,
ama maa súntì a-marau pu.
110Min kamaa binikpitib píĺ-mi kutaliŋŋuee,
maa kākatì ki wāatì a-bɔkpaaŋi.
111A-bɔkpaaŋi di sá m-fakal kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan,
ŋíǹ di tìì m-pɔbil mmɔn.
112M lēē m-pɔbilin kí ŋá a-koobiliŋ nín bí yii ḿ ŋá puee,
m-paatii dee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.
*
113M ná milimilidambi,
ama ní ki néeń a-marau.
114Sii di sá m-balilaŋki nì m-gbampɔɔl.
M máká a-nyɔɔbundi pu.
115Binikpitibee, sútímaan kí wàatī-mi,
ní ḿ nīn ŋúb́ m-Nimbɔtiu marab.
116Nín̄ tíkí-mi kii a nín sòon̄ puee ní ḿ nīn bí dimaŋfalin,
taa kɔ́ǹ-mi icoo m-mákal poon.
117Tíkiń-mi ní ḿ ká difiil,
m-nimbikpeeŋu làá nīn pée cɔ́ a-koobiliŋ pu ní.
118A dū bin kɔkɔ kākatì ki wāatì a-koobiliŋee ki fá,
di sá yii bi-ŋáaǹtam sá nnyimɔn ní.
119A féeń kitiŋ pu nikpitib kɔkɔ kii timool tin bi féeń ditampundi puee ní,
an pu ní m néeń a-bɔkpaaŋi.
120M-wunti kɔkɔ jìkì nì kufaaŋŋu a-nimbiin,
ní a nín sòon̄ pu ki síiǹee fàantí-mi.
*
121M tɔ́ tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee ki ŋá tin bí deedeeyee,
taa dū-mi kí ŋá bin sàantí-mee ŋaan.
122Líí man a-tɔntɔnliu dimákal yii m làá ká nnaam,
yii bilambidambi kaa ti làá sàaǹ-mi!
123M kpēē a-jòońdi nì difiil din a pōoǹee saŋŋu pú
m-nimbiliŋ tin kpáàa gīī.
124Dàkà man a-tɔntɔnliu a-neeŋkpaandi,
bīfì-mi a-koobiliŋ.
125M sá a-tɔntɔnliu ní, tīī-mi dinyil
ḿ béé a-bɔkpaaŋi.
126Ti-Dindaan, ŋyunti bàn̄ á tɔ̄ a-tundi:
bi yīntiǹ a-marau.
127An pu ní m néeń a-marab ki jítiǹ sindaariya,
ki jítiǹ sindaariyamɔmmɔnti pu.
128M ká yii a-bɔkpaaŋi kɔkɔ bí deedee ní,
m ná tinyimɔmbɔti kɔkɔ.
*
129A-bɔkpaaŋi sá maamaaci bɔkpaaŋi,
an pu ní m pɔ̄ɔntí ki dī-ŋi.
130Unil yaa ká a-nyɔɔbundee, dì tìì-u ŋwalifi ní,
dì tìì sɔkɔmii nib dinyil.
131M-nyɔkɔ wāā bàaa m fátí diniindi,
di sá yii m baasii néeń a-marab ní.
132Fàtīń a-ba kí túĺ-mi kí sɔ̄ m-saai,
kii a nín sòon̄ ki síiǹ kí ŋá bin néeń-see puee.
133Dū a-nyɔɔbundi kí tīī-mi dimákal,
taa yàntī tikpitil tiba ń nyàŋkiǹ-mi.
134Fōō-mi bin sàantí-mee ŋaan kí líí,
ní ḿ nīn ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi.
135Bútí man a-tɔntɔnliu pu nnimbiin,
ní kí bīfì-mi a-koobiliŋ.
136M-nyinnyim pùub̀ kii mbunee,
di sá yii baa ŋúb́ a-marab.
*
137Ti-Dindaan, a sá deedeedaan ní,
ní tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee tèen̄.
138A-bɔkpaaŋi ŋin a tīīyee sá deedee
ní bi ŋūǹ kí nīn máká ŋi-pu.
139M-bum fòol̄ m-ni lìblib kii ŋŋmee,
kun puee m-nannanliibi súntí a-nyɔɔbundi pu.
140Bi cɔ́ŋkì ki béè tin a sòon̄ee baamɔŋyi,
ní man a-tɔntɔnliu néeń-tì.
141Maa bí tiban ní bi kpèé-mi fám,
ama maa súntì a-bɔkpaaŋi pu.
142A-deedeeu sá deedee un bí ki cá jaanjaanee,
ní a-marab sá ibaamɔn marab.
143Dinimbinaamandi nì kunimbaau cúú-mi,
ama a-marab di tìì-mi mmɔn.
144A-bɔkpaaŋi bí deedee ní ki cá jaanjaan,
tīī-mi dinyil ḿ nīn bí dimaŋfalin.
*
145M kúuǹ ki yíiń-si nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ,
kíí-mi, ti-Dindaan, m làá nīn ŋúb́ a-koobiliŋ.
146M kúuǹ ki yíiń-si, dāá fīī-mi
ní ḿ nīn ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi.
147M yíkì ntaafaabɔmbɔm ki kúuǹ ki yíiń-si,
m máká a-nyɔɔbundi pu.
148Kunyamɔŋu kɔkɔee, maa pée dáb́,
ki bí ki dàkafī tin a sòon̄ee pu.
149Pīlifiǹ-mi a-neeŋkpaandi poon, ti-Dindaan,
tīī-mi dimaŋfal kí nóó nì tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee.
150Bin sáń ki pá ikpiti boonee sútì ki pìlīń-mi,
bi sáǹ ki wāatì a-marab.
151Ama sii ti-Dindaan pìlīǹ-mi,
ní a-marab kɔkɔ sá ibaamɔn.
152Dooooyee ní m nyí yii a tīī a-bɔkpaaŋi
ŋí nīn bí ki cá jaanjaan.
*
153Kpèè m-falaau kí fīī-mi,
di sá yii maa súntì a-marab pu.
154Mɔ̄tì m-pu ní kí dā-mi kí líí,
tīī-mi dimaŋfal kii a nín sòon̄ puee.
155Difiil dátiǹ binikpitib,
di sá yii baa nyàab̀ a-koobiliŋ.
156Ti-Dindaan, a-poon mɔ̄ tikpilku.
Tīī-mi dimaŋfal kí nóó nì tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee.
157Bin sàantí-mee nì m-nannanliibi wīikí tikpil,
ama maa fātì m-boon ki tīī a-bɔkpaaŋi.
158M ká bin nyēē binib boonee ní m-naŋki nyáń nì bi,
di sá yii baa ŋúb́ a nín sòon̄ puee.
159Ti-Dindaan, kpèè m nín néeń a-bɔkpaaŋi puee.
Tīī-mi dimaŋfal kí nóó nì a-neeŋkpaandi.
160A-nyɔɔbundi nyeel di sá ibaamɔn,
ní tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee bí deedee kí nīn cá jaanjaan.
*
161Abɔtibil sāaǹ-mi an kaa cáá taapu,
ama kun m-pɔbil fàŋkée di sá a-nyɔɔbundi.
162M fàal̀ tin a sòon̄ee pu,
a lì kii tigaajakpaandi tiba ní m kée.
163M ná nnyimɔn, an cáá-mi titantan,
ama a-marab ní m néeń.
164M nyɔ́ŋkí-si ŋfunyɔm mita ní ŋwiin
tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee nín sá deedeeyee pu.
165Bin néeń a-marabee bí dipɔɔsɔŋkilin ní,
tiba kaa ŋūǹ kí yàntī bí gbéetí kí lítí.
166Ti-Dindaan, m máká a-fiil pu,
ní ki tɔ́ a-marab.
167M ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi,
m baasii néeń-ŋi ní.
168M ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi nì a-bɔkpaafikaati,
di sá yii a nyí tin kɔkɔ m ŋáańee.
*
169Ti-Dindaan, yàntī m-kuŋkuuntii ń bàń-si,
tīī-mi dinyil kí nóó nì a-nyɔɔbundi.
170Yàntī m-gbaamii ń bàń-si,
fīī-mi kí nóó nì a nín sòon̄ puee.
171M-nyunculiŋ ń tábití kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si,
di sá yii a dàkà-mi a-koobiliŋ.
172M-nyɔkɔ làá dū tin a sòon̄ee kí gāā ilan,
di sá yii a-marab kɔkɔ bí deedee ní.
173Tàntī a-ŋal kí jòoń-mi,
di sá yii a-bɔkpaaŋi ní m lēē.
174Ti-Dindaan, kun m baasii lèe di sá á fīī-mi,
ní tin tìì-mi mmɔnee di sá a-marau.
175Tīī-mi dimaŋfal ḿ ŋmā kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si,
ní kí yàntī tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee ń tūtuǹ-mi.
176M tú ki yìiǹ kii dipibil din wáŋkèe.
Nyàab̀ man a-tɔntɔnliu,
di sá yii maa súntì a-marab pu.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1When I am in trouble, I pray,
2“Come and save me, Lord,
from deceitful liars!”
3What punishment is fitting
for you deceitful liars?
4Your reward should be
sharp and flaming arrows!
5But I must live as a foreigner
among the people of Meshech
and in the tents of Kedar.
6I have spent too much time
living among people
who hate peace.
7I am in favor of peace,
but when I speak of it,
all they want is war.
translation_text:
Unil un bi bíi kɔ́kɔĺee wimmeem
1Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà-ŋu.
M-nimbinaamandi poonee,
m kúuǹ ki yíiń ti-Dindaan ní u kíí-mi.
2«Ti-Dindaan, fīī-mi kí nyāntí binyimɔndambi
nì bikiililiibi ŋaan.»
3Nimbi bikiililiibee,
ditafadaaldi dilal bulifi ní Unimbɔti làá tīī-ni ní?
4- U làá dū kujaau piiŋyi,
nì Amɔsiŋkoon ŋin fòol̄ lìblibee ní kí dáaĺ ni-tafal.
5Mbusu dɔ̄ ki cí-mi m nín kɔ́ Meeseeki tiŋkinee,
nì m nín kāl̀ Keedaar yab kansikinee.
6M kāl̀ binib bin ná ŋgbansɔŋfee
kansikin ki yúntì tikpil.
7M yaa bíi sòoǹ nì bi nì ŋgbansɔŋfee,
ní bíǹ là kujaau.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Will Protect His People
1I look to the hills!
Where will I find help?
2It will come from the Lord,
who created heaven and earth.
3The Lord is your protector,
and he won't go to sleep
or let you stumble.
4The protector of Israel
doesn't doze
or ever get drowsy.
5The Lord is your protector,
there at your right side
to shade you from the sun.
6You won't be harmed
by the sun during the day
or by the moon at night.
7The Lord will protect you
and keep you safe
from all dangers.
8The Lord will protect you
now and always
wherever you go.
translation_text:
Ŋma làá ŋmā kí jòoń-mi dee?
1Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà-ŋu.
M wáaǹ ki kpēē ajoon watil pú:
la ní m-jòońdi làá nyānní ní?
2- M-jòońdi nyánní ti-Dindaan
un náań yilpu nì taapuee cee ní.
3Waa làá yàntī a-taal ń ŋàtī,
un cí-see kaa gèeǹ ki yìntī!
4Kpèè, un cí Isirayeelee
kaa dáb̀aaa, kaa gèeǹ mun.
5Ti-Dindaan di sá un cí-see,
ti-Dindaan wúń a-pu. U bí a-tikindi.
6Ŋwiimpuɔɔɔ, ŋwìiń kaa làá gbá-si,
kunyeeuaaa, uŋmal kaa làá ŋá-si tiba.
7Ti-Dindaan làá nyāntí-si tibɔkpitil kamaa poon,
u làá nīn cí a-naŋki.
8Ti-Dindaan làá nīn cí-si a-cùtam nì a-gítintam
kí yòon̄ kɔŋkɔnnee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan!

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
A Song of Praise
1It made me glad when they said,
“Let's go to the house
of the Lord!”
2Jerusalem, we are standing
inside your gates.
3Jerusalem, what a strong
and beautiful city you are!
4Every tribe of the Lord
obeys him and comes to you
to praise his name.
5David's royal throne is here
where justice rules.
6Jerusalem, we pray
that you will have peace,
and that all will go well
for those who love you.
7May there be peace
inside your city walls
and in your palaces.
8Because of my friends
and my relatives,
I will pray for peace.
9And because of the house
of the Lord our God,
I will work for your good.
translation_text:
Mèèmaan Jeerusaleem ń ká ŋgbansɔŋfi
1Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà-ŋu.
An mɔ́ɔkiǹ-mi ŋyunti ŋun bi bí-mi yii:
«Tí cùmaan ti-Dindaan diikunee.»
2Jeerusaleem, ti bāań
ki yú a-punyɔmmu nyɔkɔpu!
3Jeerusaleem tiŋki, bi máń-si tiŋan,
a-jaŋŋi kɔkɔ kpáfì ki ŋá ubaanti ki ŋān̄.
4Niin ní Isirayeel naakɔti, ti-Dindaan naakɔti dòoń
ki nyɔ́ŋkí ti-Dindaan,
kii an nín sá dibɔkpaal pu Isirayeel tiŋkinee.
5Di sá yii niin ní ibɔsoon beejaliŋ,
Daafiidi dicaŋku beejaliŋ bí.
6Mèèmaan yii Jeerusaleem ń ká ŋgbansɔŋfi:
Jeerusaleem, bin néeń-see ń nīn bí dipɔɔsɔŋkilin!
7Ŋgbansɔŋfi ń nīn bí a-guŋŋi poon,
dipɔɔsɔŋkil ń nīn bí ubɔti dicaŋku poon!
8M-nabiyaamu nì m-bɔɔbi puee,
m mèé yii: «Ŋgbansɔŋfi ń nīn bí a-cee!»
9Ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu diiku puee,
m mèé yii án bútí-si.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for Mercy
1Our Lord and our God,
I turn my eyes to you,
on your throne in heaven.
2Servants look to their master,
but we will look to you,
until you have mercy on us.
3Please have mercy, Lord!
We have been insulted
more than we can stand,
4and we can't take more abuse
from those proud,
conceited people.
translation_text:
Bin bi kpēē ki sīŋkiǹee mákal
1Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà-ŋu.
M wáaǹ ki kpēē sii un kā a-beejal pu
yilpuee watil pú.
2Kii iyumbu nimbikpeeŋu nín cɔ́ bi-kpiliu ŋal pu puee,
kii utɔntɔnli unimpu nimbikpeeŋu nín cɔ́ u-kpiliu pu puee,
míǹ ní ti-mun nimbikpeeŋu cɔ́ ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu pu,
ki cí ú sɔ̄ ti-saai.
3Sɔ̄ isaa, ti-Dindaan, sɔ̄ isaa!
di sá yii bi gíti kpēē-ti fám an jítì mara pu.
4Bilambidambi sīī-ti an gíti lákatì,
bin yòontí bi-ba yilpuee kpēē-ti fám an nyāŋkì.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
Thanking the Lord for Victory
1The Lord was on our side!
Let everyone in Israel say:
2“The Lord was on our side!
Otherwise, the enemy attack
3would have killed us all,
because it was furious.
4We would have been swept away
in a violent flood
5of high and roaring waves.”
6Let's praise the Lord!
He protected us from enemies
who were like wild animals,
7and we escaped like birds
from a hunter's torn net.
8The Lord made heaven and earth,
and he is the one
who sends us help.
translation_text:
Ti-Dindaan u-ba di sá ti-jòońliu
1Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà-ŋu.
Ti-Dindaan yaa kaa bàà nìn bí ti-ceeyee...
- Isirayeel ń bùsì kí lì yii:
2«Ti-Dindaan yaa kaa bàà nìn bí ti-ceeyee» -
binib nín nìn yíkì ki bíi jáà nì tee,
3bi-ŋuul nín nìn fòol̄ ti-pu lìblib kii ŋŋmee,
bi bàà nìn dū-ti ki náĺ nì ti-nimbiliŋ.
4Nnyim bàà nìn yōoǹ-ti,
mbunni nyim bàà nìn bīiǹ ti-pu.
5Mbuŋkpaan nyim
bàà nìn bīiǹ ti-pu ti múĺ.
6Ti jáaḿ ti-Dindaan u nín kaa yāntì
ti-nannanliibi tɔ̄ntì-tee!
7Ti sáǹ ki nyáń kii unoon nín sáń kí nyā ukpan laaŋkun puee ní,
kulaaŋŋu cúu tīl̀ ní ti sáǹ ki ŋmátì.
8Ti-Dindaan u-ba di sá ti-jòońliu,
úǹ di náań yilpu nì taapu.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord's People Are Safe
1Everyone who trusts the Lord
is like Mount Zion
that cannot be shaken
and will stand forever.
2Just as Jerusalem is protected
by mountains on every side,
the Lord protects his people
by holding them in his arms
now and forever.
3He won't let the wicked
rule his people
or lead them to do wrong.
4Let's ask the Lord to be kind
to everyone who is good
and completely obeys him.
5When the Lord punishes
the wicked,
he will punish everyone else
who lives an evil life.
Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_text:
Bin máká ti-Dindaan puee
1Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee.
Bin máká ti-Dindaan puee
bí kii Siiyɔn joolee ní,
dàa cìŋkī,
di bí ní ki cá talku.
2Kii ajoon nín māntìi tú Jeerusaleem tiŋki puee,
míǹ ní ti-Dindaan māntìi tú u-nibul,
kí yòon̄ kɔŋkɔnnee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.
3Ubɔti un sá unikpitee
kaa làá ŋmā kí kpòotī deedeedambi tiŋki,
an yaa sá fám, bi mun làá dāá kíĺ kí nīn bíi ŋáań tikpitil.
4Ti-Dindaan, bin ŋáań tiŋanee,
bin pɔbil bí diba nì see,
dàkà-bi a-laŋŋaŋfitiiku.
5Ama bin dī isaŋkpitee,
ti-Dindaan, ŋàtī-bi kí fá,
kí kpáaǹ bikpitiŋaliibi!
M mèé yii ŋgbansɔŋfi ń nīn bí Isirayeel pu!

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Celebrating the Harvest
1It seemed like a dream
when the Lord brought us back
to the city of Zion.
2We celebrated with laughter
and joyful songs.
In foreign nations it was said,
“The Lord has worked miracles
for his people.”
3And so we celebrated
because the Lord had indeed
worked miracles for us.
4Our Lord, we ask you to bless
our people again,
and let us be like streams
in the Southern Desert.
5We cried as we went out
to plant our seeds.
Now let us celebrate
as we bring in the crops.
6We cried on the way
to plant our seeds,
but we will celebrate and shout
as we bring in the crops.
translation_text:
Nsiim kpántì tilaal
1Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee.
Ti-Dindaan nín nìn fātìi gíiǹní ti-sarkadambi Siiyɔn tiŋkinee,
an nìn bí-ti kii kudamintiiuee ní.
2Ti nìn pée bí ní ki lāā
ní ki gà dipɔɔpindi laŋyi.
Atimbun ŋin kíǹee nìn bí ki lì yii:
«Ti-Dindaan túń atuŋkpaan ki tīī-bi.»
3Tiŋman, ti-Dindaan nìn lafun túń atuŋkpaan ki tīī-ti,
ní ti nìn bí dipɔɔpindin.
4Ti-Dindaan, fàtīí gíiǹní ti-sarkadambi,
kii a nín yàntī nnyim fàtīi gbéè
Neegeeb teekun bùmbiyaamu puee.
5Un yaa būul̀ nsiim poonee
dāa cēē dipɔɔpindi poon ní.
6Un yaa tú iwambool ki cá kí bɔ̄l̀ ki sūǹee
làá fàtīí gítiń ki tú tijin tin u cáńee nì dipɔɔpindi ní.

english_text:
(A song by Solomon for worship.)
Only the Lord Can Bless a Home
1Without the help of the Lord
it is useless to build a home
or to guard a city.
2It is useless to get up early
and stay up late
in order to earn a living.
God takes care of his own,
even while they sleep.
3Children are a blessing
and a gift from the Lord.
4Having a lot of children
to take care of you
in your old age
is like a warrior
with a lot of arrows.
5The more you have,
the better off you will be,
because they will protect you
when your enemies
attack you in court.
translation_text:
Ti-Dindaan di tìì tikɔkɔ
1Saloomɔn di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà-ŋu.
Ti-Dindaan yaa kaa máń kudiiyee,
bidimaliibi bíi pɔ̄ɔntí fám ní.
Ti-Dindaan yaa kaa cí kitiŋee,
bin cí-kèe cí fám ní.
2An sá fám ní ni yíkí kutaafaau pɔ̀lpɔl
kí dāá dòon̄ kunyataasiiu,
ki tūǹ ditundi ki gì ki pée nyàab̀ kun ni làá jēe.
Ti-Dindaan tìì bin u néeńee min jítì mimmee,
ŋyunti ŋun ní bíǹ dɔ̄ ki gèeǹee.
3Mbiyaamu sá tigaajati tin ti-Dindaan tììyee ní,
ní mmaal sá dibiindi.
4Mbininjabiyaamu mun uninja màal̀ u-naacimpɔntinee
sá kii ipiin in kā ujanjal ŋaanee ní.
5Un gbéeǹ u-baatandi ipiinee bí mmɔneeee!
U nì u-nannanliibi yaa bíi sòoǹ tibɔti kubɔtinaakoounee,
icoo kaa làá cúú-u.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Rewards His Faithful People
1The Lord will bless you
if you respect him
and obey his laws.
2Your fields will produce,
and you will be happy—
all will go well.
3Your wife will be as fruitful
as a grapevine,
and just as an olive tree
is rich with olives,
your home will be rich
with healthy children.
4This is how the Lord will bless
everyone who respects him.
5I pray that the Lord
will bless you from Zion
and let Jerusalem prosper
as long as you live.
6May you live long enough
to see your grandchildren.
Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_text:
Deedeedambi naam
1Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee.
Bin kɔkɔ fàŋkí ti-Dindaan,
ki nóó u-saŋŋuee bí mmɔnneeee!
2A nín túń ditundi ki ká kuŋyee ní a làá jī.
A làá nīn bí mmɔnni, ní án bútí-si!
3A-dumpuee, a-nimpuu làá nīn bí kii
bufiinyisubu bun lòoǹ tikpilee,
ní a-jipɔmbi ń nīn bí kii ɔliifi supɔmbiliŋee
ki māntìi tú a-teebiliu.
4Ti-Dindaan nín làá bìin̄
un fàŋkí-uee pu puee dee.
5Ti-Dindaan ń bìin̄ a-boon doooo Siiyɔn jool pu,
ní á ká án nín làá bútí Jeerusaleem pu
a-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poonee,
6ní kí ká a-biyaamu biyaamu.
Isirayeel ń nīn bí ŋgbansɔŋfin!

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for Protection
1Since the time I was young,
enemies have often attacked!
Let everyone in Israel say:
2“Since the time I was young,
enemies have often attacked!
But they have not defeated me,
3though my back is like a field
that has just been plowed.”
4The Lord always does right,
and he has set me free
from the ropes
of those cruel people.
5I pray that all who hate
the city of Zion
will be made ashamed
and forced to turn and run.
6May they be like grass
on the flat roof of a house,
grass that dries up
as soon as it sprouts.
7Don't let them be like wheat
gathered in bundles.
8And don't let anyone
who passes by say to them,
“The Lord bless you!
I give you my blessing
in the name of the Lord.”
translation_text:
Bi ŋá-mi tikpitil, ama...
1Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee.
Bi jáń nì mi ŋfunyɔm kupaau doooo m-naacimpɔntin...
- Isirayeel ń lì yii:
2«Bi jáń nì mi ŋfunyɔm kupaau doooo m-naacimpɔntin» -,
ama baa ŋúń ki ŋá-mi tiba.
3M-boon kpántì kii kitiŋee bikpaabi kùn̄ tikpaal,
bi cátì ŋu-pu adan ŋin fɔ̀kɔ̀ee.
4Ama ti-Dindaan sá deedeedaan,
u tīfì binikpitib kusakai.
5Bin kɔkɔ ná Siiyɔn tiŋkee,
icoo ń cúú-bi bí gítí bi-boon!
6Bí nīn bí kii timool tin nyáń kudii yilpuee.
Taa láá wíiǹ ní kí kpā.
7Kumoou gbanti kaa gbéè un cēē-kùee ŋantil,
kaa bàn̄ un kōontée ń páań u-ŋalii pu.
8Bisanjitiliibi kaa lì yii:
«Ti-Dindaan ń bīiǹ ni-boon!»
Ti mèé yii ti-Dindaan ń bìin̄ ni-boon u-yindi pu.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Trusting the Lord in Times of Trouble
1From a sea of troubles
I cry out to you, Lord.
2Won't you please listen
as I beg for mercy?
3If you kept record of our sins,
no one could last long.
4But you forgive us,
and so we will worship you.
5With all my heart,
I am waiting, Lord, for you!
I trust your promises.
6I wait for you more eagerly
than a soldier on guard duty
waits for the dawn.
Yes, I wait more eagerly
than a soldier on guard duty
waits for the dawn.
7Israel, trust the Lord!
God is always merciful
and has the power to save you.
8 Israel, the Lord will save you
from all your sins.
translation_text:
Dinimbinaamandi poon
1Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee.
Dinimbinaamandi poonee, m kūuntí ki yíì-si, ti-Dindaan.
2Ti-Dindaan, pīlifiǹ-mi,
kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì m-gbaamii.
3Ti-Dindaan, a yaa bàà ŋmà ti-yìntitam ki yōontée,
ti-Dindaan, ŋma bàà ŋmátí?
4Ama sii di pūǹ ikpiti,
an pu ní bi máaǹ kí fàŋkì-si.
5M cɔ́tí ti-Dindaan pu,
m cɔ́tí nì m-naŋki kɔkɔ,
ní ki máká u-nyɔɔbundi pu.
6M-naŋki fèefī ki nyàab̀ ti-Dindaan
ki jítiǹ sooja un cí sintilee nín là kutaa ń wúntí puee,
ki jítiǹ sooja un cí sintilee nín là kutaa ń wúntí puee.
7Isirayeel yab, nín̄ mákámaan ti-Dindaan pu,
di sá yii ti-Dindaan cee ní dineeŋkpaandi bí,
u cáá isan tikpil in pu u làá dī kí fīī-see.
8Úǹ di làá fīī Isirayeel yab
kí nyāntí bi-kpitii poon.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
Trust the Lord!
1I am not conceited, Lord,
and I don't waste my time
on impossible schemes.
2But I have learned to feel safe
and satisfied,
like a young child
in its mother's arms.
3People of Israel,
you must trust the Lord
now and forever.
translation_text:
Ti-Dindaan, maa yòontí m-ba yilpu
1Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee. Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄-ŋu.
Ti-Dindaan, maa yòontí m-ba yilpu,
maa cáá nnimbifɔkɔn.
Maa nyàab̀ tikpaandi, kaa tí nyàab̀ tin jítiǹ-mee.
2Ama m ŋmíl̀ díkí diki ní ki kāl̀ soooo
kii kibiki kin kā ki-na taaŋi puee.
M-pɔbil sɔ̀m̀ kii kibiki gbantee ní.
3Isirayeel yab, nín̄ mákámaan ti-Dindaan pu,
kí yòon̄ kɔŋkɔnnee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Is Always with His People
1Our Lord, don't forget David
and how he suffered.
2Mighty God of Jacob,
remember how he promised:
3“I won't go home
or crawl into bed
4or close my eyelids,
5until I find a home for you,
the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
6 When we were in Ephrath,
we heard that the sacred chest
was somewhere near Jaar.
7Then we said, “Let's go
to the throne of the Lord
and worship at his feet.”
8Come to your new home, Lord,
you and the sacred chest
with all its power.
9Let victory be like robes
for the priests;
let your faithful people
celebrate and shout.
10David is your chosen one,
so don't reject him.
11 You made a solemn promise
to David, when you said,
“I, the Lord, promise
that someone in your family
will always be king.
12If they keep our agreement
and follow my teachings,
then someone in your family
will rule forever.”
13You have gladly chosen Zion
as your home, our Lord.
14You said, “This is my home!
I will live here forever.
15I will bless Zion with food,
and even the poor will eat
until they are full.
16Victory will be like robes
for the priests,
and its faithful people
will celebrate and shout.
17 I will give mighty power
to the kingdom of David.
Each of my chosen kings
will shine like a lamp
18and wear a sparkling crown.
But I will disgrace
their enemies.”
translation_text:
Siiyɔn, ti-Dindaan kɔŋkooŋŋu
1Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee.
Ti-Dindaan, téetí Daafiidi,
nì u-gìŋ́ŋi kɔkɔ pu.
2Daafiidi di nìn pūtì ki pōoǹ ti-Dindaan,
Jaakɔb Nimbɔtikpaaŋwu yii:
3«M kpá kí kɔ́ m-diikun,
m kpá kí dòon̄ m-dooŋu pu,
4m kpá kí yàntī ŋgeem ń cúú-mi,
m kpá kí púkuń,
5kin tin sāā ŋyunti ŋun m làá ká mpaan kí tīī ti-Dindaan,
kí ká ŋkɔŋkoon ki tīī Jaakɔb Nimbɔtikpaaŋwuee!»
6Ti nìn gbìl̄ Dipoondi Dakaau pu Eefiraata tiŋkin,
ti nìn ká-u Yaari satin.
7Tí kɔ́maan ti-Dindaan kɔŋkooŋŋun,
tí gbàan̄ u-beejal taapu!
8Yīkìm̄, ti-Dindaan, dāan̄ a-ŋuŋfil paaŋŋu pu,
sii nì Dakaa un poon ní a-pɔŋŋu bée!
9A-saraaŋaliibi ń dū ibaamɔn kí pèen̄ kii tiwampeeŋkaalee,
bin yú nì si deedeeyee ń nīn fàal̀!
10A-tɔntɔnliu Daafiidi puee,
taa fàtī a-boon kí tīī ubɔti un ní a lēēyee.
11Ti-Dindaan nìn pōoǹ Daafiidi dipoondi nee.
Ibaamɔn pu u kpá kí nyā dipoondi gbanti boon:
«A-naantiibi kansikin ubɔ ní m làá dāá lēē
kí kàan̄ a-beejal pu.
12A-jipɔmbi yaa ŋúb́ m-poondi
nì abɔkpaa ŋin m tīī-bee,
bi mun jipɔmbi
làá dāá kàl̄ a-beejal pu
kí nīn cá jaanjaan.»
13Di sá ti-Dindaan lafun lēē Siiyɔn jool,
ki là dí nīn sá u-kɔŋkooŋŋu.
14U nìn lī yii: «M-ŋuŋfil paaŋŋu sèé kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.
Doo ní m là kí nīn kóò.
15M làá bìin̄ Siiyɔn tiŋki boon kí tīī-kì tin kɔkɔ kì nyàab̀ee,
m làá tīī bisoodambi bin kóò ki-nee tijin bí jī kí báĺ.
16M làá dū difiil kí pèen̄ ki-saraaŋaliibi,
ní deedeedambi bin kóò ki-nee ń nīn fàal̀.
17M làá lēē Daafiidi naantiiu ubɔ Siiyɔn tiŋkin niin
ú nīn cáá mpɔŋkpaan.
Udaan làá nīn bí kii fitila un kaa kúù jaanjaanee ní.
18M làá dāá dū icoo kí pèen̄ u-nannanliibi,
ama ní úǹ beefuuliiki ń nīn jìl̀ u-yil pu.»

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Living Together in Peace
1It is truly wonderful
when the people of God
live together in peace.
2It is as beautiful as olive oil
poured on Aaron's head
and running down his beard
and the collar of his robe.
3It is like the dew
from Mount Hermon,
falling on Zion's mountains,
where the Lord has promised
to bless his people
with life forevermore.
translation_text:
An ŋān̄ nnabiyaamu ń nīn bí dicilpu
1Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee. Daafiidi di gāā-ŋu.
Kpèè, an nín ŋān̄ ki mɔ̄
binib ń nīn bí dicilpu kunabitiiu poon puee!
2An bí kii ŋkpam min sɔ́fì
bi bātì ki sītì Aarɔn yil pu,
mi pùub̀ ki sìntìń u-nyimpul pu,
ki pùub̀ ki sìntìń u-wampeeŋkaati nyɔɔgbaŋŋi pu puee ní.
3An bí kii Eermɔn jool malindi
nín pùub̀ ki sìntìń Siiyɔn jooŋŋi pu puee ní.
Di sá yii niin ní ti-Dindaan lēē kí tīī dibiindi
nì dimaŋfal kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Praising the Lord at Night
1Everyone who serves the Lord,
come and offer praises.
Everyone who has gathered
in his temple tonight,
2lift your hands in prayer
toward his holy place
and praise the Lord.
3The Lord is the Creator
of heaven and earth,
and I pray that the Lord
will bless you from Zion.
translation_text:
Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, nimbi u-tɔntɔnliibi kɔkɔ
1Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee.
Ti-yab, jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan,
nimbi bin kɔkɔ sá ti-Dindaan tɔntɔnliibee,
nimbi bin bí ti-Dindaan diikun kunyeeuee.
2Yòom̄maan ni-ŋalii kí túĺ Circir kɔŋkooŋŋu
ní kí jāam̀ ti-Dindaan.
3Ti-Dindaan ń bìin̄ ni-boon doooo Siiyɔn jool pu,
úǹ un náań yilpu nì taapuee!

english_text:
In Praise of the Lord's Kindness
1Shout praises to the Lord!
You are his servants,
so praise his name.
2All who serve in the temple
of the Lord our God,
3come and shout praises.
Praise the name of the Lord!
He is kind and good.
4He chose the family of Jacob
and the people of Israel
for his very own.
5The Lord is much greater
than any other god.
6He does as he chooses
in heaven and on earth
and deep in the sea.
7The Lord makes the clouds rise
from far across the earth,
and he makes lightning
to go with the rain.
Then from his secret place
he sends out the wind.
8The Lord killed the first-born
of people and animals
in the land of Egypt.
9God used miracles and wonders
to fight the king of Egypt
and all of his officials.
10He destroyed many nations
and killed powerful kings,
11including King Sihon
of the Amorites
and King Og of Bashan.
He conquered every kingdom
in the land of Canaan
12and gave their property
to his people Israel.
13The name of the Lord
will be remembered forever,
and he will be famous
for all time to come.
14The Lord will bring justice
and show mercy to all
who serve him.
15 Idols of silver and gold
are made and worshiped
in other nations.
16They have a mouth and eyes,
but they can't speak or see.
17They are completely deaf,
and they can't breathe.
18Everyone who makes idols
and all who trust them
will end up as helpless
as their idols.
19Everyone in Israel,
come praise the Lord!
All the family of Aaron
20and all the tribe of Levi,
come praise the Lord!
All of his worshipers,
come praise the Lord.
21Praise the Lord from Zion!
He lives here in Jerusalem.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
M nyí yii ti-Dindaan sá ukpaan
1 Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!
Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan yindi,
nimbi ti-Dindaan tɔntɔnliibi, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u,
2nimbi bin bí ti-Dindaan diikun,
ki bí ti-Nimbɔtiu diiku cindinee.
3Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, di sá yii u ŋān̄,
gāāmaan ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì u-yindi, di sá yii di mɔ̄.
4Ti-Dindaan lēē Jaakɔb ú nīn sá u-yɔu,
u lēē Isirayeel ú nīn sá u-gaajawammɔntiiti.
5Tiŋman, man nyí yii ti-Dindaan sá ukpaan,
timbi Dindaan jítiǹ inimbɔti kɔkɔ.
6Ti-Dindaan ŋáań tin kɔkɔ u yaa lèe yilpu nì taapu,
tiŋkubin nì inyiŋfi taapu taapu.
7U yàntī atagban ń nyānní kitiŋ gbeennyɔkɔ kí dāan̄,
u yàntī utaa ń ŋmɔ́ kí nì,
u nyāntí kubuŋu laakin u kpáafì-kuee.
8Úǹ di kūū Eejipiti yab biseebiyaamu nninjabiyaamu
kí yòon̄ binib kí cáá sāā tiwaŋkuti.
9Sii Eejipiti tiŋki poonee,
u nìn ŋá tidaandi nì maamaacib
ki dáaĺ Faaroo nì u-tɔntɔnliibi kɔkɔ tafal.
10Úǹ di nāaǹ atimbun kupaau,
ki kūū bibɔtiibi bin cáá mpɔnee:
11bíǹ di sá Amɔɔr yab bɔtiu Siiwɔn,
nì Baasan tiŋki bɔtiu Ɔɔgi,
nì Kanaan yab bɔtiibi kɔkɔ.
12Míǹ boonee ní u dū bi-timmu ki tīī difakal,
u dūu tīī u-nibul Isirayeel yab bí nīn yì.
13Ti-Dindaan, a-yindi làá nīn pée bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
Bi làá nīn pée téetí a-pu ní abin abin.
14Di sá yii ti-Dindaan sòoǹ ki pɔ̀ u-nibul,
u sūǹ u-tɔntɔnliibi saai.
15Animbil kúti nì sindaariya ní bi dūu mɔ́ɔ́
atimbun ŋin kíǹee waaŋi,
binib di dū bi-ŋalii ki mɔ́ɔ́-ŋi.
16Ŋi cáá kinyɔkɔ, ní kaa sòoǹ.
Ŋi cáá animbil, ní kaa wāĺ.
17Ŋi cáá atafal, ní kaa gbìl̀.
Báà kufoou kaa bí ŋi-nyɔmmun!
18Bin mɔ́ɔ́-ŋee ń nīn bí kii ŋi nín bí puee,
ki kpáaǹ bin kɔkɔ máká ŋi-puee.
19Isirayeel yab, jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan.
Aarɔn naantiibi, jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan.
20 Leefii yab, jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan.
Nimbi bin fàŋkí ti-Dindaanee, jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan.
21Jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan un kóò Jeerusaleem
Siiyɔn jool puee.
Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_text:
God's Love Never Fails
1 Praise the Lord! He is good.
God's love never fails.
2Praise the God of all gods.
God's love never fails.
3Praise the Lord of lords.
God's love never fails.
4Only God works great miracles.
God's love never fails.
5 With wisdom he made the sky.
God's love never fails.
6 The Lord stretched the earth
over the ocean.
God's love never fails.
7 He made the bright lights
in the sky.
God's love never fails.
8He lets the sun rule each day.
God's love never fails.
9He lets the moon and the stars
rule each night.
God's love never fails.
10 God struck down the first-born
in every Egyptian family.
God's love never fails.
11 He rescued Israel from Egypt.
God's love never fails.
12God used his great strength
and his powerful arm.
God's love never fails.
13 He split the Red Sea apart.
God's love never fails.
14The Lord brought Israel safely
through the sea.
God's love never fails.
15He destroyed the Egyptian king
and his army there.
God's love never fails.
16The Lord led his people
through the desert.
God's love never fails.
17Our God defeated mighty kings.
God's love never fails.
18And he killed famous kings.
God's love never fails.
19 One of them was Sihon,
king of the Amorites.
God's love never fails.
20 Another was King Og of Bashan.
God's love never fails.
21God took away their land.
God's love never fails.
22He gave their land to Israel,
the people who serve him.
God's love never fails.
23God saw the trouble we were in.
God's love never fails.
24He rescued us from our enemies.
God's love never fails.
25He gives food to all who live.
God's love never fails.
26Praise God in heaven!
God's love never fails.
translation_text:
Isirayeel Fiiliu, si nì ditundi
1Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, di sá yii u ŋān̄,
u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
2Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan inimbɔti kɔkɔ Nimbɔtiu,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
3Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan bidindambi kɔkɔ Dindaan,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
4Úǹ baba di ŋá bimaamaacikpaambi,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
5U dū u-ciiŋyi ní ki náań yilpu,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
6U kpátì kitiŋ ki páaǹ inyiŋfi pu,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
7U ŋá iwalfi ikpaan:
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,
8ŋwìiń ŋú nīn bí ŋwiimpu ki ŋmíntí,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,
9uŋmal nì iŋmalbijaa í nīn bí kunyeeu ki ŋmíntí,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
10U kūū Eejipiti yab biseebiyaamu nninjabiyaamu,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
11U nìn nyántì Isirayeel yab kitiŋ gbantin,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
12Nì atuŋkpaan nì mpɔŋkpaan tuuŋŋi ní u nìn dūu ŋá míǹ,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
13U nìn cúú Tikati mɔɔl ki yākatì mili,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,
14ki yāntì Isirayeel yab cōom̀ ki jítì,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
15Ama u nìn yāntì Faaroo nì u-janjaliibi gbíntì niin,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
16U nìn kpōotì u-nibul bi jítì kuteeu pu,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
17U nìn nāaǹ bibɔtikpaambi,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,
18u nìn kūū bibɔtiibi bin cáá mpɔnee,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
19Bíǹ di sá Amɔɔr yab bɔtiu Siiwɔn,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,
20nì Baasan bɔtiu Ɔɔgi,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
21U nìn dū bi-timmu ki tīī difakal,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,
22ki tīī u-tɔntɔnliibi Isirayeel yab bí nīn yì,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
23U nìn téetì ti-pu ŋyunti ŋun bi nìn sīntiǹ-ti taapuee,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,
24ní ki nyántì-ti ti-nannanliibi ŋaan,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
25U tìì tiwan tin kɔkɔ cáá kufoouee tijin tì jīǹ,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
26Tí nyɔ̄ŋkì yilpu Nimbɔtiu,
di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan!

english_text:
A Prayer for Revenge
1Beside the rivers of Babylon
we thought about Jerusalem,
and we sat down and cried.
2We hung our small harps
on the willow trees.
3Our enemies had brought us here
as their prisoners;
now they wanted us to sing
and entertain them.
They insulted us and shouted,
“Sing about Zion!”
4Here in a foreign land,
how can we sing
about the Lord?
5Jerusalem, if I forget you,
let my right hand go limp.
6Let my tongue stick
to the roof of my mouth,
if I don't think about you
above all else.
7Our Lord, punish the Edomites!
On the day Jerusalem fell,
they shouted,
“Completely destroy the city!
Tear down every building!”
8 Babylon, you are doomed!
I pray the Lord's blessings
on anyone who punishes you
for what you did to us.
9May the Lord bless everyone
who beats your children
against the rocks!
translation_text:
Ti kā Babiloon mɔɔŋi gbaŋŋi
1Ti nìn kā niin Babiloon mɔɔŋi gbaŋŋi,
ki sūǹ ki téetí Siiyɔn pu.
2Ti nìn dū ti-bati ki sākaǹ
isufi in nìn bí niinee pu.
3Niin ní bin nìn cúú-ti kuyuŋuee
nìn bālifì-ti yii tí gāā ilan.
Bin nìn sàantí-tee nìn bālifì-ti yii tí gāā dipɔɔpindi laŋyi.
Bi nìn lī yii: «Gāāmaan-ti Siiyɔn laŋyi iba!»
4- Ama mana ní ti làá ŋmā kí gāā ti-Dindaan laŋŋu
kitincaŋ poon?
5Jeerusaleem, daliŋkin m yaa súntì a-puee,
m-ŋaŋgiil ń fáká!
6M yaa kaa bíi dàkafī a-pu,
Jeerusaleem yaa kaa kpántì m-pɔɔpindi kɔkɔee,
m-limbil ń nákań m-lammi!
7Ti-Dindaan, taa súntí Eedoom yab nín ŋá pu
ŋwiin ŋun bi jáń ki fōō Jeerusaleemee.
Bi nìn bí ki lì yii: «Ní kpēelikì kitiŋ nee,
ní kpēelikì-kì kí kpáaǹ ki-nyeel!»
8Babiloon yab, nnaabu dɔ̄ ki cí-ni,
bin làá téeǹ-si tikpitil tin a ŋá-tee bí mmɔnneeee!
9Bin làá cúú a-bipɔmmu
kí páań ditaŋkpal pu kí nèe bí mmɔnni!

english_text:
(By David.)
Praise the Lord with All Your Heart
1With all my heart
I praise you, Lord.
In the presence of angels
I sing your praises.
2I worship at your holy temple
and praise you for your love
and your faithfulness.
You were true to your word
and made yourself more famous
than ever before.
3When I asked for your help,
you answered my prayer
and gave me courage.
4All kings on this earth
have heard your promises, Lord,
and they will praise you.
5You are so famous
that they will sing about
the things you have done.
6Though you are above us all,
you care for humble people,
and you keep a close watch
on everyone who is proud.
7I am surrounded by trouble,
but you protect me
against my angry enemies.
With your own powerful arm
you keep me safe.
8You, Lord, will always
treat me with kindness.
Your love never fails.
You have made us what we are.
Don't give up on us now!
translation_text:
M làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ
1Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee.
Ti-Dindaan, m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ.
M làá gāā ilan kí pàkà-si inimbɔti nimbiin.
2M làá gbàan̄ a-circir diikun,
a-neeŋkpaandi nì a-deedeeu puee,
m làá pàkà-si,
di sá yii a ŋá a nín pōoǹ puee ki jítiǹ min ti bàà dàkafēe.
3Ŋwiin ŋun m yíiń-see, a kíí-mi,
a tīī-mi kunyannyaau nì mpɔn.
4Ti-Dindaan, kitiŋ pu bɔtiibi kɔkɔ ń nyɔ̄ŋkì-si,
ŋyunti ŋun bi yaa gbìl̄ a-nyɔkɔ poon nyɔɔbuŋŋee!
5Bí gāā ilan kí pàkà ti-Dindaan tuuŋŋi yii:
«Ti-Dindaan nyooti wīikéeee!
6Min kamaa ti-Dindaan bíń yilpu yilpuee,
u wāĺ un sīntiǹ u-ba taapuee,
u bí ndandati ní ki nyí un yòontí u-ba yilpuee.»
7M yaa bí dinimbinaamandinaaa,
a tìì-mi dimaŋfal.
A tàntī a-ŋal ki jáà nì m-nannanliibi,
ní ki cáá a-ŋaŋgiil ki fìil̄-mi.
8Ti-Dindaan làá ŋá tikɔkɔ kí tīī-mi.
Ti-Dindaan, a-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.
Taa fá bin a dū a-ŋal ki náańee.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
The Lord Is Always Near
1You have looked deep
into my heart, Lord,
and you know all about me.
2You know when I am resting
or when I am working,
and from heaven
you discover my thoughts.
3You notice everything I do
and everywhere I go.
4Before I even speak a word,
you know what I will say,
5and with your powerful arm
you protect me
from every side.
6I can't understand all of this!
Such wonderful knowledge
is far above me.
7Where could I go to escape
from your Spirit
or from your sight?
8If I were to climb up
to the highest heavens,
you would be there.
If I were to dig down
to the world of the dead
you would also be there.
9Suppose I had wings
like the dawning day
and flew across the ocean.
10Even then your powerful arm
would guide and protect me.
11Or suppose I said, “I'll hide
in the dark until night comes
to cover me over.”
12But you see in the dark
because daylight and dark
are all the same to you.
13You are the one
who put me together
inside my mother's body,
14and I praise you because of
the wonderful way
you created me.
Everything you do is marvelous!
Of this I have no doubt.
15Nothing about me
is hidden from you!
I was secretly woven together
out of human sight,
16but with your own eyes you saw
my body being formed.
Even before I was born,
you had written in your book
everything about me.
17 Your thoughts are far beyond
my understanding,
much more than I
could ever imagine.
18I try to count your thoughts,
but they outnumber the grains
of sand on the beach.
And when I awake,
I will find you nearby.
19How I wish that you would kill
all cruel and heartless people
and protect me from them!
20They are always rebelling
and speaking evil of you.
21You know I hate anyone
who hates you, Lord,
and refuses to obey.
22They are my enemies too,
and I truly hate them.
23Look deep into my heart, God,
and find out everything
I am thinking.
24Don't let me follow evil ways,
but lead me in the way
that time has proven true.
translation_text:
Ti-Dindaan, a nyí m-bɔti kɔkɔ
1Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.
Ti-Dindaan, a cɔ́ŋkì-mi ki béè-mi.
2M yaa kāaa, m yaa yíkàaa, a nyí,
a bí ndandati ní ki nyí m-landɔkɔi.
3M yaa còom̄aaa, m yaa dɔ̄ ki gèeǹaaa, a nyí,
a nyí tin kɔkɔ m ŋáańee.
4Maa láá wāaǹ kinyɔkɔ ki lī tiba
ní a nyí tin kɔkɔ m là kí lèe.
5A bí m-boon ki bí m-nyɔkɔpu,
a dū a-ŋal ki páaǹ m-pu.
6A nín nyí-mi pu tikpilee cáá-mi maamaaci,
an jítì m-landɔkɔŋu pu ḿ ŋmā kí gbìl̄ taapu.
7La ní m ŋūǹ kí cù kí nīn dátiǹ a-Fam ní?
La ní m ŋūǹ kí sāǹ kí cù ní aa bí niin ní?
8M yaa nín jɔ́ḿ yilpuɔɔɔ, a bí niin,
m yaa tí dɔ̄ ditaŋkpiilinaaa, a bí niin.
9M yaa túkú ifeen ki ŋàan̄ ki búntì
ditiŋkugbandi lapu pu yal kí nīn kóòyaaa,
10a-ŋal bí niin mun kí kpòotī-mi,
a-ŋaŋgiil bí niin kí tíkiń-mi.
11M yaa bí yii: «Dibɔmbɔndi ń dāá bìin̄ m-pu,
ŋwalifi ŋun māntìi tú-mee ń kpántí kunyeeuaaa!»
12sii ceeyee, dibɔmbɔndi kaa sá dibɔmbɔndi,
ní kunyeeu wāĺ kii ŋwìińee.
Dibɔmbɔndi nì ŋwalifi sá sii cee tiwambaantiil ní.
13Sii di náań m-landɔkɔjaatiŋu,
sii di máń-mi ki tākaǹ m-na poon.
14M jáaḿ-si, kun puee a náań-mi
ní m-wunti sá maamaaci ní ki ŋān̄ tikpil.
A-tuuŋŋi sá maamaaci tuuŋŋi,
m nyí míǹ tiŋan.
15Ŋyunti ŋun a nìn bíi nāantí-mi dibalin,
ní ki nìn bíi māā-mi ki tàkantí m-na poonee,
m-wunti laaba kaa nìn bí dibalin a-cee.
16Ŋyunti ŋun m nìn dáá sá nnaantee, a nìn wāĺ-mi.
Kí wàatī iwiin in a tīī-mi
ḿ dūú kàl̄ kitiŋ puee ń kíĺee,
a nìn ŋmàn̄ i-nyɔkɔm ki ŋá a-gbɔŋkun ki síiǹ.
17Unimbɔti, a-landɔkɔi pɔ̄ɔ̄ ḿ ŋmā kí gbìl̄ taapu,
i wīikí ní an kaa cáá ŋkaan.
18M yaa bí yii ḿ kàaǹ-iee,
i làá nīn wīikí ki jítiǹ dibul pu.
M yaa fīntèe, m gbíntìi bí a-cee.
19Unimbɔti, an sá á kúntí binikpitib
ní kí jà binikpɔliibi kí wàatī-mi.
20Bi cáá a-yindi ki ŋmàtíǹ binib ní,
bi yíì a-yindi ki cáa ŋáań ikpiti.
21Ti-Dindaan, mana ní ḿ taa nín̄ ná bin ná-see,
maa là kí ká bin jáà nì see.
22M baasii ná-bi ní,
bi kpántì man m-ba nannanliibi ní.
23Unimbɔti, kpèè m-pɔbil poon kí béé-mi,
cɔ̄ŋkì-mi ní kí béé m-landɔkɔi.
24Kpèè m yaa tàkā nsaŋkpiti poon,
ní kí kpòotī-mi kí tàkan̄ a-saŋŋu pu.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1Rescue me from cruel
and violent enemies, Lord!
2They think up evil plans
and always cause trouble.
3 Their words bite deep
like the poisonous fangs
of a snake.
4Protect me, Lord, from cruel
and brutal enemies,
who want to destroy me.
5Those proud people have hidden
traps and nets
to catch me as I walk.
6You, Lord, are my God!
Please listen to my prayer.
7You have the power to save me,
and you keep me safe
in every battle.
8Don't let the wicked succeed
in doing what they want,
or else they might never
stop planning evil.
9They have me surrounded,
but make them the victims
of their own vicious lies.
10Dump flaming coals on them
and throw them into pits
where they can't climb out.
11Chase those cruel liars away!
Let trouble hunt them down.
12Our Lord, I know that you
defend the homeless
and see that the poor
are given justice.
13Your people will praise you
and will live with you
because they do right.
translation_text:
Ti-Dindaan, fīī-mi kí nyāntí bin dàkà tipɔmbɔtee ŋaan
1Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.
2Ti-Dindaan, fīī-mi kí nyāntí binikpitib ŋaan,
wúń m-pu bin dàkà tipɔmbɔtee cee.
3Bi pée dàkafī kí ŋá tikpitil ŋma ní,
baabadalee, bi jāantí binib ní.
4Bi-limbiliŋ jītí kii ukoobuee,
ukoowaati looti kā bi-nyɔkɔn.
5Ti-Dindaan, taa yàntī ḿ kɔ́ binikpitib ŋaan.
Bin dàkà tipɔmbɔti,
ki nyàab̀ ḿ lítée ceeyee, wúń m-pu.
6Bilambidambi píĺ-mi kutaliŋŋu.
Bi dū iŋmii nì kulaaŋŋu ki píĺ-mi nsan caŋin,
bi píĺ-mi kpalaabi.
7Ama m bí ti-Dindaan yii: «A sá m-Nimbɔtiu!
Ti-Dindaan, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì m-gbaamii.
8Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti, sii un di sá mpɔn ŋun fìil̄-mee,
dikɔ̀ndi wiiŋŋuee, a bìintí m-yil pu.
9Ti-Dindaan, taa yàntī binikpitib nee ń ká kun bi nyàab̀ee,
taa yàntī bí ŋmā kí ŋá tin bi bɔ́ntèe,
an yaa kaa sá mimmee, bi làá nīn yòontí bi-ba yilpu.
10Yàntī bi nín sòon̄ kí ŋá-mi tikpitil tiŋyee
ń fàtīí gítí bíǹ bi-ba yil pu!»
11Yàntī amɔsiŋkoon ń sìtī bi-pu,
Unimbɔti ń yàntī bí jēetí ŋŋmin,
bí jēetí kuboou kun nyóò, baa ti làá ŋmā kí nyēe poon!
12Bin cāab̀ bi-jutiibi disambiilee
kaa máaǹ kí kàl̄ kitiŋ nee poon.
Nnaabu ń nīn pée kā
unil un dàkà tipɔmbɔtee pu!
13M nyí yii ti-Dindaan làá sòoǹ unandaan bɔti kí tīī-u,
u làá sòoǹ kí pɔ̀ ufalaadaan.
14Tiŋman, deedeedambi làá nyɔ̄ŋkì a-yindi,
binib bin pɔbil bí dibee làá nīn bí a-nimbiin.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Protection
1I pray to you, Lord!
Please listen when I pray
and hurry to help me.
2 Think of my prayer
as sweet-smelling incense,
and think of my lifted hands
as an evening sacrifice.
3Help me to guard my words
whenever I say something.
4Don't let me want to do evil
or waste my time doing wrong
with wicked people.
Don't let me even taste
the good things they offer.
5Let your faithful people
correct and punish me.
My prayers condemn the deeds
of those who do wrong,
so don't let me be friends
with any of them.
6Everyone will admit
that I was right
when their rulers are thrown
down a rocky cliff,
7and their bones lie scattered
like crushed rocks
on top of a grave.
8You are my Lord and God,
and I look to you for safety.
Don't let me be harmed.
9Protect me from the traps
of those violent people,
10and make them fall
into their own traps
while you help me escape.
translation_text:
Ti-Dindaan, ŋúb́ m-nyɔkɔ
1Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee.
Ti-Dindaan, m kúuǹ ki yíiń-si, dāá jòoń-mi malaa,
m yaa yíì-see, á kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifiǹ-mi.
2Yàntī m-wimmeem ń nīn sá kii talaalu tūukaayee a-nimbiin,
ní m-ŋalii in m yōoǹ yilpuee ń nīn sá kii kujoou saraauee.
3Ti-Dindaan, ŋúb́ m-nyɔkɔ,
nín̄ cí m-nyunculiŋ punyɔkɔ.
4Taa yàntī tibɔkpitil ń nyānní m-pɔbil poon,
kí taa yàntī ḿ kūtì bikpitiŋaliibi pu kí ŋá atuŋkpiti.
Maa làá dáká bi-jiŋaalib jinti.
5Dineendi poonee, deedeedaan ŋūǹ kí fáá-mi,
kí dáaĺ m-tafal,
ama m yíì binikpitib ń dàkà-mi dineendi.
Min kamaa bi bíi ŋáań ikpitee, m làá nīn gbíntìi mèé.
6Bi yaa láa dū bi-kpilib ki lúkú ditaŋkpal puee,
m-nannanliibi làá dāá béé yii tin m nìn sòoǹee sá mbaamɔn.
7Kii kitiŋ nín fátí ŋwèeń puee,
míǹ ní ditaŋkpiil làá wàan̄ kinyɔkɔ
kí dū bi-kpabiŋ ŋin yàl̄ee kí náĺ.
8Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti, m-nimbikpeeŋu cɔ́ a-pu ní,
sii ní m sáǹ ki kɔ́. Taa yàntī ḿ lántí dimaŋfal.
9Nyāntí-mi kutaliŋŋu kun ní bi píĺ-mee
nì bikpitiŋaliibi laanti poon.
10Bikpitiŋaliibi talinti làá fàtīí sàl̄-bi,
ama man làá yùkū kí lákatí.

english_text:
(A special psalm and a prayer by David when he was in the cave.)
A Prayer for Help
1 I pray to you, Lord.
I beg for mercy.
2I tell you all my worries
and my troubles,
3and whenever I feel low,
you are there to guide me.
A trap has been hidden
along my pathway.
4Even if you look,
you won't see anyone
who cares enough
to walk beside me.
There is no place to hide,
and no one who really cares.
5I pray to you, Lord!
You are my place of safety,
and you are my choice
in the land of the living.
Please answer my prayer.
I am completely helpless.
6Help! They are chasing me,
and they are too strong.
7Rescue me from this prison,
so I can praise your name.
And when your people notice
your wonderful kindness to me,
they will rush to my side.
translation_text:
Ti-Dindaan baba di sá un bi sàantée balilaŋki
1Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. U nín nìn bí ntaŋkpalɔkɔnee ní u nìn mēē míǹ.
2M fátí mbiil mpɔn ki yíì ti-Dindaan,
m fátí mbiil mpɔn ki gbàam̄ ti-Dindaan.
3M dū m-yaliŋkii ki bíl̀ u-nimbiin,
m dū m-nimbinaamandi ki bíl̀ u-nimbiin.
4M-wunti yaa yɔ̄tèe, sii nyí laakin m cée.
Nsan ŋun poon m tàkēe, bi píĺ-mi kutaliŋŋu.
5Kpèè m-ŋaŋgiil pú, a làá ká yii,
báà ubɔ kaa nyí-mi.
Maa cáá laakin m làá sāǹ kí báĺee,
m-bɔti kaa ká báà ubɔ.
6Ti-Dindaan, m fáá mbiil ki yíiń-si
ki lī yii: «Sii di sá m-balilaŋki,
kun m pée cáá binifoobi tiŋki nee puee.»
7Pīlifì m-biilii, di sá yii m gbí falaa!
Fīī-mi kí nyāntí bin sàantí-mee ŋaan,
di sá yii bi pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki jítiǹ-mi.
8Nyāntí-mi m-sarkaun ḿ ŋmā kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si.
A yaa ŋá-mi tiŋan, deedeedambi làá màntīí tū-mi.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A Prayer in Time of Danger
1Listen, Lord, as I pray!
You are faithful and honest
and will answer my prayer.
2 I am your servant.
Don't try me in your court,
because no one is innocent
by your standards.
3My enemies are chasing me,
crushing me in the ground.
I am in total darkness,
like someone long dead.
4I have given up hope,
and I feel numb all over.
5I remember to think about
the many things you did
in years gone by.
6Then I lift my hands in prayer,
because my soul is a desert,
thirsty for water from you.
7Please hurry, Lord,
and answer my prayer.
I feel hopeless.
Don't turn away
and leave me here to die.
8Each morning let me learn
more about your love
because I trust you.
I come to you in prayer,
asking for your guidance.
9Please rescue me
from my enemies, Lord!
I come to you for safety.
10You are my God. Show me
what you want me to do,
and let your gentle Spirit
lead me in the right path.
11Be true to your name, Lord,
and keep my life safe.
Use your saving power
to protect me from trouble.
12I am your servant.
Show how much you love me
by destroying my enemies.
translation_text:
Ti-Dindaan, taa sòoǹ m-bɔti
1Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee.
Ti-Dindaan, pīlifì m-wimmeem,
kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì m-gbaamii.
A nín ŋān̄ ki sá deedeedaan puee, kíí-mi.
2Taa sòoǹ man a-tɔntɔnliu bɔti,
di sá yii unifoo ubɔ kaa bí ki sá deedeedaan a-nimbiin.
3M-nannanliu sāaǹ-mi,
u dū-mi ki lúkú kitiŋ ki tàn̄ tàn̄.
U yāntì m kɔ́ dibɔmbɔndin
kii bin kpíì dooooyee.
4M-wunti yɔ̄tì,
maa ti cáá mpɔn.
5M téetí iyunti in jítèe pu,
m dàkafī tin kɔkɔ a ŋée pu,
m dàkafī a-tuuŋŋi pu.
6M yōoǹ m-ŋal ki túĺ-si,
m fèefī ki nyàab̀-si kii kitiŋ nín fèefī ki nyàab̀ utaa puee.
7Ti-Dindaan, kíí-mi malaa, maa ti cáá ŋfam.
Taa fàtī a-boon kí tīī-mi, an yaa kaa sá mimmee, an dóò m-pu.
8Yàntī ḿ gbìl̄ a-neeŋkpaandi pu kutaafaau,
di sá yii sii pu ní m máká.
Dàkà-mi nsan ŋun m máaǹ kí nóóyee,
di sá yii sii watil pú ní m fātì m-ba ki túĺ.
9Ti-Dindaan, fīī-mi kí nyāntí m-nannanliibi ŋaan,
sii ní m sáǹ ki kɔ́.
10Bīfì-mi ḿ ŋmā kí ŋá tin fáatiǹ-see,
di sá yii sii di sá m-Nimbɔtiu.
A-Fam ŋān̄ ní,
mí kpòotī-mi kí dī kitiŋ kin kaa cáá diganlakalee pu.
11Ti-Dindaan, a-yindi puee, tīī-mi dimaŋfal.
A-deedeeu puee, nyāntí-mi dinimbinaamandin.
12A-neeŋkpaandi poonee, a làá kúntí m-nannanliibi,
kí kpɔ̀ bin jáà nì mee kɔkɔ, di sá yii m sá a-tɔntɔnliu ní.

english_text:
(By David.)
A Prayer for the Nation
1I praise you, Lord!
You are my mighty rock,
and you teach me
how to fight my battles.
2You are my friend, my fortress,
where I am safe.
You are my shield,
and you made me the ruler
of our people.
3 Why do we humans mean anything
to you, our Lord?
Why do you care about us?
4We disappear like a breath;
we last no longer
than a faint shadow.
5Open the heavens like a curtain
and come down, Lord.
Touch the mountains
and make them send up smoke.
6Use your lightning as arrows
to scatter my enemies
and make them run away.
7Reach down from heaven
and set me free.
Save me from the mighty flood
8of those lying foreigners
who never tell the truth.
9In praise of you, our God,
I will sing a new song,
while playing my harp.
10By your power, kings win wars,
and your servant David is saved
from deadly swords.
11Won't you keep me safe
from those lying foreigners
who never tell the truth?
12Let's pray that our young sons
will grow like strong plants
and that our daughters
will be as lovely as columns
in the corner of a palace.
13May our barns be filled
with all kinds of crops.
May our fields be covered
with sheep by the thousands,
14and every cow have calves.
Don't let our city be captured
or any of us be taken away,
and don't let cries of sorrow
be heard in our streets.
15Our Lord and our God,
you give these blessings
to all who worship you.
translation_text:
Ubɔti wimmeem
1Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee.
M jáaḿ ti-Dindaan, m-taŋkpanaakooku!
U dàkà-mi bi nín jáà kujaau puee,
u bɔ́ntí-mi ki cīití dikɔ̀ndi wiiŋŋu.
2U sá m-mákal nì m-taŋkpanaakooku,
ki sá m-balilaŋki nì m-fiiliu,
ki sá m-gbampɔɔl, úǹ ní m sáń ki kóò.
Úǹ di dū m-nibooliŋu ki ŋá m-taapu.
3Ti-Dindaan, unil sá ba ní u-bɔti páb́-si míǹ,
nisaal sá ba ní a dàkafī u-pu míǹ?
4Unil náań nì kubuŋu ní,
ní u-wiiŋyi bí kii mboon nín jītí puee.
5Ti-Dindaan, kpáb́ kutagbɔŋu kí kpákatiń.
Gbēē ajoon ŋí nīn bíi dùkù.
6Yàntī utaa ń ŋmɔ́ kí jà a-nannanliibi kí yàaǹ,
tɔ̄ń a-piiŋyi kí jà-bi bí sāǹ.
7Tàntī a-ŋal doooo yilpu kí fīī-mi.
Fīī-mi kí nyāntí nnyiŋkpaam nee ni,
nì binicambi ŋaan.
8Bíǹ bin nyɔmmu sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔti
ní bi yaa yōoǹ bi-ŋaŋgiil ki pūtì bi mɔ́ntée.
9Unimbɔti, m làá gāā nlampɔɔn kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si,
m làá bɔ̀ɔ̀ iŋmii saalaa beeku kí tīī-si tinyool.
10Sii di tìì bibɔtiibi dijajil,
sii di fīī a-tɔntɔnliu Daafiidi kitàataajiki kin kùee cee ki líì.
11Fīī-mi kí nyāntí binicambi
bin nyɔmmu sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔti,
ní bi yaa yōoǹ bi-ŋaŋgiil ki pūtì bi mɔ́ntée ŋaan.
12Yàntī bi-pɔntinee, ti-jipɔmbi ń nīn bí kii
isufi in wíiǹ tiŋanee,
ní ti-bisalib ń nīn bí kii
jaantalkub bin bi kpítì ki dūu nyáantì kubɔtinaakoouee!
13Yàntī ti-cakalaabi ń gbí,
kí nīn cáá tijin kɔkɔ nì ti-bulifi!
Yàntī ti-piii nì ti-ŋoobui ń bùtī ŋfunyɔm kutuku pu,
ŋfunyɔm kutukub saalaa pu ti-naakpaapɔɔkun!
14Ti-naai ń nīn bí màlmal!
Ti-tiŋki guŋŋi ń taa bátí kí lítáaa, bí taa cúú-ti kuyuŋuaaa,
kí taa gbìl̄ binib gbáà ibiil ti-mɔŋkijaai pu!
15Dinibul din cáá tin bí nee kɔkɔee bí mmɔnneeee!
Dinibul din Nimbɔtiu sá ti-Dindaanee bí mmɔnni!

english_text:
(By David for praise.)
The Lord Is Kind and Merciful
1I will praise you,
my God and King,
and always honor your name.
2I will praise you each day
and always honor your name.
3You are wonderful, Lord,
and you deserve all praise,
because you are much greater
than anyone can understand.
4Each generation will announce
to the next your wonderful
and powerful deeds.
5I will keep thinking about
your marvelous glory
and your mighty miracles.
6Everyone will talk about
your fearsome deeds,
and I will tell all nations
how great you are.
7They will celebrate and sing
about your matchless mercy
and your power to save.
8You are merciful, Lord!
You are kind and patient
and always loving.
9You are good to everyone,
and you take care
of all your creation.
10All creation will thank you,
and your loyal people
will praise you.
11They will tell about
your marvelous kingdom
and your power.
12Then everyone will know about
the mighty things you do
and your glorious kingdom.
13Your kingdom will never end,
and you will rule forever.
Our Lord, you keep your word
and do everything you say.
14When someone stumbles or falls,
you give a helping hand.
15Everyone depends on you,
and when the time is right,
you provide them with food.
16By your own hand you satisfy
the desires of all who live.
17Our Lord, everything you do
is kind and thoughtful,
18and you are near to everyone
whose prayers are sincere.
19You satisfy the desires
of all your worshipers,
and you come to save them
when they ask for help.
20You take care of everyone
who loves you,
but you destroy the wicked.
21I will praise you, Lord,
and everyone will respect
your holy name forever.
translation_text:
A-beel sá jaanjaan beel ní
1Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ inyɔŋki laŋŋu nee.
M-Nimbɔtiu, m-bɔtiu, m làá yòon̄ a-yindi yilpu,
m làá jāam̀-si kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.
2M làá nīn jáaḿ-si baabadal
ní kí nīn nyɔ́ŋkí a-yindi kí taa gbèen̄.
3Ti-Dindaan sá ukpaan ní ki máaǹ inyɔŋki,
baa ŋūǹ kí dū u nín sá ukpaan puee kí ŋmàntīǹ tiba.
4Ŋyunti ŋubɔ poon nib làá sòoǹ a-tuuŋŋi pu
kí nàatī ŋun làá dāá páańee yab,
bi làá māafì a-tuŋkpaaŋŋi ŋin a túńee!
5M làá sòoǹ kí gíti sòoǹ a-nyooti nín ŋān̄ puee pu,
m làá sòoǹ kí bùsì a-maamaaci tuuŋŋi pu.
6Bi làá sòoǹ a-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu pu!
Mamee, m làá māafì a-tuŋkpaaŋŋi pu.
7Bí téetí a-ŋaŋkpaanti pu,
bí nīn gà ilan ki fàal̀ a nín sá deedeedaanee pu.
8Ti-Dindaan poon mɔ̄ ní ki cáá kulaŋŋaŋfitiiu,
waa gífí diŋuul malaa ní u-neendi wīikí tikpilku.
9Ti-Dindaan ŋān̄ ki tīī báà ŋma,
u-poon mɔ̄ u-wannaaŋkaati kɔkɔ pu.
10Ti-Dindaan, a-wannaaŋkaati kɔkɔ ń nyɔ̄ŋkì-si,
bin yú nì si deedeeyee ń jāam̀-si!
11Bí lì yii a-beel cáá tinyool,
bí sòoǹ a-pɔŋŋu pu!
12Mimmee bi làá yàntī binib ń béé a-tuŋkpaaŋŋi,
nì a-beel nyooti nín jìl̀ puee.
13A-beel sá jaanjaan beel ní,
a-pɔŋŋu bí ní ki cá abin abin.
Ti-Dindaan yaa pōoǹ kí ŋá puee, míǹ ní u ŋáań,
u dàkà u-neendi u-tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ poon.
14Ti-Dindaan di tīkintí bin kɔkɔ cá kí lítée,
úǹ di yáatí bin bōōyee.
15Bi-kɔkɔ nimbikpeeŋu cɔ́ a-pu nì dimákal,
ní a tìì-bi tijin ŋyunti ŋun an máaǹee.
16Sii di tàntī a-ŋal
ní ki tìì tin kɔkɔ cáá kufoouee tijin tí jī kí díkí.
17Ti-Dindaan sá deedeedaan tin u ŋáańee kɔkɔ poon,
u dàkà u-neendi u-tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ poon.
18Ti-Dindaan pìlīǹ bin kɔkɔ yíì-uee,
bin yíì-u nì mbaamɔnee.
19Bin fàŋkí-uee yaa là kuŋyee, u ŋáań ki tìì-bi ní,
u pílifí bi-biilii ní ki fìil̄-bi.
20Ti-Dindaan wúǹ bin kɔkɔ néeń-uee pu,
ama u làá kpɔ̀ kí céetí binikpitib kɔkɔ.
21M làá gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan,
tin kɔkɔ cáá kufoouee ń jāam̀ u-circir yindi
kí nīn pée cá jaanjaan.

english_text:
Shout Praises to the Lord
1Shout praises to the Lord!
With all that I am,
I will shout his praises.
2I will sing and praise
the Lord God
as long as I live.
3You can't depend on anyone,
not even a great leader.
4Once they die and are buried,
that will be the end
of all their plans.
5The Lord God of Jacob blesses
everyone who trusts him
and depends on him.
6 God made heaven and earth;
he created the sea
and everything else.
God always keeps his word.
7He gives justice to the poor
and food to the hungry.
The Lord sets prisoners free
8and heals blind eyes.
He gives a helping hand
to everyone who falls.
The Lord loves good people
9and looks after strangers.
He defends the rights
of orphans and widows,
but destroys the wicked.
10The Lord God of Zion
will rule forever!
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Ti-Dindaan di wúǹ biwɔfib pu
1 Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!
M làá nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan nì m-naŋki kɔkɔ!
2M làá nīn nyɔ́ŋkí ti-Dindaan m-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poon,
ŋyunti ŋun ní m bí dimaŋfalinee,
m làá nīn nyɔ́ŋkí m-Nimbɔtiu ní.
3Ní taa nín̄ máká abɔtibil,
àá unil un kaa cáá mpɔn kí fīīyee pu.
4Bi yaa kpíì ki fātìi gítì ntaminee,
tin bi nìn bɔ́ntì kí ŋée mun kúntì dee.
5Un jòońliu sá Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiu
ní udaan máká ti-Dindaan u-Nimbɔtiu puee bí mmɔnneeee!
6Ti-Dindaan di náań yilpu nì taapu,
nì tiŋku nì tin kɔkɔ bí u-poonee.
Úǹ di ŋúb́ ibaamɔn kí nīn cá jaanjaan.
7U sòoǹ ki ŋáŋkí bin bi sàantée bɔti,
u tìì bin ŋkùm cááyee tijin.
Ti-Dindaan tìì bisarkadambi dibatɔl,
8ti-Dindaan ŋúbití bijɔfub nimbiliŋ,
ti-Dindaan yáatí bin bōōyee,
ti-Dindaan néeń deedeedambi.
9Ti-Dindaan wúǹ binikɔkaabi pu,
u tīkintí ditaŋkpiibil nì ukpiipu,
ama u yàntī binikpitib nín bɔ́ntì tiŋyee ŋáań fám.
10Ti-Dindaan sá ubɔti ní kí nīn cá jaanjaan.
Siiyɔn, u sá a-Nimbɔtiu ní kí nīn cá abin abin.
Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_text:
Come Praise the Lord
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Shout the Lord's praises
in the highest heavens.
2All of you angels,
and all who serve him above,
come and offer praise.
3Sun and moon,
and all of you bright stars,
come and offer praise.
4Highest heavens, and the water
above the highest heavens,
come and offer praise.
5Let all things praise
the name of the Lord,
because they were created
at his command.
6He made them to last forever,
and nothing can change
what he has done.
7All creatures on earth,
you obey his commands,
so come praise the Lord!
8Sea monsters and the deep sea,
fire and hail, snow and frost,
and every stormy wind,
come praise the Lord!
9All mountains and hills,
fruit trees and cedars,
10every wild and tame animal,
all reptiles and birds,
come praise the Lord!
11Every king and every ruler,
all nations on earth,
12every man and every woman,
young people and old,
come praise the Lord!
13All creation, come praise
the name of the Lord.
Praise his name alone.
The glory of God is greater
than heaven and earth.
14Like a bull with mighty horns,
the Lord protects
his faithful nation Israel,
because they belong to him.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan yilpu nì taapu
1 Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!
Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan doooo yilpu,
nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u yilpu yilpu.
2Nimbi u-tuuŋyi kɔkɔ, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u,
nimbi u-janjakitil kɔkɔ, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u.
3Ŋwìiń nì uŋmal, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u,
nimbi iŋmalbijaa in jìl̀ee, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u.
4Nimbi yilpu yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u,
nimbi inyiŋfi in bí yilpu yilpuee, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u.
5Bi-kɔkɔ ń nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan yindi,
di sá yii u nìn tīī mara ní tiwan gbanti kɔkɔ náań.
6U dū-tì ki kāaǹ ti-paaŋyi kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan,
u síiǹ-tì mara un kaa bí kí kpántée.
7Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, doooo taapu,
tiŋkub nì tiŋku poon peebilinti,
8nì ŋŋmi nì ditaanyiŋkumbil nì dipɔ̀ńdi
nì kubuŋu nì kubuŋkpaaŋŋu kun bí u-nyɔɔbundi taapuee.
9Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u, ajoon nì ŋgbantamu,
nì isufi in lòoǹ abilee nì seedir dɔi kɔkɔ,
10nì ipeel nì tiwaŋkuti kɔkɔ,
nì inoon nì tin fù ti-pool puee.
11Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u, kitiŋ pu bɔtiibi,
nì anibul kɔkɔ,
nì abɔtibil nì kitiŋ pu kpootiliibi kɔkɔ,
12nì binaacimpɔmbi nì bisapɔmbi mun,
nì bitikpilib nì mbiyaamu.
13Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan yindi,
di sá yii úǹ baba yindi di sá diyiŋkpaandi,
u-nyooti tɔ́kɔ́ kitiŋ nì yilpu pu.
14U yāntì u-nibul yil kíǹ ki gáań.
An sá dinyandi ní ki tīī bin kɔkɔ néeń-uee,
Isirayeel yab, dinibul din pìlīǹ-uee.
Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_text:
A New Song of Praise
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Sing him a new song of praise
when his loyal people meet.
2People of Israel, rejoice
because of your Creator.
People of Zion, celebrate
because of your King.
3Praise his name by dancing
and playing music on harps
and tambourines.
4The Lord is pleased
with his people,
and he gives victory
to those who are humble.
5All of you faithful people,
praise our glorious Lord!
Celebrate and worship.
6 Praise God with songs
on your lips
and a sword in your hand.
7Take revenge and punish
the nations.
8Put chains of iron
on their kings and rulers.
9Punish them as they deserve;
this is the privilege
of God's faithful people.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Bin néeń Unimbɔtee jilmau
1 Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!
Gāāmaan nlampɔɔn kí pàkà ti-Dindaan.
Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan bin néeń-uee kpafil poon!
2Isirayeel yab, nín̄ fàal̀maan ni-náanliu pu,
Siiyɔn yab, an nīn mɔ̄ǹ-ni ni-bɔtiu pu.
3Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan nì diŋool,
bí bɔ̀ɔ̀ kigaŋgaŋ nì kubeeu kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u.
4Di sá yii ti-Dindaan nibul di tìì-u dipɔɔpindi,
u tìì bin sīntiǹ bi-ba taapuee jilma ki fìil̄-bi.
5Bin néeń Unimbɔtee ń nīn fàal̀ kí nīn tìì-u tinyool!
Báà bi yaa dɔ̄ bi-dooŋu puɔɔɔ, bí nīn gà ilan nì dipɔɔpindi!
6Bí gāā ilan mpɔn kí yòon̄ Unimbɔti yilpu,
kí nīn ŋúb́ bi-ŋaan kitàataajiki kin jītí ajan liitilee
7kí tɔ̀ atimbun ipɔntoon,
ní kí dáaĺ anibul tafal.
8Bí bóob́ bi-bɔtiibi ikusaka
ní kí bā bi-kàliŋkpilib akpambaa.
9Bí dáaĺ atimbun gbanti tafal kii an nín ŋmàn̄ puee.
An sá jilma ní ki tīī bin kɔkɔ néeń Unimbɔtee.
Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_text:
The Lord Is Good to His People
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Praise God in his temple.
Praise him in heaven,
his mighty fortress.
2Praise our God!
His deeds are wonderful,
too marvelous to describe.
3Praise God with trumpets
and all kinds of harps.
4Praise him with tambourines
and dancing,
with stringed instruments
and woodwinds.
5Praise God with cymbals,
with clashing cymbals.
6Let every living creature
praise the Lord.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan
1 Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!
Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan Unimbɔti u-Circir kɔŋkooŋŋun,
nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u u-pɔŋŋu ŋun bí kutagbɔŋunee pu!
2Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u u-tuŋkpaaŋŋi pu,
nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u u nín sá ukpaŋkpaanee pu!
3Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u nì dikantándi,
nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u nì iŋmii saalaa beeku nì saŋgu.
4Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u nì kigaŋgaŋ nì diŋool,
nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u nì tibati nì awul.
5Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u nì cancakantib ŋwaamu,
nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u nì cancakantib bikpaambi.
6Tin kɔkɔ pée cáá kufoouee ń nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan!
Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_text:
How Proverbs Can Be Used
1 These are the proverbs
of King Solomon of Israel,
the son of David.
2Proverbs will teach you
wisdom and self-control
and how to understand
sayings with deep meanings.
3You will learn what is right
and honest and fair.
4From these, an ordinary person
can learn to be smart,
and young people can gain
knowledge and good sense.
5If you are already wise,
you will become even wiser.
And if you are smart,
you will learn to understand
6proverbs and sayings,
as well as words of wisdom,
and all kinds of riddles.
7 Respect and obey the Lord!
This is the beginning
of knowledge.
Only a fool rejects wisdom
and good advice.
Warnings against Bad Friends
8My child, obey the teachings
of your parents,
9and wear their teachings
as you would a pretty hat
or a lovely necklace.
10Don't be tempted by sinners
or listen 11when they say,
“Come on! Let's gang up
and kill somebody,
just for the fun of it!
12They're well and healthy now,
but we'll finish them off
once and for all.
13We'll take their valuables
and fill our homes
with stolen goods.
14If you join our gang,
you'll get your share.”
15Don't follow anyone like that
or do what they do.
16They are in a big hurry
to commit some crime,
perhaps even murder.
17They are like a bird
that sees the bait,
but ignores the trap.
18They gang up to murder someone,
but they are the victims.
19The wealth you get from crime
robs you of your life.
Wisdom Speaks
20 Wisdom shouts in the streets
wherever crowds gather.
21She shouts in the marketplaces
and near the city gates
as she says to the people,
22“How much longer
will you enjoy
being stupid fools?
Won't you ever stop sneering
and laughing at knowledge?
23Listen as I correct you
and tell you what I think.
24You completely ignored me
and refused to listen;
25you rejected my advice
and paid no attention
when I warned you.
26“So when you are struck
by some terrible disaster,
27or when trouble and distress
surround you like a whirlwind,
I will laugh and make fun.
28You will ask for my help,
but I won't listen;
you will search,
but you won't find me.
29No, you would not learn,
and you refused
to respect the Lord.
30You rejected my advice
and paid no attention
when I warned you.
31“Now you will eat the fruit
of what you have done,
until you are stuffed full
with your own schemes.
32Sin and self-satisfaction
bring destruction and death
to stupid fools.
33But if you listen to me,
you will be safe and secure
without fear of disaster.”
translation_text:
1Daafiidi jipɔɔn Saloomɔn un sá Isirayeel bɔtiuee laŋkpaŋŋi.
Kun pu ní bi ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu neeyee
2Alaŋkpan nee yàntī unil ń béé iciin kí dàkà-u ú nīn nyí tibɔti tin cáá taapuee. 3Ŋi yàntī unil ń ká didàkamɔntiil, kí nīn bí deedee, kí nīn cáá tibulcin ní kí nīn nóó ibaamɔn saŋŋu. 4Ŋi yàntī sɔkɔmii nib ń nīn wálifì, ki tìì binipɔmbi dinyil nì nlandɔkɔ. 5Uciŋfiti pílifí-ŋi ní ki mɔ̀tīi cíkití iciin, ní ŋi kpòotī unyil ki tàkantí nsammɔnti pu 6ú ŋmā kí béé alaŋkpan nì ipɔɔn nì biciŋfitiibi bɔti tin bí dibalin bi lèekī ki dàkèe.
7Á fàŋkì ti-Dindaan di sá iciin kílilaŋki. See bigbaambi tafal di kaa fātìi tɔ́ didàkal nì biciŋfitiibi saŋkii.
Á nīn nyí nì a-ba nì binaacimpɔmbi bin dī isaŋkpitee
8M-jipɔɔn, pīlifì a-baa dàkal, taa kpèè a-na dàkatam fám. 9Án di dāa sá kifuunyaaŋŋi ki cíkí a-yil, nì tiléeŋkaal tin a lá a-neenee. 10M-jipɔɔn, bikpitiŋaliibi yaa là kí kīil̀-see, á taa kíí. 11Bi yaa lī yii: «Dāan̄ kí nóó-ti tí cùú nákań nsanni, binib yaa jītée tí kpɔ̀-bi. Tí cùú píĺ kpaalaa kí cúú maanyiiba un kaa ŋá-ti tibee. 12Tí yàntī bí sìntī ditaŋkpiilin nì bi-nimbiliŋ, bí kɔ́ dikaakulin nì bi-laafiyau. 13Ti làá ká tiwan tin pɔ̄ɔ̄ kudaauee nì ti-bulifi. Ti làá gbéeǹ ti-dumpui nì tiwan tin ti fúkúl̀ee. 14Sii mun wanti làá nīn bí poon, kun puee ti làá dū ti-kɔkɔ yati kí kpāfì dicilpu ní!» 15M-jipɔɔn, taa nóó an nib gbanti, sii nì bi ń taa pèen̄ nsan. 16Di sá yii bi sáń ki cá kí ŋá ikpiti ní, bi yáb̀ nnikpaakoon pu. 17An sá fám ní bí píĺ kutaliŋŋu unoon nimbilin. 18Ama bíǹ pīil̀ bi-ba ní kutaliŋŋu, bíǹ bi-ba maŋfal ní bi pīil̀ kpaalaabi. 19Míǹ ní an sá ki tīī un kamaa yù bunaayubuee. Bu làá dāá lēē bin ni bu bée maŋfal.
Iciin yíì binib ki kpáafí-bi
20Iciin bíi kūuntí mpɔn adan pu, i bí ki sòoǹ mpɔn mpaampiin pu. 21Iciin kūuntí ki yíì binib sampaambi pu, i sòoǹ ki báakí tin i cáá kí lèe ntimu punyɔmmu nyɔkɔpu. 22Iciin téeń ki lī yii: «Nimbi nnaatuumu làá nīn néeń inaatuu kí tin sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu dee? Nimbi bibeeliliibee, ni làá nīn bèel̄-mi kí tin sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní? Nimbi bigbaambi làá nīn ná dinyil kí tin sāā la? 23Pīlifìmaan tin m cáá kí wòoǹ-nee. M làá yàntī m-fam ń kpákatí ni-pu ní kí yàntī ní béé m-bɔti. 24Ama m yíì-ni ní naa pílifí, m tāntì m-ŋal ni-watil pú ní ni-kansikin báà ubɔ kaa fātìi tɔ́. 25Ni fá m-saŋkii kɔkɔ, kaa kíí ḿ wòoǹ-ni. 26Dinimbinaamandi yaa láa jéetì ni-puee, ma mun làá dāá lā-ni. Ni yaa láa kɔ́ dinyoondinee, m làá dāá bèel̀-ni. 27Di sá yii ŋwindalee dinyoondi làá dāá jēetí ni-pu kii umɔfiintaayee. Dinimbinaamandi làá dāá jēetí ni-pu kii kunaakpaabuŋŋuee, ní kunimbaau nì nnaabu ń dāá kɔ́-ni an kaa cáá bí lì. 28Niinee ni làá dāá yíiń-mi, ama maa làá dāá kíí-ni, ni làá dāá nyàab̀-mi, ama naa làá dāá ká-mi. 29Kun puee ni ná dinyil, ní kaa lēē kí nīn fàŋkí ti-Dindaan. 30Naa fōō m-saŋkii, kaa fātìi tɔ́ tin ní m kpáafì-nee. 31Mimmee kun ní ni-bimbikpitim búĺee, kúǹ ní ni làá cā, atuŋkpiti ŋin ni bɔ́ntì ki làá ŋée di làá kpíiǹ-ni. 32Di sá yii nnaatuumu nín kaa bífí iciin puee di làá kpɔ̀-mu, ní tiba nì tiba nín kaa ká bigbaambi puee di làá nàan̄-bi. 33Ama un kamaa di yaa pílifì-mee làá nīn bí ŋgbansɔŋfin, ní kaa làá fàŋkì nnaabu.»

english_text:
Wisdom and Bad Friends
1My child, you must follow
and treasure my teachings
and my instructions.
2Keep in tune with wisdom
and think what it means
to have common sense.
3Beg as loud as you can
for good common sense.
4Search for wisdom
as you would search for silver
or hidden treasure.
5Then you will understand
what it means to respect
and to know the Lord God.
6 All wisdom comes from the Lord,
and so do common sense
and understanding.
7God gives helpful advice
to everyone who obeys him
and protects those
who live as they should.
8God sees that justice is done,
and he watches over everyone
who is faithful to him.
9With wisdom you will learn
what is right
and honest and fair.
10Wisdom will control your mind,
and you will be pleased
with knowledge.
11Sound judgment and good sense
will watch over you.
12Wisdom will protect you
from evil schemes
and from those liars
13who turned from doing good
to live in the darkness.
14Most of all they enjoy
being mean and deceitful.
15They are dishonest themselves,
and so are all their deeds.
Wisdom and Sexual Purity
16Wisdom will protect you
from the smooth talk
of a sinful woman,
17who breaks her wedding vows
and leaves the man she married
when she was young.
18The road to her house leads
down
to the dark world
of the dead.
19Visit her, and you will never
find the road to life again.
20Follow the example
of good people
and live an honest life.
21If you are honest and innocent,
you will keep your land;
22if you do wrong
and can never be trusted,
you will be rooted out.
translation_text:
Iciin fìil̄ unil tikpitilin
1M-biki, fōō tin ní m dàkà-see,
kpāafì m-marab a-ni.
2Kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì iciin,
kpòon̄ a-pɔbil kí gíiǹ dinyil watil pú.
3Mèè dinyil dí tūtuǹ-si,
yíiń tibɔti taapu digbilindi dí jòoń-si.
4Nyàab̀ an wanti kii animbilee,
nyàab̀-tì kii tigaajawan tin bí dibalinee.
5Niinee a làá gbìl̄ unil ń nīn fàŋkí ti-Dindaanee taapu,
ní á ŋmā kí nīn nyí Unimbɔti.
6Di sá yii ti-Dindaan di tìì iciin,
u-cee ní dinyil nì tibɔti taapu digbilindi nyēeń.
7Úǹ di tútúǹ deedeedambi,
ní ki wúǹ bibulcinnib pu kii digbampɔɔlee.
8U tíkí bin nóó deedee saŋŋuee,
ki cí bin yú nì u deedeeyee.
9A yaa pílifiǹ-mee, a làá béé yii
á nīn bí deedee, kí nīn cáá tibulcin ní kí nīn nóó ibaamɔn saŋŋuee
di sá nnaam sàmbiki.
10Niinee ní iciin ń kɔ́ a-pɔbilin,
ní dinyil ń yàntī a-naŋki ń nīn bí mmɔnni.
11Nlandɔkɔmɔnti làá nīn wúń a-pu,
ní dinyil ń nīn cí-si.
12Tiwan gbanti làá tūtuǹ-si á taa ŋá tin kaa ŋān̄ee.
Tì làá fīī-si binib bin sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔtee ŋaan.
13Tì làá fīī-si binib bin féeń ibaamɔn saŋŋu
ki kíǹ ki nóó dibɔmbɔndi sàmbiyaamuee ŋaan.
14An mɔ̄ǹ-bi bí nīn ŋáań tin kaa ŋān̄ee,
bi tūǹ atuŋkpiti ki fàal̀.
15Bi-sàmbiyaamu gɔ́ĺ,
ní bi-saŋyi kaa tèen̄.
16Mimmee a làá nyā ubɔ nimpuu ŋaan,
uninjamɔnnil un cáá nyɔɔmálmalee.
17U yāntì u-taafaabɔɔn,
ní ki súntì dipoondi din u pōoǹ u-Nimbɔtiu nimbiinee pu.
18U-bimbim cáǹ-u ŋkúmin,
ní u-ŋáaǹtam cáǹ-u ditaŋkpiilin.
19Ubɔ kaa cūtì u-cee ki fātìi gítìń,
ki kíntì dimaŋfal saŋŋu.
20An puee fōō binimɔntiibi bimbim,
dī deedeedambi tabɔbiliŋ.
21Di sá yii deedeedambi di làá nīn kóò kitiŋ pu,
bibulcinnib di làá gbíntí ki-pu.
22Binikpitib bíǹ làá nyā kitiŋ pu,
bi làá jà bin kaa bí deedeeyee kí nyāntí kitiŋ pu.

english_text:
Trust God
1My child, remember
my teachings and instructions
and obey them completely.
2They will help you live
a long and prosperous life.
3Let love and loyalty
always show like a necklace,
and write them in your mind.
4 God and people will like you
and hold you in high esteem.
5With all your heart
you must trust the Lord
and not your own judgment.
6Always let him lead you,
and he will clear the road
for you to follow.
7 Don't ever think that you
are wise enough,
but respect the Lord
and stay away from evil.
8This will make you healthy,
and you will feel strong.
9Honor the Lord by giving him
your money and the first part
of all your crops.
10Then you will have
more grain and grapes
than you will ever need.
11 My child, don't turn away
or become bitter
